knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。
knowledge.textEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「施工窗口與可完成工作量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Possession window and achievable work" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。
兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack.
Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator.
quiz.explanation: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率與隧道換氣與稀釋時間
stages.titleEn: Vertical circulation throughput & Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直動線有效輸送率」與「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Vertical circulation throughput" and "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Vertical circulation throughput: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直動線有效輸送率」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Vertical circulation throughput” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 電扶梯的理論輸送率可由速度、梯級間距及每級人數估算，實際值還受入口遲疑、行李和站立習慣限制。多台設備不一定能線性相加，因為共用入口或出口可能先形成瓶頸。 階梯間距與速度決定理論階梯通過率，每階占用率則把機械運動轉成載客量。旅客猶豫、行李及出口壅塞會降低實際通過率，不能以理論值直接證明疏散能力。 比較深層站電扶梯和樓梯的服務量及移動時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直動線有效輸送率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Escalator theoretical throughput follows speed, step pitch and occupants per step. Hesitation, luggage and standing habits limit actual use. Several escalators do not necessarily add linearly when a shared entrance or exit becomes the earlier bottleneck. Step pitch and speed determine theoretical step passage, while occupancy per step converts mechanical motion into passenger flow. Hesitation, luggage and blocked exits reduce delivery, so the theoretical rate cannot directly demonstrate evacuation capacity. Compare escalator and stair throughput and travel time at a deep station. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vertical circulation throughput” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step；計算：throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step; calculation: throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直動線有效輸送率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Vertical circulation throughput”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率
knowledge.text: 電扶梯的理論輸送率可由速度、梯級間距及每級人數估算，實際值還受入口遲疑、行李和站立習慣限制。多台設備不一定能線性相加，因為共用入口或出口可能先形成瓶頸。
knowledge.textEn: Escalator theoretical throughput follows speed, step pitch and occupants per step. Hesitation, luggage and standing habits limit actual use.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直動線有效輸送率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Vertical circulation throughput" is correct?
options: 兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
電扶梯的理論輸送率可由速度、梯級間距及每級人數估算，實際值還受入口遲疑、行李和站立習慣限制。
optionsEn: Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
Escalator theoretical throughput follows speed, step pitch and occupants per step.
quiz.explanation: 電扶梯的理論輸送率可由速度、梯級間距及每級人數估算，實際值還受入口遲疑、行李和站立習慣限制。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Escalator theoretical throughput follows speed, step pitch and occupants per step. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Vertical circulation throughput: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直動線有效輸送率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Vertical circulation throughput” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step；計算：throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 0.55 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 5940 persons/hour。模型邊界：穩定速度和平均梯級占用；不含出入口匯流與無障礙替代路徑。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step; calculation: throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.55 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5940 persons/hour. Model boundary: Steady speed and mean step occupancy; entrance merging and accessible alternative routes are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step；計算：throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour。敏感度：speed 單獨增加百分之十至 0.55 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 5940 persons/hour。模型邊界：穩定速度和平均梯級占用；不含出入口匯流與無障礙替代路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step; calculation: throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour. Sensitivity: speed, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.55 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 5940 persons/hour. Model boundary: Steady speed and mean step occupancy; entrance merging and accessible alternative routes are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「垂直動線有效輸送率」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Vertical circulation throughput", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step。
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step；計算：throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: speed=0.5 m/s; pitch=0.4 m/step; occupants=1.2 persons/step; calculation: throughput=3600*speed/pitch*occupants=5400 persons/hour. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Vertical circulation throughput: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直動線有效輸送率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Vertical circulation throughput” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。 核對階梯間距與帶速，以入口及出口計數比較乘客流量，另記停頓和空階比例。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput. Verify step pitch and belt speed, compare entry and exit passenger counts, and separately record stoppages and empty-step proportions. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一台停機與出口縮窄兩種情境，畫出瓶頸位置，提出電梯與樓梯的替代動線並記錄不同旅客所需時間。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 throughput，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare one failed escalator with a narrowed exit, map the bottleneck, and propose lift and stair alternatives while recording journey times for different passenger needs. Also recalculate throughput for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：出口暫停會造成回堵並影響整段動線；一台設備停機時，另一台的入口可能無法吸收全部轉移人流。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A pause at the exit causes spillback through the circulation path; when one escalator is unavailable, the other entrance may not accept all diverted passengers. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。 核對階梯間距與帶速，以入口及出口計數比較乘客流量，另記停頓和空階比例。
knowledge.textEn: Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput. Verify step pitch and belt speed, compare entry and exit passenger counts, and separately record stoppages and empty-step proportions.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較一台停機與出口縮窄兩種情境，畫出瓶頸位置，提出電梯與樓梯的替代動線並記錄不同旅客所需時間。 再以本單元 speed 的對照值重算 throughput，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare one failed escalator with a narrowed exit, map the bottleneck, and propose lift and stair alternatives while recording journey times for different passenger needs. Also recalculate throughput for the alternative speed value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「垂直動線有效輸送率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Vertical circulation throughput"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。
兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput.
Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them.
quiz.explanation: 逐時段計數入口和出口，記錄空梯級比例與行李比例，並在共用平台量隊列長度，避免把額定值當現場值。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Count entrance and exit flow by interval, record empty-step and luggage fractions, and measure the shared-landing queue rather than substituting rated throughput. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 垂直動線有效輸送率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Vertical circulation throughput: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂直動線有效輸送率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Vertical circulation throughput” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 出口暫停會造成回堵並影響整段動線；一台設備停機時，另一台的入口可能無法吸收全部轉移人流。 出口堵塞時提高帶速可能加劇累積，需先檢查出口容量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A pause at the exit causes spillback through the circulation path; when one escalator is unavailable, the other entrance may not accept all diverted passengers. Increasing belt speed can worsen accumulation at a blocked outlet; inspect outlet capacity first. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較深層站電扶梯和樓梯的服務量及移動時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare escalator and stair throughput and travel time at a deep station.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two escalators necessarily deliver twice the rated throughput of one escalator." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 出口暫停會造成回堵並影響整段動線；一台設備停機時，另一台的入口可能無法吸收全部轉移人流。 出口堵塞時提高帶速可能加劇累積，需先檢查出口容量。
knowledge.textEn: A pause at the exit causes spillback through the circulation path; when one escalator is unavailable, the other entrance may not accept all diverted passengers. Increasing belt speed can worsen accumulation at a blocked outlet; inspect outlet capacity first.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「垂直動線有效輸送率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Vertical circulation throughput" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
出口暫停會造成回堵並影響整段動線；一台設備停機時，另一台的入口可能無法吸收全部轉移人流。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
A pause at the exit causes spillback through the circulation path; when one escalator is unavailable, the other entrance may not accept all diverted passengers.

steps.objective: 說明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 建立車站一般換氣量，清楚區別火災煙流分析。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Estimate normal station ventilation while clearly separating fire-smoke analysis. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=276.3102 s。敏感度：flow 單獨增加百分之十至 27.5 m^3/s，其餘固定，結果為 251.1911 s。模型邊界：完全混合且污染源已停止；不含煙層、熱浮力與火災成長。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=276.3102 s. Sensitivity: flow, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 27.5 m^3/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 251.1911 s. Model boundary: Perfect mixing after source removal; smoke layers, buoyancy and fire growth are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. Check the time constant with safe tracer decay, measure concentration at multiple points, retain door states, and check for a continuing source. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對兩種風量計算達到同一殘餘比例的時間，加入一個不完全混合死角，說明量測配置如何發現模型失配。 再以本單元 flow 的對照值重算 dilution_time，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform storage and queue conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 把月台候車、行走和設備占用劃成不同有效面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Divide platform waiting, movement and equipment occupation into distinct usable areas. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform storage and queue conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform storage and queue conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆
knowledge.text: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。
knowledge.textEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

quiz.question: 關於「月台暫存與隊列守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Platform storage and queue conservation" is correct?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。

optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
quiz.explanation: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform storage and queue conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 463至 463 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.322857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 463, to 463 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.322857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 463至 463 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.322857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=420 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.2 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 463, to 463 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.322857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台暫存與隊列守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform storage and queue conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「月台暫存與隊列守恆」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Platform storage and queue conservation"?
options: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。

optionsEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.

quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform storage and queue conservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把月台候車、行走和設備占用劃成不同有效面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Divide platform waiting, movement and equipment occupation into distinct usable areas.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。
knowledge.textEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台暫存與隊列守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Platform storage and queue conservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。

optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.

quiz.explanationEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 以入口短時降雨估算排水量，檢查泵浦停止時的積水。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Estimate entrance runoff during a short storm and examine accumulation with the pump stopped. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

knowledge.title: 集水與排水容量
knowledge.text: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。
knowledge.textEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level.

Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「集水與排水容量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s。敏感度：rain 單獨增加百分之十至 2.2e-05 m/s，其餘固定，結果為 0.3366 m^3/s。模型邊界：均勻降雨的合理化法概念；不含集流時間、水文頻率分析或蓄滯。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.2e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3366 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2; calculation: flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.306 m^3/s. Sensitivity: rain, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 2.2e-05 m/s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.3366 m^3/s. Model boundary: Uniform-rainfall rational-method concept; concentration time, frequency analysis and storage are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「集水與排水容量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verify rainfall units and catchment boundaries, measure pump outflow and sump-level change, and cross-check them through volume conservation.

knowledge.text: 將部分入口視為堵塞，建立地表暫存與排出的水量表；比較增加入口和增加泵量對不同瓶頸的效果。 再以本單元 rain 的對照值重算 flow，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Block selected inlets in the scenario, tabulate surface storage and discharge, and compare additional inlets with additional pumping for different bottlenecks. Also recalculate flow for the alternative rain value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「集水與排水容量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity"?
options: 沿用另一處鐵路設施或路線的量測結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。
兩台電扶梯的實際總輸送率必定等於單台額定值兩倍
optionsEn: Reusing results from another railway facility or route counts as verifying this structure.
Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater.

quiz.explanationEn: Check catchment boundaries and inlet elevations, use rainfall, water-level and pump logs for a balance, and distinguish normal outflow from downstream backwater. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Catchment inflow and drainage capacity: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「集水與排水容量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以入口短時降雨估算排水量，檢查泵浦停止時的積水。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimate entrance runoff during a short storm and examine accumulation with the pump stopped.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。
knowledge.textEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Blocked drainage changes effective outflow and cannot be compensated merely by a larger pump nameplate rating.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「集水與排水容量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause.
quiz.explanation: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證與聲能相加與分貝
stages.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification & Sound-energy addition and decibels
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互斥進路與真值驗證」與「聲能相加與分貝」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" and "Sound-energy addition and decibels": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 為新線接入既有線列出不可同時授權的進路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. List routes that cannot be authorised simultaneously where the new line joins the existing railway. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「互斥進路與真值驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" is correct?
options: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
兩個七十分貝聲源同時工作一定產生一百四十分貝
optionsEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels.
quiz.explanation: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
quiz.explanation: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「互斥進路與真值驗證」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 狀態覆蓋率高仍可能缺少危險轉移，須查事件先後。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. High state coverage can still miss a hazardous transition; inspect event ordering as well. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：為新線接入既有線列出不可同時授權的進路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: List routes that cannot be authorised simultaneously where the new line joins the existing railway.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲能相加與分貝」如何影響紐約第二大道地鐵一期的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Sound-energy addition and decibels” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Second Avenue Subway Phase 1”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 分貝是對數量，兩個聲源不能直接把分貝數字相加。非相干聲源需先還原相對聲能再合成，頻帶、量測位置及時間加權若不同，表面上相同的數值也不能直接比較。 分貝是對數量，聲源互不相干時應先轉回線性能量再相加。頻率加權和量測時間必須相同，否則兩個數字不能直接合成；有相干干涉時還需相位資訊。 將施工和營運聲源分開，以聲能方式計算合成量級。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲能相加與分貝」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Decibels are logarithmic, so sound levels cannot be added as ordinary numbers. Incoherent sources must first be converted to relative acoustic energy. Different bands, measurement positions or time weightings prevent direct comparison even when displayed values happen to match. Decibels are logarithmic, so incoherent sources must be converted to linear energy before summation. Frequency weighting and observation duration must match. Coherent interference additionally requires phase information and is not captured by the energy-sum model. Separate construction and operating sources and combine their acoustic energy levels. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Sound-energy addition and decibels” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：L1=73 dB; L2=67 dB；計算：combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=73.97323 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=73 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=73.97323 dB.

steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: L1=73 dB; L2=67 dB; calculation: combined=10*log10(10**(L1/10)+10**(L2/10))=73.97323 dB. Sensitivity: L1, increase the level by 3 dB, not a percentage increase in acoustic power, to 76 dB, with all other inputs fixed, gives 76.51497 dB. Model boundary: Incoherent sources with the same reference and weighting; phase interference and background subtraction are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲能相加與分貝」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Sound-energy addition and decibels” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時保留背景、列車通過和設備單獨運轉紀錄，確認麥克風校正、距離與頻帶設定一致，避免把不同時間窗混合。 以聲級校正器檢查儀器前後漂移，記錄頻率加權和平均時間，再測背景聲單獨量級。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Retain background, train-passage and equipment-only recordings, confirm microphone calibration, distance and frequency settings, and avoid mixing incompatible time windows. Check instrument drift with a sound calibrator before and after measurement, record frequency weighting and averaging time, and measure background separately. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較相同聲級與相差十分貝的兩聲源合成，列出背景扣除的適用條件，並解釋聲壓幅與聲能的對數係數差異。 再以本單元 L1 的對照值重算 combined，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Combine equal-level sources and sources ten decibels apart, list the conditions for background subtraction, and explain the different logarithmic factors for pressure amplitude and energy. Also recalculate combined for the alternative L1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 聲能相加與分貝：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Sound-energy addition and decibels: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「聲能相加與分貝」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Sound-energy addition and decibels” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未扣除背景可能高估列車貢獻，錯用算術平均則低估高噪事件；屏障缺口還可能讓局部接收點明顯偏高。 若背景聲未扣除，不能把全部合成量歸因於列車。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unremoved background can overstate train contribution, while arithmetic averaging understates loud events; barrier gaps can also produce local receiver hot spots. Without separate background measurement, the complete combined level cannot be attributed to the train. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Two seventy-decibel sources operating together necessarily produce one hundred forty decibels." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

title: 洛杉磯區域連接線
summary: 以洛杉磯區域連接線把既有路線貫通的背景，建立服務路徑重新組合的教學案例。學徒比較少一次轉乘與核心區段增班的不同效果，檢查合流進路、月台交換、地下站排水和施工交接如何共同決定實際效益。
summaryEn: Use the Los Angeles Regional Connector to construct a teaching case about through-running and reconfigured service paths. Compare the benefit of removing one transfer with that of increasing frequency in the central section. Examine how merge routes, platform exchange, underground drainage and construction handback jointly determine the realised passenger benefit, rather than assuming a shorter route diagram guarantees shorter journeys.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing distance in the first unit changes its result to 55.02 s. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.

stages.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕與快慢車追及與待避
stages.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin & Fast-slow train catch-up
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」與「快慢車追及與待避」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer walking and connection margin" and "Fast-slow train catch-up": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響洛杉磯區域連接線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Los Angeles Regional Connector”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 比較原先轉乘步行和等待與貫通列車旅程中的剩餘時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Compare former transfer walking and waiting with remaining time in a through-running journey. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=181.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=73.2 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=181.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=73.2 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transfer walking and connection margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕
knowledge.text: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。
knowledge.textEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer walking and connection margin" is correct?
options: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。
快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
optionsEn: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs.
Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
quiz.explanation: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer walking and connection margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=181.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=73.2 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 199.98 m，其餘固定，結果為 55.02 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=181.8 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=73.2 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 199.98 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 55.02 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.textEn: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer walking and connection margin"?
options: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
