steps.title: 沉陷差與軌道坡折：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Differential settlement and track kink: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「沉陷差與軌道坡折」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Differential settlement and track kink” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 採用同一穩定水準基點反覆量測，保留溫度和施工時間，利用多點高程剖面區分整段平移、坡折與量測基點漂移。 重複觀測同一測點並做閉合檢核，以另一穩定基準核對零點，報告高差與基長各自誤差。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat surveys against one stable datum, retain temperature and construction timing, and use multipoint profiles to separate translation, kinks and datum drift. Repeat identical points with closure checks, verify zero against another stable reference, and report separate errors for elevation difference and baseline. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：構造端點相同但中間下陷的剖面，與直線坡度模型比較；提出足以辨識沉陷槽寬度的測點間距與複測頻率。 再以本單元 drop 的對照值重算 gradient，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct a profile with equal endpoints and an intermediate trough, compare it with a straight-gradient model, and propose spacing and repeat intervals able to resolve the trough. Also recalculate gradient for the alternative drop value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「沉陷差與軌道坡折」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Differential settlement and track kink” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較施工前後同一測點剖面，避免基準更換造成假位移。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare identical survey profiles before and after construction to avoid apparent displacement from changed datums.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩端高程相同就能證明兩點之間沒有差異沉陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Equal endpoint elevations prove there is no differential settlement between them." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 高差異常需先查基點，不能立刻推定路基局部下沉。
knowledge.textEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. An unusual level difference requires a datum check before inferring local earthwork settlement.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「沉陷差與軌道坡折」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Differential settlement and track kink" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量

optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact.
quiz.explanation: 基點本身下沉會讓全段看似正常；只量端點又會漏掉中間沉陷槽，兩種情況均可低估輪軌衝擊。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A settling datum can hide movement of the whole section, and endpoint-only measurement misses an intermediate trough; both may understate wheel-rail impact. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量與匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕
stages.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work & Merging flow and bottleneck margin
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Possession window and achievable work" and "Merging flow and bottleneck margin": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」如何影響洛杉磯區域連接線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Possession window and achievable work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Los Angeles Regional Connector”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把交接窗口中的測試與還路時間列為必要工序。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工窗口與可完成工作量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Treat testing and handback time as necessary tasks within a commissioning possession. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Possession window and achievable work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Possession window and achievable work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量
knowledge.text: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。
knowledge.textEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Possession window and achievable work" is correct?
options: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。
施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量
平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊
optionsEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins.
The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time.
quiz.explanation: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Possession window and achievable work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 49.995 min，其餘固定，結果為 540.02 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.995 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 540.02 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 49.995 min，其餘固定，結果為 540.02 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.995 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 540.02 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Possession window and achievable work", which statement holds?
options: 快慢車平均速度不同也不會影響同線時刻表容量
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min。
只要平均班距減半所有乘客的等待時間就一定減半
optionsEn: Different fast and slow train speeds do not affect shared-line timetable capacity.
Original hypothetical exercise.
Halving average headway necessarily halves the waiting time of every passenger.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.45 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=558.2 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工窗口與可完成工作量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Possession window and achievable work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。
knowledge.textEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Possession window and achievable work"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差
按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
quiz.explanation: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Possession window and achievable work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把交接窗口中的測試與還路時間列為必要工序。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treat testing and handback time as necessary tasks within a commissioning possession.

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」如何影響洛杉磯區域連接線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Los Angeles Regional Connector”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩支線人流或列車流匯入同一通道時，總需求需與下游服務率比較。差值為正只代表平均有餘裕，突發到達仍會形成隊列；服務率降低時積壓以需求和服務的差累積。 容量減去兩支流給出平均服務餘裕，負值表示隊列會累積而非負人數。此代數式不描述人群密度與速度的關係；要算實際隊列長度，必須把淨流量隨時間積分。 把兩個出站方向匯入共同通道的流量與出口容量相減。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service. Positive average margin does not prevent queues after bursts. If service falls below demand, backlog accumulates at the difference between their rates. Capacity minus two incoming streams gives mean service margin; a negative value indicates accumulating queues, not negative people. This algebra does not describe the density-speed relationship. Physical queue length requires integrating net flow over time. Subtract two merging exit flows from the capacity of their shared downstream passage. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45.45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=19.55 persons/min。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45.45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=19.55 persons/min.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Mean demand below capacity guarantees that no queue forms at any time." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Merging flow and bottleneck margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: When two passenger or train streams merge, their combined demand must be compared with downstream service. Positive average margin does not prevent queues after bursts.

knowledge.text: 誤解：平均總需求低於容量就保證任何時間都不會排隊 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Merging flow and bottleneck margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Merging flow and bottleneck margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45.45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min；計算：margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=19.55 persons/min。敏感度：flow1 單獨增加百分之十至 49.995 persons/min，其餘固定，結果為 15.005 persons/min。模型邊界：定常平均流量；不包含隨機到達、優先權和實體隊列長度。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: capacity=100 persons/min; flow1=45.45 persons/min; flow2=35 persons/min; calculation: margin=capacity-flow1-flow2=19.55 persons/min. Sensitivity: flow1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 49.995 persons/min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 15.005 persons/min. Model boundary: Steady mean flows; random arrivals, priority rules and physical queue length are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「匯入流量與瓶頸餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 同時記錄兩個入口和下游出口，將資料用相同時間窗聚合，檢查需求尖峰是否被過大的平均窗隱藏。 同步量測兩入口與出口流量，採相同時間窗並以人數守恆核對區域內隊列的增減。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record both inlets and the downstream outlet synchronously, aggregate with equal windows, and check whether long averaging periods hide demand peaks. Measure both inlet flows and outlet flow synchronously, use identical time windows, and check queue changes through conservation of people. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：保持平均需求相同但把一支線改成脈衝到達，逐分鐘更新隊列，提出分流或節流措施並檢查其上游影響。 再以本單元 flow1 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Keep mean demand fixed while making one branch arrive in pulses, update the queue minute by minute, and assess upstream consequences of rerouting or metering. Also recalculate margin for the alternative flow1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：一支線延誤後集中釋放會造成瞬時過載，即使全天平均需求較小；下游出口短暫阻塞則可能向上游回堵。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A delayed branch can release a concentrated surge despite modest daily demand; a brief downstream blockage can spill a queue back upstream. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.explanationEn: A delayed branch can release a concentrated surge despite modest daily demand; a brief downstream blockage can spill a queue back upstream. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 新加坡湯申—東海岸線
summary: 以新加坡湯申東海岸線分期通車的背景，建立營運路段與延伸工程並存的教學系統。課程要求每次延伸都重新核對定位、通訊、進路、供電和旅客路徑，並保留已營運設備和新設備之間可追溯的測試證據。
summaryEn: Use the staged opening of Singapore’s Thomson–East Coast Line to build a teaching system where operating sections coexist with extension works. Recheck localisation, communications, routes, power and passenger paths at every extension. Retain traceable evidence across the boundary between existing and new equipment, rather than assuming acceptance of the earlier stage automatically covers the enlarged system.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 work_length=556.4 m；單元 2 得 combinations=64 states；單元 3 得 sigma=1.795841 m。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 setup 的擾動測試，結果改為 538.04 m；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以新加坡湯申東海岸線分期通車的背景，建立營運路段與延伸工程並存的教學系統。課程要求每次延伸都重新核對定位、通訊、進路、供電和旅客路徑，並保留已營運設備和新設備之間可追溯的測試證據。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives work_length=556.4 m; unit 2 gives combinations=64 states; unit 3 gives sigma=1.795841 m. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing setup in the first unit changes its result to 538.04 m. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the staged opening of Singapore’s Thomson–East Coast Line to build a teaching system where operating sections coexist with extension works. Recheck localisation, communications, routes, power and passenger paths at every extension. Retain traceable evidence across the boundary between existing and new equipment, rather than assuming acceptance of the earlier stage automatically covers the enlarged system. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量與互斥進路與真值驗證
stages.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work & Conflicting routes and truth-table verification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「施工窗口與可完成工作量」與「互斥進路與真值驗證」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Possession window and achievable work" and "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Possession window and achievable work” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。 可施工時間等於總窗口扣掉保護設置、測試及還路等必要活動。這些活動可能有不可重疊的安全依賴；趕工不能直接刪除，應以資源和先後順序改變排程。 把延伸線接續窗口分為隔離、施工、測試及還路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「施工窗口與可完成工作量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path. Coordination of dependencies may matter more than nominal production speed. Usable work time equals the possession window minus protection, testing and handback activities. These can have nonoverlapping safety dependencies and cannot simply be deleted to accelerate work. Change scheduling through resources and legitimate task order. Split the extension connection window into isolation, construction, testing and handback. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Possession window and achievable work” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Possession window and achievable work”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量
knowledge.text: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。提高施工速度不一定提高總產出，若撤場與驗收成為關鍵路徑，必須先調整作業協調。
knowledge.textEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. Higher work rate does not always increase output if clearance and acceptance dominate the critical path.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Possession window and achievable work" is correct?
options: 施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量
夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 夜間施工窗口需先扣除封鎖確認、隔離、運入及恢復測試時間，剩餘時間才可進行實際工作。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A night possession must allow for protection, isolation, access and restoration testing before productive work begins. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Possession window and achievable work” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 50.49 min，其餘固定，結果為 538.04 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 50.49 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 538.04 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。敏感度：setup 單獨增加百分之十至 50.49 min，其餘固定，結果為 538.04 m。模型邊界：固定速度與確定性窗口；不含返工、設備故障和分段驗收。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Sensitivity: setup, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 50.49 min, with all other inputs fixed, gives 538.04 m. Model boundary: Fixed production rate and deterministic window; rework, equipment failure and phased acceptance are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Possession window and achievable work", which statement holds?
options: 平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移
原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min。
optionsEn: A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset.
Original hypothetical exercise.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min；計算：work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: window=240 min; setup=45.9 min; restore=55 min; rate=4 m/min; calculation: work_length=(window-setup-restore)*rate=556.4 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「施工窗口與可完成工作量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Possession window and achievable work” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 逐項記錄窗口開始、保護完成、施工完成與還路時刻，核對前置條件及實際資源。
knowledge.textEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Log possession start, protection completion, work completion and handback times, checking mandatory prerequisites and resources actually available.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 增加前置作業時間並加入一次返工，重畫關鍵路徑，區分可平行任務與必須完成後才可開放的檢查。 再以本單元 setup 的對照值重算 work_length，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Increase setup time and add one rework event, redraw the critical path, and distinguish parallel tasks from checks that must finish before reopening. Also recalculate work_length for the alternative setup value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「施工窗口與可完成工作量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Possession window and achievable work"?
options: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 按事件紀錄封鎖、確認隔離、進場、工作結束與試驗完成時間，用實際有效工作時間計算產率。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Log possession, isolation confirmation, access, work completion and final testing, then calculate productivity from actual effective work time. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 施工窗口與可完成工作量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Possession window and achievable work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「施工窗口與可完成工作量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Possession window and achievable work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 壓縮恢復測試時間可能掩蓋未完成檢查；低估撤場時間會造成延誤，不能把安全確認當成可任意削減的冗餘。 施工完成不等於可還路，需保留檢查測試與解除保護時間。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Compressing restoration tests can hide incomplete checks, while underestimated clearance causes delay; safety confirmation cannot be treated as arbitrary slack. Work completion is not readiness for handback; retain inspection, testing and protection-removal time. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把延伸線接續窗口分為隔離、施工、測試及還路。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Split the extension connection window into isolation, construction, testing and handback.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=6 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=64 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 7 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 128 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=6 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=64 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 7 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 128 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

quiz.explanation: 只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 里程融合與不確定度與通訊延遲與位置陳舊量
stages.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty & Communication delay and stale position
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「里程融合與不確定度」與「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position fusion and uncertainty" and "Communication delay and stale position": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「里程融合與不確定度」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position fusion and uncertainty” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。 兩個獨立無偏估計的資訊量可以相加，較小變異數應獲較大權重。共同偏差不會被這種融合消除，相關性也會破壞公式；較小標準差只能表示宣告模型下的精密度。 比較延伸前後定位參考表，檢查資料版本一致性。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「里程融合與不確定度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error. Information from two independent unbiased estimates can be combined, assigning greater weight to smaller variance. Shared bias is not removed by this fusion, and correlation invalidates the expression. Smaller standard deviation represents precision only under the declared statistical model. Compare localisation reference tables before and after extension and check version consistency. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position fusion and uncertainty” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「里程融合與不確定度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Position fusion and uncertainty”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 里程融合與不確定度
knowledge.text: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。輪徑誤差和共同地圖偏差可能讓多個通道一起偏移，不能靠增加感測器數量消除。
knowledge.textEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. Wheel-diameter error and shared map bias can shift multiple channels together, so merely adding sensors does not remove systematic error.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「里程融合與不確定度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Position fusion and uncertainty" is correct?
options: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。

平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
optionsEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected.
Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
quiz.explanation: 獨立位置感測器可用變異數倒數加權，但只有誤差不相關且偏差已校正時，融合後不確定度才按公式下降。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Independent position measurements can be weighted by inverse variance, but uncertainty decreases as predicted only when errors are uncorrelated and biases have been corrected. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「里程融合與不確定度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position fusion and uncertainty” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.488 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.826817 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m. Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.488 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.826817 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m；計算：sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m。敏感度：s1 單獨增加百分之十至 4.488 m，其餘固定，結果為 1.826817 m。模型邊界：零均值獨立高斯誤差；不含共同偏差與完整性風險。

Sensitivity: s1, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 4.488 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.826817 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean Gaussian errors; common bias and integrity risk are excluded.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「里程融合與不確定度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Position fusion and uncertainty", which statement holds?
options: 停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移

風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降

Original hypothetical exercise.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: s1=4.08 m; s2=2 m; calculation: sigma=(1/(1/s1**2+1/s2**2))**0.5=1.795841 m. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「里程融合與不確定度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Position fusion and uncertainty” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Construct independent-error and common-bias datasets, compare their fused results, and identify the error requiring an external control point for detection. Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 以外部參考位置核對兩感測器殘差，檢查平均偏差及相關係數，再比較融合後覆蓋範圍。
knowledge.textEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Check both sensor residuals against an external position reference, examine mean bias and correlation, and compare coverage after fusion.

knowledge.text: 建立獨立誤差與共同偏差兩組資料，對比融合結果，指出哪一種誤差需要外部控制點才能發現。 再以本單元 s1 的對照值重算 sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。

Also recalculate sigma for the alternative s1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「里程融合與不確定度」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Position fusion and uncertainty"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低
以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability.
Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation.
quiz.explanation: 以獨立已知控制點比較融合前後殘差，逐段檢查偏差及相關性，並故意遮蔽一個感測器觀察降級行為。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare pre-fusion and post-fusion residuals at independently surveyed points, check bias and correlation by segment, and mask one sensor to inspect degraded operation. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 里程融合與不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Position fusion and uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「里程融合與不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Position fusion and uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較延伸前後定位參考表，檢查資料版本一致性。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare localisation reference tables before and after extension and check version consistency.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「兩個定位來源彼此一致就能保證定位沒有共同偏差」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Agreement between two position sources guarantees absence of common bias." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 共用錯誤地圖會讓兩個感測器看似一致卻都錯；錯把相關訊號當獨立會使報告的置信區間過窄。 若兩感測器共用錯誤基準，融合後仍會保持共同偏差。
knowledge.textEn: A shared wrong map can make two sensors agree while both are wrong; treating correlated signals as independent produces an overconfident interval. If both sensors share a wrong reference, the fused result retains the common bias.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「里程融合與不確定度」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達

A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.

steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 在延伸設備通訊延遲時驗證既有區段仍維持安全狀態。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Verify the existing section retains a safe state when extension-equipment communication is delayed. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Communication delay and stale position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Communication delay and stale position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.306 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.65 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3366 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.415 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.306 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.65 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3366 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.415 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Communication delay and stale position: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Communication delay and stale position” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 先檢查序號與時間戳，避免把重播封包誤認為狀態恢復。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. Check sequence numbers and timestamps before interpreting a replayed packet as state recovery. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Traction feeder voltage drop" and "Stopping error and platform-door alignment": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 牽引饋線壓降：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Traction feeder voltage drop: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「牽引饋線壓降」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Traction feeder voltage drop” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 牽引電流經導體與回流路徑產生壓降，電壓下降又可能讓定功率列車要求更大電流，形成非線性負荷互動。單一電阻模型先隔離線路損耗，再逐步引入雙端供電和多列車位置。 回路電阻必須包含饋電與回流路徑，還需說明是否納入接頭和變電站等效阻抗。電流固定是簡化；實際定功率負載在電壓降低時可能增加電流並擴大壓降。 將新增列車負載帶入供電回路，重新估算最遠端電壓。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「牽引饋線壓降」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Current through the feeder and return path creates voltage drop. A constant-power train may draw more current as voltage falls, creating nonlinear load interaction. A single resistance model first isolates line loss before adding two-ended supply and multiple train positions. Loop resistance must include supply and return paths, with joints and substation equivalent impedance explicitly included or excluded. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：current=1530 A; resistance=0.06 ohm；計算：drop=current*resistance=91.8 V。敏感度：current 單獨增加百分之十至 1683 A，其餘固定，結果為 100.98 V。模型邊界：固定電流與集中等效電阻；不含回生、功率因數與暫態。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.instruction: 列車停準與月台門對位由列車位置、門中心距和控制容差共同決定。多個獨立誤差可用平方和開根號描述標準差，但系統偏差須另加；幾何對位也不能代替障礙物偵測和關門互鎖。 停車、測量與門位置三個獨立零均值誤差以變異數相加，再取平方根得到合成標準差。這不是最大偏移保證，也不含共同系統偏差；機械淨空及容許對位範圍須另外核對。 讓新站門位與既有車輛停準配對量測，區分隨機及共同偏差。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「停準誤差與月台門對位」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Train-to-platform door alignment combines stopping position, door spacing and control tolerances. Independent random errors can be combined by root-sum-square, but systematic offsets must be added separately. Geometric alignment does not replace obstruction detection or the door-closure interlock. Three independent zero-mean errors in stopping, surveying and door position combine through summed variances. The square root gives a standard deviation, not a guaranteed maximum offset. Shared bias is excluded, and mechanical clearance and permitted alignment ranges require separate checks. Pair new station door-position measurements with existing vehicle stops and distinguish random from shared error. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「停準誤差與月台門對位」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m；計算：combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m。敏感度：stop_sigma 單獨增加百分之十至 0.08976 m，其餘固定，結果為 0.09317649 m。模型邊界：獨立零均值誤差；不是最大誤差界限，也未給允收公差。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: stop_sigma=0.0816 m; survey_sigma=0.02 m; door_sigma=0.015 m; calculation: combined_sigma=(stop_sigma**2+survey_sigma**2+door_sigma**2)**0.5=0.08534378 m. Sensitivity: stop_sigma, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.08976 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.09317649 m. Model boundary: Independent zero-mean errors; not a maximum bound and no acceptance tolerance is specified. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「停準誤差與月台門對位」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以固定月台基準量車門中心偏差，區分重複性與平均偏移，並在載重、方向和制動條件改變時重複測試。 以獨立基準重複量測停準與門位，檢查各誤差平均值、相關性和單位，再核對合成分布。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Repeat stopping and door-position measurements against an independent reference, check each mean, correlation and unit, and compare the combined distribution. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把隨機誤差和固定偏移分開做誤差預算，畫出不同載重的停準分布，列出對位與互鎖需分別驗證的證據。 再以本單元 stop_sigma 的對照值重算 combined_sigma，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build separate random-error and fixed-bias budgets, plot stopping distributions at different loads, and list distinct evidence for alignment and interlocking. Also recalculate combined_sigma for the alternative stop_sigma value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
