quiz.explanationEn: Measure door-centre offset against fixed platform datums, separate repeatability from mean bias, and repeat with changes in load, direction and braking conditions. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 停準誤差與月台門對位：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Stopping error and platform-door alignment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「停準誤差與月台門對位」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Stopping error and platform-door alignment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：讓新站門位與既有車輛停準配對量測，區分隨機及共同偏差。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Pair new station door-position measurements with existing vehicle stops and distinguish random from shared error.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「停準誤差標準差小就代表不可能出現固定方向偏移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A small stopping-error standard deviation rules out a persistent directional offset." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 定位偏差和站台測量偏差可能同向累積，僅看標準差會漏掉系統偏移；門對準也不代表夾物偵測有效。 若共同定位偏差存在，平方和模型會低估實際對位偏移。
knowledge.textEn: Position and survey biases may accumulate in the same direction and escape a standard-deviation check; aligned doors also do not prove obstruction detection works. A shared positioning bias makes the root-sum-square model understate actual alignment offset.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.

stages.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕與隧道換氣與稀釋時間

stages.description: 本階段聚焦「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」與「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Transfer walking and connection margin" and "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 比較新轉乘路徑開放前後的步行與等候分布。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Compare walking and waiting distributions before and after a new interchange path opens. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer walking and connection margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 m，其餘固定，結果為 53.04 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 53.04 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 201.96 m，其餘固定，結果為 53.04 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=183.6 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=71.4 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 201.96 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 53.04 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer walking and connection margin"?
options: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。

optionsEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.

quiz.explanationEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer walking and connection margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：比較新轉乘路徑開放前後的步行與等候分布。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Compare walking and waiting distributions before and after a new interchange path opens.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transfer walking and connection margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。
風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route.
A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
quiz.explanation: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。 完全混合且污染源已停止時，濃度以指數衰減；剩餘比例必須介於零與一。換氣率是流量除以容積，清除時間還依目標濃度而變，不能把一次換氣直接當成全部清除。 隨新增地下站重新界定一般通風的體積和換氣需求。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow. This model illustrates dilution scale and cannot establish fire evacuation tenability. For perfect mixing after the source stops, concentration decays exponentially and the remaining fraction lies between zero and one. Air-change rate is flow divided by volume, while clearance time also depends on target concentration. One air change does not mean complete removal. Redefine normal ventilation volume and air-change demand as underground stations are added. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1；計算：dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: volume=3000 m^3; flow=25.5 m^3/s; remaining=0.1 1; calculation: dilution_time=-volume/flow*log(remaining)=270.8924 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間
knowledge.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time
knowledge.text: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。真實隧道存在分層、死角及列車活塞風，因此這個模型只適合示範稀釋量級，不能直接用作火災避難判定。
knowledge.textEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. Real tunnels contain layering, stagnant regions and train-induced piston flow.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tunnel air exchange and dilution time" is correct?
options: 風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降
排水管截面夠大就不需要檢查入口堵塞及下游水位
完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。
optionsEn: A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel.
A sufficiently large drain eliminates the need to check blocked inlets and tailwater.
A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant.
quiz.explanation: 完全混合空間的濃度在定風量清除下呈指數衰減，體積除以風量給出特徵時間。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A perfectly mixed volume under constant clean-air flow exhibits exponential concentration decay, with volume divided by flow as the time constant. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.observation: 如何核對：用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用非危險示蹤試驗在不同高度與距離採樣，量測實際風量並檢查濃度衰減是否符合單一指數。 以安全示蹤氣體衰減核對時間常數，多點量測濃度並保留門狀態，檢查是否存在未停止源。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use a harmless tracer test with samples at several heights and distances, measure actual airflow, and check whether one exponential describes the decay. steps.observationEn: Site practice: Calculate time to one residual fraction at two airflows, add a poorly mixed pocket, and explain how sensor placement can reveal model mismatch. Also recalculate dilution_time for the alternative flow value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 隧道換氣與稀釋時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Tunnel air exchange and dilution time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「隧道換氣與稀釋時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tunnel air exchange and dilution time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 死角可能在平均濃度下降後仍維持高濃度；風機反轉或風門錯位也會改變流路，不能只用風機啟動回饋判斷通風。 風機有轉不代表有效稀釋，需查風道旁通和持續污染源。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Stagnant pockets may remain concentrated after the average falls; reversed fans or misplaced dampers alter flow paths, so a running-status signal alone cannot verify ventilation. A running fan does not prove effective dilution; inspect bypass and continuing contaminant sources. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：隨新增地下站重新界定一般通風的體積和換氣需求。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Redefine normal ventilation volume and air-change demand as underground stations are added.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「風機已經啟動就能證明隧道每一處濃度同樣下降」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A running fan proves concentration falls equally at every point in the tunnel." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Catchment inflow and drainage capacity" and "Parallel redundancy and common cause": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 集水與排水容量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「集水與排水容量」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 短時逕流可先以降雨強度、集水面積和逕流係數估計，但設施排水還受入口阻塞、管線坡度與下游水位影響。鐵路集水範圍若只算軌道面，會漏掉坡面與站區流入。 合理化流量法假定雨強與集流條件相符，面積及逕流係數也須明確。它估算峰值流率而非完整洪水歷線；抽水或蓄水設計還需對時間積分和出口條件。 檢查新舊排水區域連接是否改變泵浦停機的積水邊界。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「集水與排水容量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A first runoff estimate combines rainfall intensity, catchment area and runoff coefficient. Actual drainage also depends on inlet blockage, pipe slope and downstream water level. Counting only track surface can omit inflow from adjacent slopes and station areas. The rational estimate assumes rainfall intensity compatible with catchment response and explicit area and runoff coefficient. It gives a peak rate, not a complete hydrograph. Pumping or storage design additionally requires time integration and outlet conditions. Check whether linked drainage zones change accumulation boundaries during pump downtime. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Catchment inflow and drainage capacity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：coefficient=0.85 1; rain=2.04e-05 m/s; area=18000 m^2；計算：flow=coefficient*rain*area=0.31212 m^3/s。

steps.instruction: 現地核對集水分界和入口標高，以雨量、液位與泵浦運轉紀錄檢查水量收支，分開分析正常排放和下游頂托。 核對雨量單位和有效集水邊界，量測泵浦出流與集水井水位變化，以體積守恆互證。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instruction: 垃圾堵塞入口會讓理論管徑容量無法發揮；下游水位上升又可能使出口排量下降，僅加大泵浦不能解決所有原因。 排水堵塞改變有效出流，不能只用較大泵浦銘牌值補償。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Blocked inlets can prevent nominal pipe capacity from being used, while rising tailwater reduces outflow; a larger pump does not resolve every cause. steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「並聯備援與共同原因」如何影響新加坡湯申—東海岸線的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Parallel redundancy and common cause” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Singapore Thomson–East Coast Line”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 兩個獨立元件只要有一個成功即可服務時，系統失效機率等於兩者失效機率相乘。但共用電源、軟體或環境會破壞獨立假設，備援數量增加不能自動證明整體風險按平方下降。 獨立失效機率相乘只在共同原因可忽略時成立。共用機房、電源、時鐘或軟體缺陷會使冗餘失去預期效果；應把獨立事件與共同事件分成不同邏輯項。 辨認新增備援設備是否仍依賴同一機房或電源。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「並聯備援與共同原因」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: When either of two independent components can serve the demand, system failure probability is the product of their failure probabilities. Shared power, software or environment breaks independence. More redundant components therefore do not automatically prove a squared reduction in overall risk. Multiplying failure probabilities requires negligible common causes. Shared rooms, power, clocks or software defects can defeat expected redundancy. Represent independent events and common events as separate logical terms rather than silently combining them. Identify whether added backup equipment still depends on one equipment room or supply. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Parallel redundancy and common cause” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: q1=0.0204 1; q2=0.03 1; calculation: joint_failure=q1*q2=0.000612 1. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Parallel redundancy and common cause” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。 列出兩通道共用的實體與軟體資源，分開注入單路故障及共因故障，核對失效狀態。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：在獨立模型加入一個共同原因機率，對比結果，列出可用物理隔離與不同依賴路徑降低的風險。 再以本單元 q1 的對照值重算 joint_failure，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Add one common-cause probability to the independent model, compare the result, and identify risks reduced by physical separation and distinct dependencies. Also recalculate joint_failure for the alternative q1 value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

List physical and software resources shared by both channels, inject individual and common-cause faults separately, and verify resulting failure states.

quiz.question: 要驗證「並聯備援與共同原因」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Parallel redundancy and common cause"?
options: 畫出供電、網路、冷卻和軟體版本的依賴圖，逐一驗證切換功能；以故障注入確認另一通道可承接完整需求。

optionsEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand.

quiz.explanationEn: Map dependencies in power, networking, cooling and software versions, verify switching, and use fault injection to confirm the surviving channel can carry the full demand. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 並聯備援與共同原因：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Parallel redundancy and common cause: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「並聯備援與共同原因」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Parallel redundancy and common cause” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 兩個盒子不等於兩個獨立通道，須核對共用依賴。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：辨認新增備援設備是否仍依賴同一機房或電源。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Identify whether added backup equipment still depends on one equipment room or supply.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要設備數量變成兩台失效機率就必定平方降低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Doubling equipment count necessarily squares down the failure probability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Two boxes do not imply two independent channels; inspect their shared dependencies.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「並聯備援與共同原因」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Parallel redundancy and common cause" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。
施工窗口全長都可以直接乘以施工速度當成可完成量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over.
The entire possession duration can be multiplied by work rate to obtain achievable production.
quiz.explanation: 兩台設備接在同一配電盤可能被一次故障同時切斷；過載備援也可能在接手後立即失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Two devices on one distribution board can be lost together, and an undersized backup can fail immediately after taking over. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 利雅德地鐵
summary: 以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。
summaryEn: Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 air_rise=12.81095 K；單元 2 得 deposit=3.55968 kg；單元 3 得 fan_power=1502.083 W。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 heat 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.09204 K；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以利雅德地鐵分階段投入服務為背景，建立多路線與轉乘節點同時驗收的教學案例。學徒要把高溫冷房、砂塵維護、列車循環和轉乘容量放在共同需求情境，並以各路線分別啟用的狀態表檢查服務邊界。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives air_rise=12.81095 K; unit 2 gives deposit=3.55968 kg; unit 3 gives fan_power=1502.083 W. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing heat in the first unit changes its result to 14.09204 K. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use the staged launch of Riyadh Metro to construct a teaching case involving several lines and interchange nodes under acceptance. Place cooling in extreme heat, dust maintenance, fleet circulation and transfer capacity within one demand scenario. Use a state table for separately opened lines to check the service boundary instead of assuming all parts of a new network become available at the same moment. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升與砂塵沉積與清理週期
stages.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat & Dust deposition and cleaning interval
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「砂塵沉積與清理週期」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" and "Dust deposition and cleaning interval": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「通風散熱與設備溫升」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。 顯熱負載決定溫度改變需求，但高濕環境還有潛熱除濕與新風處理。冷卻量和耗電量也不同，兩者需要效率或性能係數連結，不能把熱量數字當作電表讀值。 對大型轉乘站的不同空間分別設定顯熱負載及外氣條件。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通風散熱與設備溫升」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature. Equipment rooms also contain recirculation and hot spots, so an average supply-to-exhaust difference does not guarantee identical conditions around every electronic module. Sensible load describes temperature-related demand, while humidity introduces latent dehumidification and outdoor-air treatment. Cooling delivered and electricity consumed are different quantities, connected through efficiency or a performance coefficient rather than treated as identical meter readings. Set sensible loads and outdoor-air conditions separately for different spaces in a large interchange. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「通風散熱與設備溫升」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升
knowledge.text: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。設備房還存在短路循環和局部熱點，平均送排風溫差不能保證所有電子模組都在同樣環境中。
knowledge.textEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. Insufficient flow raises exhaust temperature.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「通風散熱與設備溫升」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" is correct?
options: 風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。
防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降
optionsEn: Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise.
Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location.
quiz.explanation: 流動空氣帶走的顯熱與質量流率和溫升相乘，風量不足會提高排氣溫度。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Air removes sensible heat through mass flow and temperature rise. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通風散熱與設備溫升」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20394 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.09204 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18540 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.81095 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20394 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.09204 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型

steps.instruction: 沉積質量可由有效集塵面積、入射質量通量與時間估算，防砂構造改變局部風場也會改變沉積位置。清理週期應依累積量與功能影響決定，而不是把全年平均濃度當成每次沙塵事件。 沉積通量乘接收面積與時間得到積砂質量，通量已是單位面積的到達率。它不同於空氣中的濃度；要從濃度推回沉積，還需風速、粒徑及捕集機制。 用設備表面沉積通量與接收面積建立維修週期中的積砂質量。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「砂塵沉積與清理週期」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Deposited mass can be estimated from effective collection area, incident mass flux and time. Wind barriers alter local airflow and deposition location. Cleaning intervals should follow accumulation and functional impact rather than treating annual mean concentration as a description of every dust event. Deposition flux times receiving area and time gives accumulated sand mass. Flux is already an arrival rate per unit area and differs from airborne concentration. Deriving deposition from concentration also requires wind, particle size and a capture mechanism. Use surface deposition flux and receiving area to estimate sand mass over a maintenance interval. steps.instruction: 在不同高度和背風位置配置集塵盤，對照風速風向與設備故障紀錄，量出事件累積量而非只取單點濃度。 用已知面積收集盤在指定時間稱重，保留風向與取樣位置，並檢查再懸浮和散失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Place deposition trays at different heights and sheltered locations, correlate with wind and equipment records, and measure event accumulation rather than one concentration reading. stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Filter pressure drop and fan power" and "Transfer walking and connection margin": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「濾網壓差與通風功率」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Filter pressure drop and fan power” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 風機必須克服風道與濾網壓差才能輸送空氣，輸入功率近似為壓差乘體積流率再除效率。積塵提高阻力但工作點會沿風機曲線改變，因此固定風量假設只是一種受控比較。 風機功率等於壓力差乘體積流率再除以宣告效率，壓力與流量必須使用同一工作點。積塵使阻力和風機工作點共同改變，固定流量算例不能預測未控制風量時的耗電。 把濾材積塵造成的壓差與風機調速造成的壓差區分。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「濾網壓差與通風功率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency. Dust raises resistance but shifts the operating point on the fan curve, so fixed flow is only a controlled comparison. Fan power equals pressure difference times volume flow divided by the declared efficiency. Pressure and flow must refer to one operating point. Dust changes resistance and the fan operating point together, so a fixed-flow example cannot predict consumption without airflow control. Distinguish filter-loading pressure drop from pressure changes caused by fan-speed control. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Filter pressure drop and fan power” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「濾網壓差與通風功率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Filter pressure drop and fan power”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A fan must overcome duct and filter pressure losses to move air. Input power is approximately pressure rise times volume flow divided by efficiency.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「濾網壓差與通風功率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Filter pressure drop and fan power” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1；計算：fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W。敏感度：pressure 單獨增加百分之十至 396.55 Pa，其餘固定，結果為 1652.292 W。模型邊界：固定風量與總效率；不包含風機曲線移動和馬達熱限制。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: pressure=360.5 Pa; flow=2.5 m^3/s; eta=0.6 1; calculation: fan_power=pressure*flow/eta=1502.083 W. Sensitivity: pressure, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 396.55 Pa, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1652.292 W. Model boundary: Fixed flow and overall efficiency; fan-curve shifts and motor thermal limits are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「濾網壓差與通風功率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Filter pressure drop and fan power” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 校正取壓點與風量計，同步量測電功率，核對效率是否包含馬達與驅動器損失。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Calibrate pressure taps and airflow measurement, record electric power simultaneously, and check whether efficiency includes motor and drive losses.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 對堵塞與旁路兩個情境列出壓差、風量和粒子濃度的預期方向，設計三項量測共同判斷而非只靠單一數字。 再以本單元 pressure 的對照值重算 fan_power，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Predict pressure drop, airflow and particle concentration for clogging and bypass scenarios, then design a three-measurement diagnosis instead of relying on one number. Also recalculate fan_power for the alternative pressure value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「濾網壓差與通風功率」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Filter pressure drop and fan power"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。
設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。
optionsEn: A single reading or a visual impression is enough to accept the work; no datum, reference specimen or repeat measurement is needed.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing.
quiz.explanation: 同時量濾網前後壓差、實際風量和電功率，用乾淨濾網建立基準，並記錄沙塵、濕度與維修時間。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Measure differential pressure, actual flow and input power together, establish a clean-filter baseline, and record dust exposure, humidity and maintenance timing. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 濾網壓差與通風功率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Filter pressure drop and fan power: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「濾網壓差與通風功率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Filter pressure drop and fan power” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 壓差很低也可能是旁通，須核對濾材密封及實際風量。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. Very low pressure drop can indicate bypass; check filter sealing and actual airflow. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把濾材積塵造成的壓差與風機調速造成的壓差區分。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distinguish filter-loading pressure drop from pressure changes caused by fan-speed control.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「濾網壓差越低就一定表示過濾狀況越好」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Lower filter pressure drop always means better filtration condition." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 壓差很低也可能是旁通，須核對濾材密封及實際風量。
knowledge.textEn: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. Very low pressure drop can indicate bypass; check filter sealing and actual airflow.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「濾網壓差與通風功率」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Filter pressure drop and fan power" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。
裂縫或異常只出現一次就可以忽略，不需要記錄或追蹤。
轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
optionsEn: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal.
A crack or anomaly that appears only once can be ignored without logging or follow-up.
The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
quiz.explanation: 旁路漏氣可能讓壓差降低但過濾品質變差；只以壓差低判定良好，會忽略濾網破損和密封失效。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Bypass leakage may lower pressure drop while worsening filtration; a low drop alone can therefore hide a damaged filter or failed seal. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Transfer walking and connection margin” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。 距離除速度只表示行走或移動時間，等待列車、排隊和辨識路徑應另列。使用單一平均速度會掩蓋行李、行動能力和雙向干擾，應以分段分群資料檢查。 在多路線尚未全開時重算可用轉乘路徑和等待時間。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting. Accessible routes need their own timing rather than an assumed common walking speed. Distance divided by speed represents movement only; train waiting, queueing and wayfinding need separate terms. One mean speed hides baggage, mobility differences and opposing flow. Check the result with segmented measurements for relevant passenger groups. Recalculate available transfer paths and waiting times while some lines remain unopened. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Transfer walking and connection margin” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Transfer walking and connection margin”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕
knowledge.text: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。最短路徑不一定最快，因為樓梯、閘門與人流交會造成等待；無障礙路徑需要獨立列出而非套用同一速度。
knowledge.textEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The shortest route is not always fastest because stairs, gates and crossing streams cause waiting.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Transfer walking and connection margin" is correct?
options: 轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接
轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。
只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
optionsEn: The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection.
A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
quiz.explanation: 轉乘能否銜接取決於實際可用時間扣除下車、步行、垂直動線與候車需求。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A connection depends on available time after alighting, walking, vertical circulation and boarding needs. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Transfer walking and connection margin” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 203.94 m，其餘固定，結果為 51.06 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s; calculation: margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s. Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 203.94 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 51.06 s. Model boundary: Fixed walking speed and additional time; dynamic queues and individual variability distributions are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：available=300 s; distance=185.4 m; speed=1 m/s; vertical=45 s；計算：margin=available-distance/speed-vertical=69.6 s。敏感度：distance 單獨增加百分之十至 203.94 m，其餘固定，結果為 51.06 s。模型邊界：固定步速與額外時間；不包含動態排隊或旅客個別差異分布。

Sensitivity: distance, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 203.94 m, with all other inputs fixed, gives 51.06 s. knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.
