steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Transfer walking and connection margin” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 在路徑起終點對時，逐段記錄水平、垂直與等待時間，核對是否漏計驗票或排隊。
knowledge.textEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Synchronise route endpoints, record horizontal movement, vertical movement and waiting separately, and check for omitted gate processing or queues.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較一般與無障礙兩條路徑的餘裕，加入一台電梯停機情境，說明時刻表調整與空間導引分別能改善哪一段。 再以本單元 distance 的對照值重算 margin，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare connection margins for ordinary and accessible routes, add one unavailable lift, and distinguish improvements from timetable changes versus spatial guidance. Also recalculate margin for the alternative distance value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Transfer walking and connection margin"?
options: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
optionsEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
quiz.explanation: 以匿名實測旅程時間分位數比較路徑，記錄電梯等待及閘門排隊，檢查轉乘圖的距離是否包含所有垂直動線。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Compare route-time quantiles from anonymous observations, record lift and gate waits, and check that route distances include every vertical circulation segment. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 轉乘步行與銜接餘裕：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Transfer walking and connection margin: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Transfer walking and connection margin” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：在多路線尚未全開時重算可用轉乘路徑和等待時間。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Recalculate available transfer paths and waiting times while some lines remain unopened.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「轉乘路線距離最短就一定適合所有旅客最快銜接」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "The shortest transfer route necessarily gives every passenger the fastest connection." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 旅客走錯路會改變實際距離，需比較引導前後的路徑。
knowledge.textEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Wrong turns change actual distance; compare observed routes before and after guidance changes.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「轉乘步行與銜接餘裕」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Transfer walking and connection margin" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。
只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route.
Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
quiz.explanation: 只用最快步行者校準會低估多數人的轉乘時間；電梯停機又可能使唯一無障礙路徑失去連續性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Calibrating to the fastest walkers understates many passengers’ transfer time; a failed lift can also break the only continuous accessible route. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆與周轉時間與車隊需求
stages.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation & Round-trip time and fleet size
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「月台暫存與隊列守恆」與「周轉時間與車隊需求」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Platform storage and queue conservation" and "Round-trip time and fleet size": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Platform storage and queue conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。 密度是人數除以有效面積，不直接描述人群流速或推擠力。設備、柱子及候車線會減少可用空間；安全通道應另列，不能為了降低平均密度而計入不可占用區域。 以分階段開放的出口數檢查有效候車與通行面積。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「月台暫存與隊列守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity. Usable area excludes stairs, equipment and safety strips. Density describes an average state but does not alone represent dynamic pedestrian risk. Density divides occupancy by usable area but does not directly describe walking speed or crowd pressure. Equipment, columns and waiting boundaries reduce usable space. Reserved circulation must be accounted separately, not included merely to lower the reported average density. Check effective waiting and circulation area under a staged number of open exits. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Platform storage and queue conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Platform storage and queue conservation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆
knowledge.text: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。可用面積應扣除樓梯口、設備與安全帶；密度只能描述平均狀態，不能單獨代表行人動態風險。
knowledge.textEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. A short surge can grow a queue despite sufficient daily capacity.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「月台暫存與隊列守恆」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Platform storage and queue conservation" is correct?
options: 只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞
車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定
月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。
optionsEn: Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits.
quiz.explanation: 月台人數是進入、登車與離開人數的累積差，短時尖峰會使隊列成長，即使全天總運能足夠。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Platform population accumulates from arrivals minus boarding and exits. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Platform storage and queue conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 477至 477 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.362857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 477, to 477 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.362857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。敏感度：people 將整數計數增加到 477至 477 persons，其餘固定，結果為 1.362857 persons/m^2。模型邊界：均勻平均密度；未含局部擠壓、行李和對向人流。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2. Sensitivity: people, increase the integer count to 477, to 477 persons, with all other inputs fixed, gives 1.362857 persons/m^2. Model boundary: Uniform average density; local compression, luggage and opposing streams are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Platform storage and queue conservation", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2。
平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
optionsEn: Original hypothetical exercise.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2；計算：density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: people=433 persons; usable_area=350 m^2; calculation: density=people/usable_area=1.237143 persons/m^2. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「月台暫存與隊列守恆」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Platform storage and queue conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 以分區影片計數核對總人數，量測淨面積，並同時記錄局部瓶頸及進出流量。
knowledge.textEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Cross-check total occupancy with zonal video counts, measure net area, and record local bottlenecks and entry-exit flows simultaneously.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 模擬一列取消後兩個班距內的人數變化，扣除不能站立的面積，提出分流措施並比較它們改變的是流量還是暫存容量。 再以本單元 people 的對照值重算 density，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Simulate population for two headways after one cancellation, subtract unusable area, and compare whether proposed controls change flow rate or storage capacity. Also recalculate density for the alternative people value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「月台暫存與隊列守恆」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Platform storage and queue conservation"?
options: 允收準則可以等看到量測數據後再決定。
用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。
防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降
optionsEn: Acceptance criteria can be decided after the measured data have been seen.
Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow.
Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location.
quiz.explanation: 用匿名計數器核對入口、出口與登車量，分區觀察月台密度，保留列車延誤時間以辨認隊列成長來源。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Reconcile anonymous counts at entrances, exits and train doors, observe density by zone, and retain train-delay times to identify why queues grow. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 月台暫存與隊列守恆：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Platform storage and queue conservation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「月台暫存與隊列守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Platform storage and queue conservation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Low overall mean density can coexist with local crowding; inspect doorway and stair zones. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：以分階段開放的出口數檢查有效候車與通行面積。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Check effective waiting and circulation area under a staged number of open exits.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「只要月台平均密度低就不會在任何局部出現壅塞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Low average platform density prevents congestion at every local point." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 總平均密度低仍可能局部壅塞，須查看門口與樓梯區域。

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「月台暫存與隊列守恆」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Platform storage and queue conservation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。

平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing.
quiz.explanation: 平均密度低仍可能在樓梯出口形成局部瓶頸；計數器漏記同行群體也會使守恆帳不閉合。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A low mean density can coexist with a bottleneck at a stair exit; missed group entries can also prevent the passenger balance from closing. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「周轉時間與車隊需求」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Round-trip time and fleet size” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 維持固定班距所需列車數取決於完整周轉時間除班距並向上取整，周轉包含兩端折返與停站。備用車和維修車需另列；只用單程行車時間會把車隊需求低估接近一半。 循環時間除以班距後必須向上取整，半列車不能提供完整班次。此數量是投入循環的最低值，維修備用、延誤緩衝與不同分支運轉仍需額外配置。 按每條線完整循環估算車數，再辨認共用備援的限制。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「周轉時間與車隊需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fleet requirement for fixed headway is round-trip cycle time divided by headway, rounded upward. The cycle includes terminal turnbacks and stops. Spares and maintenance vehicles are additional; using only one-way running time can underestimate the requirement by nearly half. Divide cycle time by headway and round upward because a fraction of a train cannot provide a full departure. This is the minimum circulating requirement; maintenance spares, delay buffers and branch-specific operation need additional allocation. Estimate fleet size from each line’s complete cycle and identify limits of shared spares. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Round-trip time and fleet size” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「周轉時間與車隊需求」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Round-trip time and fleet size”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「周轉時間與車隊需求」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Round-trip time and fleet size” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6118.2 s，其餘固定，結果為 34 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6118.2 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 34 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s；計算：fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains。敏感度：cycle 單獨增加百分之十至 6118.2 s，其餘固定，結果為 34 trains。模型邊界：固定周轉與班距、無延誤；不含備用率和維修排程。
knowledge.textEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: cycle=5562 s; headway=180 s; calculation: fleet=ceil(cycle/headway)=31 trains. Sensitivity: cycle, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 6118.2 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 34 trains. Model boundary: Fixed cycle and headway without delays; reserve ratio and maintenance scheduling are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 周轉時間與車隊需求：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Round-trip time and fleet size: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「周轉時間與車隊需求」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Round-trip time and fleet size” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 逐列串接實際到發時間檢查周轉，將折返與等待分開，並對尖峰班距需求與可出車數建立同一時點的清單。 核對往返與折返時間使用同一單位，以逐列時刻表重播，檢查每次發車是否有車可用。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Join actual arrival and departure logs by train, separate turnback from waiting, and compare peak headway requirements with trains available at the same time. Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：增加一端折返時間後重算車隊，檢查向上取整造成的跳變，再提出維修備用與臨時故障應如何另列。 再以本單元 cycle 的對照值重算 fleet，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase one terminal turnback time, recalculate fleet and examine rounding jumps, then explain separate allowances for maintenance reserve and unexpected failures. Also recalculate fleet for the alternative cycle value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

Verify consistent units for round-trip and turnaround times, replay a train-by-train timetable, and check vehicle availability at every departure.

A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：按每條線完整循環估算車數，再辨認共用備援的限制。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Estimate fleet size from each line’s complete cycle and identify limits of shared spares.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「車隊需求可以只用單程時間除以班距決定」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fleet requirement can be determined using one-way time divided by headway alone." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 列車數足夠仍可能因機廠出入路徑受限而無法準時上線；忽略維修週期則會讓紙上車隊數不可持續。 循環時間稍增可能跨過整數門檻，不能只比較百分比。
knowledge.textEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. A small cycle-time increase can cross an integer fleet threshold; percentages alone are insufficient.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「周轉時間與車隊需求」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

optionsEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable.
As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.

quiz.explanationEn: Sufficient fleet count may still fail when depot access restricts insertion; ignoring maintenance cycles makes the paper fleet unsustainable. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證與通訊延遲與位置陳舊量
stages.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification & Communication delay and stale position
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「互斥進路與真值驗證」與「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" and "Communication delay and stale position": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「互斥進路與真值驗證」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。 布林組合數表示測試狀態空間的大小，並不代表每個狀態在現場都可達或安全。應把占用、道岔鎖閉和授權的邏輯關係明列，逐項證明危險組合會被拒絕。 在試運轉和載客區段之間建立不可同時成立的進路。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「互斥進路與真值驗證」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions. Boolean input combinations grow rapidly; a truth table checks logical coverage but does not replace timing analysis or hardware fault assessment. The Boolean count describes the size of a test state space, not that every state is reachable or safe in service. Explicitly state relations among occupation, point locking and authority, and demonstrate that hazardous combinations are rejected. Build mutually exclusive routes between testing and passenger-service sections. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「互斥進路與真值驗證」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證
knowledge.text: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。狀態數隨布林輸入快速增加，真值表可檢查邏輯完整性，但不能代替時序與硬體故障分析。
knowledge.textEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. Occupancy, locked points and complete train passage jointly determine permissive conditions.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「互斥進路與真值驗證」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification" is correct?
options: 聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。
平均網路延遲很低就足以證明所有控制訊息都及時到達
optionsEn: Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes.
A low average network delay proves that every control message arrives on time.
quiz.explanation: 聯鎖的核心是明確禁止衝突進路同時成立，安全條件需要由占用、道岔鎖閉和列車完整通過共同決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Interlocking explicitly excludes simultaneous conflicting routes. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「互斥進路與真值驗證」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：inputs=7 Boolean inputs；計算：combinations=2**inputs=128 states。敏感度：inputs 增加 1 個布林輸入至 8 Boolean inputs，其餘固定，結果為 256 states。模型邊界：有限個獨立二值輸入的完整枚舉；不代表實際聯鎖軟體測試已完成。

Sensitivity: inputs, add one Boolean input, to 8 Boolean inputs, with all other inputs fixed, gives 256 states. Model boundary: Complete enumeration of independent binary inputs; not a claim that real interlocking software has been tested.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「互斥進路與真值驗證」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Conflicting routes and truth-table verification", which statement holds?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
防風牆一旦設置就必定讓所有位置的砂塵沉積同時下降

Installing a wind barrier necessarily reduces dust deposition at every location.
Original hypothetical exercise.

quiz.explanationEn: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: inputs=7 Boolean inputs; calculation: combinations=2**inputs=128 states. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 互斥進路與真值驗證：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Conflicting routes and truth-table verification: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「互斥進路與真值驗證」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Conflicting routes and truth-table verification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 把每個允許輸出對應到必要條件，逐項加入反例測試；再檢查占用訊號失效或道岔未鎖閉時是否回到禁止狀態。 從真值表逐列執行故障注入，記錄預期拒絕與實際輸出，並覆核非法狀態不可授權。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Map every permissive output to its necessary conditions, add counterexample tests, and check that occupancy failure or unlocked points leads to a restrictive state. Execute fault injection row by row from the truth table, recording expected refusal and actual output, and verify that illegal states receive no authority. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：為兩條衝突進路建立真值表，標記禁止組合，再加入先占用後解鎖的事件序列，說明組合邏輯和時序邏輯的差異。 再以本單元 inputs 的對照值重算 combinations，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Build a truth table for two conflicting routes, mark forbidden combinations, then add occupancy and release event sequences to distinguish combinational from temporal logic. Also recalculate combinations for the alternative inputs value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測正常進路順序會漏掉同時請求和殘留狀態；感測器卡在允許值也可能使紙上正確的邏輯收到錯誤輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the normal route sequence misses simultaneous requests and residual states; a sensor stuck permissive can feed wrong inputs to otherwise correct logic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法

steps.instruction: 移動列車在訊息傳遞期間繼續前進，最簡單的陳舊位置上界是速度乘延遲。封包延遲、遺失與時鐘偏差應分開，平均延遲不能代表最壞情況，也不能直接替代列車保護的安全論證。 傳輸時間不是訊息年齡的全部，排隊、重送及接收端處理也可能占主要比例。安全邏輯應明確定義逾時後的狀態；成功收到舊封包不能當成最新授權。 檢查多路線資料交換的封包時效，不把收到訊息當成許可。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A moving train advances while a message is in transit. Speed times delay gives the simplest stale-position bound. Packet delay, loss and clock bias must be separated; mean latency neither represents a worst case nor replaces a safety argument for train protection. Transmission time is not the entire message age; queueing, retransmission and receiver processing may dominate. Safety logic needs an explicit state after timeout. Successful receipt of an old packet is not equivalent to a fresh movement authority. Check packet freshness in inter-line data exchange rather than treating receipt as permission. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Communication delay and stale position” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Communication delay and stale position” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s；計算：stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m。敏感度：latency 單獨增加百分之十至 0.3399 s，其餘固定，結果為 8.4975 m。模型邊界：固定速度且單次訊息延遲；未含加速度、連續遺失及協定重試。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: v=25 m/s; latency=0.309 s; calculation: stale_distance=v*latency=7.725 m. Sensitivity: latency, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 0.3399 s, with all other inputs fixed, gives 8.4975 m. Model boundary: Constant speed and one delayed message; acceleration, consecutive losses and protocol retries are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 通訊延遲與位置陳舊量：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「通訊延遲與位置陳舊量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Communication delay and stale position” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 以送出和接收兩端的同步時間戳量延遲分布，注入延遲及封包遺失，確認過期訊息被辨識而非繼續當成即時位置。 以發送與接收端同步時鐘核對端到端延遲，記錄重送次數、封包遺失及最長連續中斷。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure latency distribution using synchronised transmit and receive timestamps, inject delay and packet loss, and confirm stale messages are identified rather than treated as current position. Use synchronised sender and receiver clocks to check end-to-end delay, recording retries, packet loss and the longest continuous interruption. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：把速度與延遲各提高一成，比較位置陳舊量；設計含連續遺失的重播案例，列出接收端需要保留的時間與序號資訊。 再以本單元 latency 的對照值重算 stale_distance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase speed and delay separately, compare stale distance, and design a replay with consecutive losses listing the timestamps and sequence information required at the receiver. Also recalculate stale_distance for the alternative latency value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：時鐘漂移可能讓過期訊息被誤判為新資料；只測低負載網路會漏掉交接區、干擾和突發流量造成的延遲尾端。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Clock drift can make stale data appear fresh; low-load tests miss latency tails caused by handover, interference and burst traffic. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「備援電池與可維持時間」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Backup battery endurance” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 備援電池可供負載使用的能量由額定容量、允許放電深度和轉換效率相乘，除負載功率得到理想時間。低溫、老化及啟動電流會縮短可用時間；額定安時也不能直接當成瓦時。 可用電量應扣除允許放電深度與轉換損失，負載也可能隨時間變化。銘牌容量的測試溫度和放電倍率會影響實際結果，續航計算不能取代受控放電驗證。 把高溫下緊急照明和通訊耗電分別納入備援估算。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「備援電池與可維持時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Usable backup energy combines rated energy, permitted discharge fraction and conversion efficiency. Dividing by load gives ideal endurance. Cold temperature, ageing and start-up current can shorten it; an ampere-hour rating must not be mistaken directly for watt-hours. Usable energy must account for permitted discharge depth and conversion losses, while load may vary over time. Test temperature and discharge rate influence rated capacity, so an endurance calculation cannot replace controlled discharge verification. Include emergency lighting and communication consumption separately in hot-condition backup estimates. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Backup battery endurance” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「備援電池與可維持時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Backup battery endurance”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「備援電池與可維持時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Backup battery endurance” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW；計算：endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h。敏感度：energy 單獨增加百分之十至 22.66 kWh，其餘固定，結果為 4.0788 h。模型邊界：固定負載與額定能量；不含電池倍率效應、溫度與容量衰退。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: energy=20.6 kWh; usable=0.8 1; eta=0.9 1; load=4 kW; calculation: endurance=energy*usable*eta/load=3.708 h. Sensitivity: energy, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 22.66 kWh, with all other inputs fixed, gives 4.0788 h. Model boundary: Constant load and nominal energy; rate effects, temperature and capacity degradation are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「備援電池與可維持時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Backup battery endurance” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 定期以已知負載做受控放電，量端電壓、電流及溫度，核對控制器切離點與真正可用能量。 以受控負載記錄電池電壓、電流與溫度，積分可用電量，核對低壓切斷時刻。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Perform controlled discharges into a known load, measure voltage, current and temperature, and compare controller cutoff with actually delivered energy. Record battery voltage, current and temperature under controlled load, integrate usable energy, and verify the low-voltage cut-off time. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：將負載增加一成並把可用容量降為老化假設值，重新計算時間，提出量測端電壓以外必須保留的證據。 再以本單元 energy 的對照值重算 endurance，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Increase load and reduce usable capacity for an ageing case, recalculate endurance, and identify evidence required beyond terminal-voltage readings. Also recalculate endurance for the alternative energy value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Backup battery endurance"?
options: 只看一次讀值或外觀即可判定合格，不需要基準點、參考試體或重複量測。

steps.title: 備援電池與可維持時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Backup battery endurance: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「備援電池與可維持時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Backup battery endurance” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 老化電池可能有正常開路電壓卻無法承受負載；共用充電器故障也可能同時耗盡兩組名義備援。 電池電壓正常不代表容量足夠，需檢查負載下放電曲線。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An aged battery may show normal open-circuit voltage yet fail under load; a shared charger fault can also deplete two nominally redundant banks. Normal open-circuit voltage does not prove sufficient capacity; inspect the loaded discharge curve. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：把高溫下緊急照明和通訊耗電分別納入備援估算。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Include emergency lighting and communication consumption separately in hot-condition backup estimates.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「備援電池開路電壓正常就能保證額定支援時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Normal open-circuit battery voltage guarantees the rated backup duration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「可用度與修復時間」如何影響利雅德地鐵的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Availability and repair time” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Riyadh Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。 平均故障間隔和平均修復時間必須使用相同服務邊界；備件等待與到場時間若被排除，數字就不能描述旅客看到的中斷。短期樣本也應報告事件數與觀測時間。 用逐線停機紀錄計算可用性，避免網路平均掩蓋單線中斷。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「可用度與修復時間」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved. Spares, travel and diagnosis all affect actual restoration time. Mean time between failures and mean repair time require a common service boundary. Excluding spare-part waiting or travel time prevents the figure from describing passenger-visible interruption. Short samples should also report event count and observation duration. Calculate availability from line-specific outages instead of hiding one line’s failure in a network average. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Availability and repair time” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1236 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967742 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1236 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967742 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「可用度與修復時間」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Availability and repair time”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 可用度與修復時間
knowledge.text: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。這個指標不能替代安全性，因為快速恢復服務可能仍保留危險失效；備品、交通與診斷都會影響實際修復時間。
knowledge.textEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. It does not replace safety: rapidly restoring service may leave a hazardous failure unresolved.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Availability and repair time" is correct?
options: 設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低
在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。
風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
optionsEn: High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low.
In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time.
Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
quiz.explanation: 在簡化更新過程中，可用度是平均故障間隔占故障間隔加修復時間的比例。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: In a simplified renewal process, availability is mean time between failures divided by that time plus mean repair time. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「可用度與修復時間」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Availability and repair time” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：mtbf=1236 h; mttr=4 h；計算：availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967742 1。敏感度：mtbf 單獨增加百分之十至 1359.6 h，其餘固定，結果為 0.9970666 1。模型邊界：兩狀態穩態平均模型；不含計畫維修、共同原因與降級服務品質。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: mtbf=1236 h; mttr=4 h; calculation: availability=mtbf/(mtbf+mttr)=0.9967742 1. Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1359.6 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970666 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Sensitivity: mtbf, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 1359.6 h, with all other inputs fixed, gives 0.9970666 1. Model boundary: Two-state steady-state mean model; planned maintenance, common causes and degraded service quality are excluded.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「可用度與修復時間」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Availability and repair time” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 逐項對照故障開始、服務恢復與維修完成時間，公開排除項，並核對總觀測時數。
knowledge.textEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Cross-check fault start, service restoration and repair completion for each event, disclose exclusions, and verify total observed hours.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 比較提高故障間隔與縮短修復時間兩種措施，用同一故障定義重算，並列出可用度之外需要追蹤的危險失效指標。 再以本單元 mtbf 的對照值重算 availability，提交含單位、輸入來源和模型不適用條件的結果表。
knowledge.textEn: Compare increasing failure interval with reducing repair time under one failure definition, and list hazardous-failure measures that must be tracked separately from availability. Also recalculate availability for the alternative mtbf value in this unit, submitting units, input provenance and conditions under which the model is inapplicable.

quiz.question: 要驗證「可用度與修復時間」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Availability and repair time"?
options: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
聯鎖只要正常路徑通過測試就不需要檢查衝突請求
optionsEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
Passing normal route tests removes the need to test conflicting requests.
quiz.explanation: 將故障開始、到場、診斷、修復及恢復服務分段記錄，明確定義可用狀態，避免把降級運轉與完整服務混算。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Record failure onset, arrival, diagnosis, repair and service restoration separately, define the available state, and avoid mixing degraded operation with full service. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 可用度與修復時間：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Availability and repair time: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「可用度與修復時間」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Availability and repair time” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：用逐線停機紀錄計算可用性，避免網路平均掩蓋單線中斷。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Calculate availability from line-specific outages instead of hiding one line’s failure in a network average.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「設備可用度高就表示所有安全風險一定很低」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "High equipment availability necessarily means every safety risk is low." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 修好設備和恢復服務可能不同時，須分別記錄終點。
knowledge.textEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Equipment repair and service restoration may occur at different times; record both endpoints.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「可用度與修復時間」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Availability and repair time" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。
風機轉速正常就能保證機櫃內每個設備都有足夠散熱
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable.
Normal fan speed guarantees adequate cooling for every device in the cabinet.
quiz.explanation: 只縮短更換時間但備品仍缺貨，可用度未必改善；將延後報修時間排除也會讓數字看似漂亮卻失去代表性。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Shorter replacement time may not improve availability when spare parts remain unavailable; excluding reporting delays can also create an unrepresentative figure. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 多哈地鐵
summary: 以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。
summaryEn: Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 整合原創算例：單元 1 得 air_rise=12.93532 K；單元 2 得 fan_power=1516.667 W；單元 3 得 capacity=17307.69 persons/hour。上述三個結果使用各單元明示的不同邊界，不能任意相加或視為實際工程實測值。以第一單元 heat 的擾動測試，結果改為 14.22886 K；學徒需先比較單位、敏感度和假設，再決定是否要細化模型。以多哈地鐵為背景，建立高溫潮濕環境與活動散場旅客同時出現的教學案例。學徒從空調、濾材與供電負載追蹤到月台隊列、車門和自動行車，區分日常平均需求與短時大量到達所需的控制措施。 最終交付應保留原始輸入、測點時間戳、誤差範圍與無法由簡化式證明的結論。
workedExample.textEn: Integrated original exercise: unit 1 gives air_rise=12.93532 K; unit 2 gives fan_power=1516.667 W; unit 3 gives capacity=17307.69 persons/hour. These three results use different explicit boundaries and must not be added or presented as measurements of the real railway. Perturbing heat in the first unit changes its result to 14.22886 K. Compare units, sensitivity and assumptions before deciding which model needs refinement. Use Doha Metro to construct a teaching case combining a hot humid environment with a large post-event passenger release. Trace cooling, filters and power demand into platform queues, doors and automated movement. Distinguish normal mean demand from short-duration batch arrivals, and require measurable control actions instead of treating advertised frequency as evidence that every crowd can be absorbed immediately. The final submission should retain original inputs, measurement timestamps, uncertainty ranges and conclusions that the simplified expressions cannot establish.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升與濾網壓差與通風功率
stages.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat & Filter pressure drop and fan power
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「通風散熱與設備溫升」與「濾網壓差與通風功率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ventilation cooling and equipment heat" and "Filter pressure drop and fan power": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 通風散熱與設備溫升：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ventilation cooling and equipment heat: mechanism and system paths

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ventilation cooling and equipment heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Doha Metro”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，全部輸入均非本工程操作參數：heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s；計算：air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K。敏感度：heat 單獨增加百分之十至 20592 W，其餘固定，結果為 14.22886 K。模型邊界：穩態顯熱且混合均勻；不含潛熱、輻射與空調循環效率。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original hypothetical exercise; none of these inputs are operating parameters of this project: heat=18720 W; density=1.2 kg/m^3; cp=1005 J/(kg*K); flow=1.2 m^3/s; calculation: air_rise=heat/(density*cp*flow)=12.93532 K. Sensitivity: heat, increase this input alone by ten percent, to 20592 W, with all other inputs fixed, gives 14.22886 K. Model boundary: Steady sensible heat and uniform mixing; latent heat, radiation and refrigeration-cycle efficiency are excluded. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.

steps.instruction: 同時量送風量、進出口溫度和設備用電，沿機櫃高度布置測點，確認冷風沒有直接繞過設備流回出口。 同步量測進出風溫度、流量和耗電，另記濕度與新風比例，確認顯熱邊界一致。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Measure supply flow, inlet and outlet temperatures and electrical load together, instrument cabinet height, and check that cold air does not bypass the equipment.
