steps.title: 試件平均強度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Specimen mean strength: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「試件平均強度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Specimen mean strength” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 不具代表性的取樣會使漂亮平均值失去意義。這個失效與「試件平均強度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查取樣位置與試件破壞型態，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrepresentative sampling makes an attractive average uninformative. This failure and a measurement bias in Specimen mean strength can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check sampling locations and specimen failure modes rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用取樣位置與試件破壞型態作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不具代表性的取樣會使漂亮平均值失去意義，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unrepresentative sampling makes an attractive average uninformative; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不具代表性的取樣會使漂亮平均值失去意義」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrepresentative sampling makes an attractive average uninformative." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: 預鑄軌道板精調
titleEn: Precision alignment of precast track slabs
summary: 預鑄軌道板精調以「多點測量調整閉合與誤差傳播」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。軌道板精調把控制網、板體剛體位姿與扣件調整串接；若控制點與板上測點的座標基準不一致，精密讀值仍會導致錯誤的實際位置。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops multi-point survey adjustment closure and uncertainty propagation through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Slab alignment connects a control network, rigid-body pose and fastening adjustment; precision readings still give the wrong physical position when control and slab coordinates use different datums. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=3 mm, dy=4 mm；y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=5 mm。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=5.18556 mm。模型邊界：二維歐氏距離，不包含座標基準誤差；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dy=2 mm, L=5 m；y=dy/(L*1000)*1000=0.4 mrad。只把 dy 增加百分之十，y=0.44 mrad。模型邊界：小角度剛體偏轉，不含板體彎曲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=3 mm, dy=4 mm; y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=5 mm. Increasing only dx with a ten-percent increase gives y=5.18556 mm. Boundary: Two-dimensional Euclidean distance excluding datum error; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: dy=2 mm, L=5 m; y=dy/(L*1000)*1000=0.4 mrad. Increasing only dy with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.44 mrad. Boundary: Small-angle rigid yaw excluding slab bending; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 平移偏差合成與板端偏轉估算
stages.titleEn: Translation-error magnitude & Slab yaw from endpoint offsets
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「平移偏差合成」與「板端偏轉估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Translation-error magnitude" and "Slab yaw from endpoint offsets": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 平移偏差合成：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Translation-error magnitude: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「平移偏差合成」如何影響預鑄軌道板精調的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Translation-error magnitude” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Precision alignment of precast track slabs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平面偏差是向量，兩方向符號決定修正方向而長度描述誤差量級。本模型把 dx 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 5.18556 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。二維歐氏距離，不包含座標基準誤差。使用東北向殘差與控制點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只看誤差長度而丟失方向會使調整走錯方向，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「平移偏差合成」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Plan error is a vector: component signs define correction direction while magnitude describes scale. In this model, dx is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 5.18556 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Two-dimensional Euclidean distance excluding datum error. Use east-north residuals and control points as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Discarding direction while retaining magnitude can reverse an adjustment; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Translation-error magnitude” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=3 mm, dy=4 mm；y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=3 mm, dy=4 mm; y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只看誤差長度而丟失方向會使調整走錯方向」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Discarding direction while retaining magnitude can reverse an adjustment." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「平移偏差合成」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Translation-error magnitude”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 平移偏差合成
knowledge.text: 平面偏差是向量，兩方向符號決定修正方向而長度描述誤差量級。本模型把 dx 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 5.18556 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Plan error is a vector: component signs define correction direction while magnitude describes scale. In this model, dx is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只看誤差長度而丟失方向會使調整走錯方向 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Discarding direction while retaining magnitude can reverse an adjustment. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Slab yaw from endpoint offsets” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dy=2 mm, L=5 m；y=dy/(L*1000)*1000=0.4 mrad。只把 dy 增加百分之十，y=0.44 mrad。模型邊界：小角度剛體偏轉，不含板體彎曲；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dy=2 mm, L=5 m; y=dy/(L*1000)*1000=0.4 mrad. Increasing only dy with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.44 mrad. Boundary: Small-angle rigid yaw excluding slab bending; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以前後測點橫向差區分模型與觀察，先用板前後棱鏡橫向座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以前後測點橫向差區分模型與觀察，先用板前後棱鏡橫向座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「板端偏轉估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use lateral difference between front and rear targets to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using lateral coordinates of front and rear slab prisms, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Slab yaw from endpoint offsets. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「板端偏轉估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出小角度剛體偏轉，不含板體彎曲如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化造成偏離的合成觀察，以前後測點橫向差說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Slab yaw from endpoint offsets, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Small-angle rigid yaw excluding slab bending. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other. Explain which evidence in lateral difference between front and rear targets distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 板端偏轉估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slab yaw from endpoint offsets: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「板端偏轉估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab yaw from endpoint offsets” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化。這個失效與「板端偏轉估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查前後測點橫向差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other. This failure and a measurement bias in Slab yaw from endpoint offsets can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check lateral difference between front and rear targets rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用前後測點橫向差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平移與轉角未分離會讓一端修正另一端惡化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Confusing translation with rotation improves one end while worsening the other." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 板體俯仰估算：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 縱向高差形成俯仰，應先扣除設計縱坡再判斷誤差。本模型把 dz 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.33 mrad。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已扣設計縱坡的小角度俯仰。使用設計高程與實測高程差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把設計坡度當板體誤差會破壞路線縱面，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「板體俯仰估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Longitudinal level difference produces pitch; subtract the design gradient before identifying error. In this model, dz is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.33 mrad. Treating design gradient as slab error damages the vertical alignment; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Slab pitch estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=1.5 mm, L=5 m；y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad。只把 dz 增加百分之十，y=0.33 mrad。模型邊界：已扣設計縱坡的小角度俯仰；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=1.5 mm, L=5 m; y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad. Increasing only dz with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.33 mrad. Boundary: Small-angle pitch after subtracting design gradient; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以設計高程與實測高程差區分模型與觀察，先用板兩端水準與設計高程建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以設計高程與實測高程差區分模型與觀察，先用板兩端水準與設計高程建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「板體俯仰估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use differences between design and measured levels to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 板體俯仰估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Slab pitch estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「板體俯仰估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Slab pitch estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把設計坡度當板體誤差會破壞路線縱面。這個失效與「板體俯仰估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查設計高程與實測高程差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating design gradient as slab error damages the vertical alignment. This failure and a measurement bias in Slab pitch estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check differences between design and measured levels rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用設計高程與實測高程差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把設計坡度當板體誤差會破壞路線縱面，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating design gradient as slab error damages the vertical alignment; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把設計坡度當板體誤差會破壞路線縱面」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating design gradient as slab error damages the vertical alignment." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 調整螺距位移：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Adjustment screw displacement: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「調整螺距位移」如何影響預鑄軌道板精調的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Adjustment screw displacement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Precision alignment of precast track slabs”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 螺距與轉角決定位移，但間隙與受力回彈使實際變化需回測。本模型把 pitch 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.77 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。理想螺距且無間隙或受力回彈。使用單向逼近與回程差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「調整螺距位移」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pitch and turns determine nominal travel, but backlash and elastic recovery require remeasurement. In this model, pitch is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.77 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Ideal thread pitch without backlash or elastic recovery. Use one-direction approach and reverse-travel difference as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Adjustment screw displacement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：反覆換向會把螺紋間隙誤當板體不穩」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Repeated direction reversal can mistake thread backlash for slab instability." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.instruction: 本單元以不同棱鏡互換與基線區分模型與觀察，先用基線量測與棱鏡互換建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「棱鏡常數偏差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use prism interchange and a reference baseline to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch. Explain which evidence in prism interchange and a reference baseline distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：錯誤常數會平移整批量測。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 棱鏡常數偏差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Prism-constant bias: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「棱鏡常數偏差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Prism-constant bias” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 錯誤常數會平移整批量測。這個失效與「棱鏡常數偏差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查不同棱鏡互換與基線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch. This failure and a measurement bias in Prism-constant bias can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check prism interchange and a reference baseline rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用不同棱鏡互換與基線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；錯誤常數會平移整批量測，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：錯誤常數會平移整批量測」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect constant shifts the entire measurement batch." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

steps.title: 水準閉合分配：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 按長度分配閉合差只是一種模型，需先排除粗差再調整。本模型把 closure 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.66 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。已排除粗差後按路線長度分配。使用往返高差及分段長度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直接分配粗差會把錯誤散布到全部控制點，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水準閉合分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Allocating closure by length is one adjustment model; blunders must be excluded first. In this model, closure is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.66 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Length-weighted allocation after excluding blunders. Use forward-back level differences and segment lengths as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Distributing a blunder spreads error across all control points; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Levelling closure allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元以不同測站而非同站重讀區分模型與觀察，先用不同測站重測結果建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「重測平均不確定度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent stations rather than repeated display readings to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 重測平均不確定度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Repeated-survey mean uncertainty: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「重測平均不確定度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Repeated-survey mean uncertainty” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度。這個失效與「重測平均不確定度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查不同測站而非同站重讀，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision. This failure and a measurement bias in Repeated-survey mean uncertainty can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check independent stations rather than repeated display readings rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用不同測站而非同站重讀作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把同一基準的相關觀測當獨立會誇大精度」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating correlated readings as independent exaggerates precision." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

title: 長焊鋼軌應力放散
titleEn: Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail
summary: 長焊鋼軌應力放散以「連續焊軌中性溫度約束與位移證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。連續鋼軌的熱伸縮被扣件與道床約束，軌溫與應力自由溫度的差才是熱力判斷的起點；軌道橫向阻力及初始不整也影響穩定性。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops neutral temperature restraint and displacement evidence in welded rail through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Fastenings and ballast restrain thermal rail movement; the difference between rail temperature and stress-free temperature starts the force assessment, while lateral resistance and initial misalignment also govern stability. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K；y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=66.4125 MPa。模型邊界：線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K; y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=66.4125 MPa. Boundary: A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 自由鋼軌伸長與全約束熱應力
stages.titleEn: Free rail expansion & Fully restrained thermal stress
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「自由鋼軌伸長」與「全約束熱應力」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Free rail expansion" and "Fully restrained thermal stress": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「自由鋼軌伸長」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Free rail expansion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 25.3 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度。使用軌溫和端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「自由鋼軌伸長」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 25.3 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted. Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Free rail expansion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「自由鋼軌伸長」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Free rail expansion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 自由鋼軌伸長
knowledge.text: 無約束鋼軌可以以長度變化釋放熱應變。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 25.3 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Unrestrained rail releases thermal strain through a change in length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「自由鋼軌伸長」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「自由鋼軌伸長」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Free rail expansion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=25.3 mm。模型邊界：均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=100 m, dT=20 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=23 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=25.3 mm. Boundary: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「自由鋼軌伸長」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Free rail expansion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以軌溫和端部位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型鋼條兩端位移計、標距及多點溫度紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「自由鋼軌伸長」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use rail temperature and endpoint displacement to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model-bar endpoint displacement gauges, gauge length and distributed temperature records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Free rail expansion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「自由鋼軌伸長」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出均勻軌溫、定熱膨脹係數及無軸向約束；忽略溫度梯度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設造成偏離的合成觀察，以軌溫和端部位移說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Free rail expansion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Uniform rail temperature, constant expansion coefficient and no axial restraint; temperature gradients are omitted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. Explain which evidence in rail temperature and endpoint displacement distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 自由鋼軌伸長：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Free rail expansion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「自由鋼軌伸長」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Free rail expansion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設。這個失效與「自由鋼軌伸長」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查軌溫和端部位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior. This failure and a measurement bias in Free rail expansion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail temperature and endpoint displacement rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用軌溫和端部位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：局部卡阻會破壞自由伸長假設」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Local binding invalidates free-expansion behavior." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 全約束熱應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「全約束熱應力」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fully restrained thermal stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 完全約束下軸向熱應變轉成應力。本模型把 E 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 66.4125 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸。使用軌溫與可追溯應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「全約束熱應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Full axial restraint converts thermal strain into stress. In this model, E is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 66.4125 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling. Use rail temperature and traceable strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fully restrained thermal stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K；y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K; y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「全約束熱應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fully restrained thermal stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 全約束熱應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「全約束熱應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fully restrained thermal stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K；y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=66.4125 MPa。模型邊界：線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, dT=25 K; y=E*1000*alpha*dT=60.375 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=66.4125 MPa. Boundary: A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以軌溫與可追溯應變區分模型與觀察，先用合成約束力、截面面積、補償應變與軌溫時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use rail temperature and traceable strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 全約束熱應力：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「全約束熱應力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fully restrained thermal stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以軌溫與可追溯應變區分模型與觀察，先用合成約束力、截面面積、補償應變與軌溫時間序列建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「全約束熱應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use rail temperature and traceable strain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic restraint force, area, compensated strain and rail-temperature histories, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fully restrained thermal stress. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「全約束熱應力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線彈性桿完全軸向約束；結果為應力大小，升溫為壓縮、降溫為拉伸如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移造成偏離的合成觀察，以軌溫與可追溯應變說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fully restrained thermal stress, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: A fully axially restrained elastic bar; the result is stress magnitude, compressive for heating and tensile for cooling. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate. Explain which evidence in rail temperature and traceable strain distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 全約束熱應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fully restrained thermal stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「全約束熱應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fully restrained thermal stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移。這個失效與「全約束熱應力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查軌溫與可追溯應變，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate. This failure and a measurement bias in Fully restrained thermal stress can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check rail temperature and traceable strain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用軌溫與可追溯應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：中性溫度估錯會讓應力估計整體偏移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Incorrect neutral temperature shifts the full stress estimate." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認

stages.title: 熱軸力換算與軌溫量測誤差
stages.titleEn: Thermal axial-force conversion & Rail-temperature error propagation
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱軸力換算」與「軌溫量測誤差」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Thermal axial-force conversion" and "Rail-temperature error propagation": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱軸力換算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Thermal axial-force conversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱軸力換算」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Thermal axial-force conversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軸力等於平均應力乘有效斷面，左右兩軌須分別核對。本模型把 sigma 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 501.6 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。應力沿有效斷面均勻；只算單根鋼軌的軸力。使用斷面損耗與軸向應變作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；磨耗斷面仍沿用新軌面積會誤算軸力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱軸力換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial force equals mean stress times effective area, with each rail checked separately. In this model, sigma is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 501.6 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Stress is uniform over the effective section; force is for one rail only. Use section loss and axial strain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Using new-rail area for worn rail miscalculates force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Thermal axial-force conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sigma=60 MPa, A=7600 mm2；y=sigma*A/1000=456 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: sigma=60 MPa, A=7600 mm2; y=sigma*A/1000=456 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：磨耗斷面仍沿用新軌面積會誤算軸力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Using new-rail area for worn rail miscalculates force." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱軸力換算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Thermal axial-force conversion”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱軸力換算
knowledge.text: 軸力等於平均應力乘有效斷面，左右兩軌須分別核對。本模型把 sigma 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 501.6 kN。

steps.title: 軌溫量測誤差：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「軌溫量測誤差」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Rail-temperature error propagation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, uT=2 K；y=E*1000*alpha*uT=4.83 MPa。只把 E 增加百分之十，y=5.313 MPa。模型邊界：只傳播軌溫誤差；彈性係數、熱膨脹係數及約束皆視為已知；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: E=210 GPa, alpha=0.0000115 1/K, uT=2 K; y=E*1000*alpha*uT=4.83 MPa. Increasing only E with a ten-percent increase gives y=5.313 MPa. Boundary: Only rail-temperature error is propagated; modulus, expansion coefficient and restraint are treated as known; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以兩種接觸式溫度量測區分模型與觀察，先用同步雙溫度計、溫度校準紀錄及合成應力估計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use two contact-temperature measurements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 軌溫量測誤差：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Rail-temperature error propagation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「軌溫量測誤差」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Rail-temperature error propagation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以兩種接觸式溫度量測區分模型與觀察，先用同步雙溫度計、溫度校準紀錄及合成應力估計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「軌溫量測誤差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use two contact-temperature measurements to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using paired synchronous thermometers, calibration records and synthetic stress estimates, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Rail-temperature error propagation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「軌溫量測誤差」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出只傳播軌溫誤差；彈性係數、熱膨脹係數及約束皆視為已知如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性造成偏離的合成觀察，以兩種接觸式溫度量測說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Rail-temperature error propagation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Only rail-temperature error is propagated; modulus, expansion coefficient and restraint are treated as known. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative. Explain which evidence in two contact-temperature measurements distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 軌溫量測誤差：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Rail-temperature error propagation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「軌溫量測誤差」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Rail-temperature error propagation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性。這個失效與「軌溫量測誤差」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩種接觸式溫度量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative. This failure and a measurement bias in Rail-temperature error propagation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check two contact-temperature measurements rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用兩種接觸式溫度量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單側日照造成的溫差會讓表面溫度失去代表性」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One-sided sunshine makes a surface temperature unrepresentative." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 扣件阻力累積與溫差等效位移
stages.titleEn: Fastening resistance accumulation & Temperature-equivalent displacement
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「扣件阻力累積」與「溫差等效位移」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fastening resistance accumulation" and "Temperature-equivalent displacement": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 扣件阻力累積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fastening resistance accumulation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「扣件阻力累積」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fastening resistance accumulation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻分布縱向阻力積分後形成可傳遞軸力的量級。本模型把 r 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 264 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。全長均勻且已動員的縱向阻力；不是未滑移狀態的彈性剛度。使用沿線相對滑移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把滑動後阻力視為初始彈性剛度會混淆機制，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「扣件阻力累積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Integrating uniform longitudinal resistance gives a transferable-force scale. In this model, r is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 264 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform longitudinal resistance is fully mobilized along the length; it is not pre-slip elastic stiffness. Use relative slip along the line as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Confusing post-slip resistance with initial elastic stiffness mixes mechanisms; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fastening resistance accumulation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：r=8 kN/m, L=30 m；y=r*L=240 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: r=8 kN/m, L=30 m; y=r*L=240 kN.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=80 m, dT=12 K；y=alpha*L*dT*1000=11.04 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=12.144 mm。模型邊界：同一已知標距的自由熱位移；不把它視為有約束鋼軌的實際位移；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.0000115 1/K, L=80 m, dT=12 K; y=alpha*L*dT*1000=11.04 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=12.144 mm. Boundary: Free thermal movement over a known gauge length; it is not actual movement of a restrained rail; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以標距及基準端點區分模型與觀察，先用固定基準標記、模型標距及平均鋼條溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use gauge length and reference endpoints to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Temperature-equivalent displacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以標距及基準端點區分模型與觀察，先用固定基準標記、模型標距及平均鋼條溫度建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「溫差等效位移」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use gauge length and reference endpoints to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Temperature-equivalent displacement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「溫差等效位移」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出同一已知標距的自由熱位移；不把它視為有約束鋼軌的實際位移如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差造成偏離的合成觀察，以標距及基準端點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Temperature-equivalent displacement, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Free thermal movement over a known gauge length; it is not actual movement of a restrained rail. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. steps.failure: 注意干擾：標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 溫差等效位移：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Temperature-equivalent displacement: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「溫差等效位移」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Temperature-equivalent displacement” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差。這個失效與「溫差等效位移」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查標距及基準端點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using the old displacement with a shorter gauge exaggerates inferred temperature change. This failure and a measurement bias in Temperature-equivalent displacement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check gauge length and reference endpoints rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用標距及基準端點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；標距縮短後沿用原位移會放大推算溫差，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 中性溫差反算與截面溫度梯度
stages.titleEn: Neutral-temperature difference inversion & Cross-section temperature curvature
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「中性溫差反算」與「截面溫度梯度」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Neutral-temperature difference inversion" and "Cross-section temperature curvature": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 中性溫差反算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Neutral-temperature difference inversion: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「中性溫差反算」如何影響長焊鋼軌應力放散的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Neutral-temperature difference inversion” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Stress neutralization of continuously welded rail”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 應變反算溫差必須先分離機械與熱補償項。本模型把 strain 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 11 K。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。應變是已分離機械載重的熱等效大小；只能反算溫差大小，不能單獨定出中性溫度。使用補償應變計與獨立溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；儀器熱漂移會被誤認為中性溫度改變，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「中性溫差反算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring temperature difference from strain requires separating mechanical strain and temperature compensation. In this model, strain is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 11 K. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Strain is an isolated thermal-equivalent magnitude; inversion yields a temperature-difference magnitude, not neutral temperature by itself. Use compensated strain gauges and independent temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Instrument thermal drift can resemble a neutral-temperature change; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Neutral-temperature difference inversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
