quiz.explanation: 只以缺口大小推算整條線軌應力並不唯一。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: A gap size does not uniquely determine stress along an entire line. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼軌閃光焊接
summary: 鋼軌閃光焊接以「電阻熱頂鍛幾何與焊接品質證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。閃光對焊把電熱輸入、接合面狀態與頂鍛塑性變形串接；焊後外觀平順只是幾何條件，不能單獨證明熱影響區與內部接合品質。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops resistance heating upset geometry and weld-quality evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Flash-butt welding couples electrical heat input, interface condition and upset deformation; a smooth finished profile is a geometric condition and alone does not prove heat-affected-zone or internal bond quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=4 V, I=5000 A；y=V*I/1000=20 kW。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=22 kW。模型邊界：電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.05 kJ. Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: V=4 V, I=5000 A; y=V*I/1000=20 kW. Increasing only V with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 kW. Boundary: Voltage spans only the joint and is synchronous with current; cable and source losses are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 電阻熱積分與電功率帳核對
stages.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration & Electrical power cross-check
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「電阻熱積分」與「電功率帳核對」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Resistance-heat integration" and "Electrical power cross-check": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 電阻熱積分：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「電阻熱積分」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Resistance-heat integration” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.05 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量。使用同步電流電壓波形作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電阻熱積分」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.05 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted. Use synchronized current and voltage waveforms as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Resistance-heat integration” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「電阻熱積分」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Resistance-heat integration”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 電阻熱積分
knowledge.text: 焦耳熱與電流平方相關，電阻隨溫度和接觸狀態改變。本模型把 I 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.05 kJ。
knowledge.textEn: Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. In this model, I is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「電阻熱積分」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Resistance-heat integration" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入

本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current.
Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat.

quiz.explanationEn: Joule heat depends on current squared while resistance changes with temperature and contact state. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 電阻熱積分：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「電阻熱積分」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Resistance-heat integration” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Increasing only I with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.05 kJ. Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同步電流電壓波形區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速電流與電壓訊號、同步時間窗及能量積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronized current and voltage waveforms to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s；y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ。只把 I 增加百分之十，y=6.05 kJ。模型邊界：電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Resistance-heat integration", which statement holds?

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: I=5000 A, R=0.0001 ohm, t=2 s; y=I**2*R*t/1000=5 kJ. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 電阻熱積分：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Resistance-heat integration: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「電阻熱積分」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Resistance-heat integration” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以同步電流電壓波形區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速電流與電壓訊號、同步時間窗及能量積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「電阻熱積分」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronized current and voltage waveforms to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic high-rate current and voltage signals, synchronized intervals and energy integration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Resistance-heat integration. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「電阻熱積分」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出電流及接觸電阻在時間窗內恆定；只算電阻耗散熱量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入造成偏離的合成觀察，以同步電流電壓波形說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Resistance-heat integration, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Current and contact resistance are constant during the interval; only resistive heat is counted. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current. Explain which evidence in synchronized current and voltage waveforms distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

quiz.question: 要驗證「電阻熱積分」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？

options: 本單元以同步電流電壓波形區分模型與觀察，先用合成高速電流與電壓訊號、同步時間窗及能量積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.instruction: 接頭電壓乘電流給出局部電功率，不能包含無關導線壓降。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 kW。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗。使用接頭四線式電壓量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「電功率帳核對」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：V=4 V, I=5000 A；y=V*I/1000=20 kW。只把 V 增加百分之十，y=22 kW。模型邊界：電壓只跨接頭且與電流同步；不含電纜及電源端損耗；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以接頭四線式電壓量測區分模型與觀察，先用低壓等效試件的四端電壓、電流及量測端點圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「電功率帳核對」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 電功率帳核對：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Electrical power cross-check: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「電功率帳核對」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Electrical power cross-check” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量。這個失效與「電功率帳核對」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭四線式電壓量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat. This failure and a measurement bias in Electrical power cross-check can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check four-terminal voltage measurements across the joint rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用接頭四線式電壓量測作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量。這個失效與「電功率帳核對」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭四線式電壓量測，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat. This failure and a measurement bias in Electrical power cross-check can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check four-terminal voltage measurements across the joint rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「電功率帳核對」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Electrical power cross-check" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 補一層塗料或放寬允收值，就能解決大多數劣化問題。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均
量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量。
optionsEn: Adding a coat of paint or widening the acceptance limits solves most deterioration problems.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow.
Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat.
quiz.explanation: 量測點過遠會把電纜損耗算進接頭熱量。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Distant voltage taps count cable loss as joint heat. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 頂鍛平均壓力與頂鍛作功估計
stages.titleEn: Mean upset pressure & Upset-work estimate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「頂鍛平均壓力」與「頂鍛作功估計」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean upset pressure" and "Upset-work estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「頂鍛平均壓力」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean upset pressure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軸力除面積是平均頂鍛壓力，不等於接觸面每處應力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 65.1316 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布。使用力位移同步曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頂鍛平均壓力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Axial force divided by area is mean upset pressure, not local contact stress everywhere. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 65.1316 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution. Use synchronized force-displacement curves as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean upset pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頂鍛平均壓力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean upset pressure”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 頂鍛平均壓力
knowledge.text: 軸力除面積是平均頂鍛壓力，不等於接觸面每處應力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 65.1316 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: Axial force divided by area is mean upset pressure, not local contact stress everywhere. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「頂鍛平均壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Mean upset pressure" is correct?
options: 軸力除面積是平均頂鍛壓力，不等於接觸面每處應力。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移
optionsEn: Axial force divided by area is mean upset pressure, not local contact stress everywhere.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement.
quiz.explanation: 軸力除面積是平均頂鍛壓力，不等於接觸面每處應力。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Axial force divided by area is mean upset pressure, not local contact stress everywhere. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頂鍛平均壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean upset pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=65.1316 MPa。模型邊界：力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=65.1316 MPa. Boundary: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以力位移同步曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成軸向力、接觸面積及接頭對中偏差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use synchronized force-displacement curves to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=65.1316 MPa。模型邊界：力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=65.1316 MPa. Boundary: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「頂鍛平均壓力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Mean upset pressure", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一平均值會掩蓋局部快速冷卻
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略微小偏心會低估接頭彎曲
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One average hides locally rapid cooling.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring a small eccentricity understates joint bending.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2；y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=450 kN, A=7600 mm2; y=F*1000/A=59.2105 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 頂鍛平均壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean upset pressure: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「頂鍛平均壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean upset pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以力位移同步曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成軸向力、接觸面積及接頭對中偏差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頂鍛平均壓力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use synchronized force-displacement curves to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic axial force, contact area and joint-alignment offset, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean upset pressure. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「頂鍛平均壓力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均造成偏離的合成觀察，以力位移同步曲線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean upset pressure, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow. Explain which evidence in synchronized force-displacement curves distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Misalignment produces eccentric pressure and uneven plastic flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以力位移同步曲線區分模型與觀察，先用合成軸向力、接觸面積及接頭對中偏差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頂鍛平均壓力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use synchronized force-displacement curves to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic axial force, contact area and joint-alignment offset, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean upset pressure. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「頂鍛平均壓力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出力沿軸線且接觸面積固定；平均壓力不代表局部塑性應力分布如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由對中不良會使壓力偏心與塑性流動不均造成偏離的合成觀察，以力位移同步曲線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean upset pressure, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Force is axial and contact area fixed; mean pressure does not represent local plastic stress distribution. steps.title: 頂鍛作功估計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Upset-work estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「頂鍛作功估計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Upset-work estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移。這個失效與「頂鍛作功估計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查行程零點與載荷，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement. This failure and a measurement bias in Upset-work estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check travel zero and load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用行程零點與載荷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：液壓機構彈性位移會被誤算成接頭塑性位移」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Hydraulic elastic displacement can be mistaken for joint plastic displacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 熱影響區顯熱與平均冷卻速率
stages.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat & Average cooling rate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「熱影響區顯熱」與「平均冷卻速率」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Heat-affected-zone sensible heat" and "Average cooling rate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 熱影響區顯熱：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「熱影響區顯熱」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 顯熱量級不包含相變與溫度依賴比熱。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 693 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性。使用熱影響區範圍與溫度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「熱影響區顯熱」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sensible-heat scale excludes phase change and temperature-dependent heat capacity. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 693 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded. Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「熱影響區顯熱」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 熱影響區顯熱
knowledge.text: 顯熱量級不包含相變與溫度依賴比熱。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 693 kJ。
knowledge.textEn: Sensible-heat scale excludes phase change and temperature-dependent heat capacity. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「熱影響區顯熱」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

steps.title: 熱影響區顯熱：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「熱影響區顯熱」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=693 kJ。模型邊界：區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=693 kJ. Boundary: Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以熱影響區範圍與溫度區分模型與觀察，先用合成多位置溫度曲線、區域質量估計與比熱資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=693 kJ。模型邊界：區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=1.5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=700 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=630 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=693 kJ. Boundary: Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 熱影響區顯熱：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Heat-affected-zone sensible heat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「熱影響區顯熱」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Heat-affected-zone sensible heat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以熱影響區範圍與溫度區分模型與觀察，先用合成多位置溫度曲線、區域質量估計與比熱資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「熱影響區顯熱」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic distributed temperature traces, region-mass estimate and heat-capacity data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heat-affected-zone sensible heat. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「熱影響區顯熱」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出區域質量、比熱及溫升均勻；不含潛熱、散熱及溫度依存性如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度造成偏離的合成觀察，以熱影響區範圍與溫度說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Heat-affected-zone sensible heat, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Region mass, heat capacity and temperature rise are uniform; latent heat, heat loss and temperature dependence are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients. Explain which evidence in heat-affected-zone extent and temperature distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：均溫假設會掩蓋近界面梯度。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A uniform-temperature assumption hides near-interface gradients. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以熱影響區範圍與溫度區分模型與觀察，先用合成多位置溫度曲線、區域質量估計與比熱資料建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「熱影響區顯熱」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use heat-affected-zone extent and temperature to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic distributed temperature traces, region-mass estimate and heat-capacity data, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Heat-affected-zone sensible heat. steps.title: 焊頭垂向角差：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「焊頭垂向角差」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weld vertical angular mismatch” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 端部角差造成通過時幾何激振，表面研磨不能修復所有內部偏心。本模型把 dz 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.33 mrad。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。高差與標距之比為小角近似；兩側剖面使用同一基準。使用兩側直尺與縱向剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短尺平順可能漏掉較長波長折角，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「焊頭垂向角差」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Angular mismatch excites passing wheels geometrically, and surface grinding cannot correct every internal eccentricity. In this model, dz is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.33 mrad. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Height difference over gauge length is a small-angle approximation; profiles use one datum. Use straightedge readings and longitudinal profiles on both sides as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A short straightedge can miss a longer-wavelength angular defect; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weld vertical angular mismatch” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=0.3 mm, L=1 m；y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dz=0.3 mm, L=1 m; y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weld vertical angular mismatch” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dz=0.3 mm, L=1 m；y=dz/(L*1000)*1000=0.3 mrad。只把 dz 增加百分之十，y=0.33 mrad。模型邊界：高差與標距之比為小角近似；兩側剖面使用同一基準；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weld vertical angular mismatch” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以兩側直尺與縱向剖面區分模型與觀察，先用多標距直尺、連續縱向剖面與零點校準建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「焊頭垂向角差」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 斷面偏心彎矩：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Section-eccentricity bending moment: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斷面偏心彎矩」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Section-eccentricity bending moment” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略微小偏心會低估接頭彎曲。這個失效與「斷面偏心彎矩」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查軸線對中與偏移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring a small eccentricity understates joint bending. This failure and a measurement bias in Section-eccentricity bending moment can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check axial alignment and offset rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用軸線對中與偏移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略微小偏心會低估接頭彎曲，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring a small eccentricity understates joint bending; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略微小偏心會低估接頭彎曲」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring a small eccentricity understates joint bending." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

stages.title: 硬度相對差異與檢測覆蓋比例
stages.titleEn: Relative hardness difference & Inspection coverage fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「硬度相對差異」與「檢測覆蓋比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Relative hardness difference" and "Inspection coverage fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 硬度相對差異：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Relative hardness difference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「硬度相對差異」如何影響鋼軌閃光焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Relative hardness difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Flash-butt rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 硬度差反映局部材料狀態，但不直接等同疲勞壽命差。本模型把 H1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命。使用等距硬度剖面與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「硬度相對差異」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Hardness variation reflects local material state but does not directly equal a fatigue-life difference. In this model, H1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 32 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life. Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Relative hardness difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV；y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV; y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「硬度相對差異」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Relative hardness difference”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 硬度相對差異
knowledge.text: 硬度差反映局部材料狀態，但不直接等同疲勞壽命差。本模型把 H1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32 percent。
knowledge.textEn: Hardness variation reflects local material state but does not directly equal a fatigue-life difference. In this model, H1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.title: 硬度相對差異：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Relative hardness difference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「硬度相對差異」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Relative hardness difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV；y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent。只把 H1 增加百分之十，y=32 percent。模型邊界：兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV; y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent. Increasing only H1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=32 percent. Boundary: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以等距硬度剖面與位置區分模型與觀察，先用同載荷壓痕硬度網格、位置及重複試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：H1=300 HV, H2=250 HV；y=(H1-H2)/H2*100=20 percent。只把 H1 增加百分之十，y=32 percent。模型邊界：兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 硬度相對差異：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Relative hardness difference: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「硬度相對差異」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Relative hardness difference” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以等距硬度剖面與位置區分模型與觀察，先用同載荷壓痕硬度網格、位置及重複試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「硬度相對差異」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using indentation-hardness grid at equal load, position records and repeat tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Relative hardness difference. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「硬度相對差異」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩值使用同一硬度尺度和試驗條件；比例不換算疲勞壽命如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區造成偏離的合成觀察，以等距硬度剖面與位置說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Relative hardness difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Values share one hardness scale and test conditions; the ratio is not converted into fatigue life. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. Explain which evidence in equally spaced hardness profiles and positions distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：只測焊縫中心會漏掉較軟熱影響區。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Testing only the weld centre misses a softer heat-affected zone. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以等距硬度剖面與位置區分模型與觀察，先用同載荷壓痕硬度網格、位置及重複試驗建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「硬度相對差異」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use equally spaced hardness profiles and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using indentation-hardness grid at equal load, position records and repeat tests, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Relative hardness difference. knowledge.text: 重算「檢測覆蓋比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出覆蓋與總長度是同一幾何量；未包含聲束靈敏度或檢出機率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力造成偏離的合成觀察，以探頭聲束覆蓋圖說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection coverage fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Coverage and total length describe the same geometry; sensitivity and detection probability are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability. Explain which evidence in probe beam-coverage maps distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢測覆蓋比例」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inspection coverage fraction"?
options: 本單元以探頭聲束覆蓋圖區分模型與觀察，先用標定試塊、探頭姿態及實際聲束覆蓋圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短尺平順可能漏掉較長波長折角
optionsEn: Use probe beam-coverage maps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short straightedge can miss a longer-wavelength angular defect.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以探頭聲束覆蓋圖區分模型與觀察，先用標定試塊、探頭姿態及實際聲束覆蓋圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use probe beam-coverage maps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢測覆蓋比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspection coverage fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢測覆蓋比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inspection coverage fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力。這個失效與「檢測覆蓋比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查探頭聲束覆蓋圖，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection coverage fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check probe beam-coverage maps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用探頭聲束覆蓋圖作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力。這個失效與「檢測覆蓋比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查探頭聲束覆蓋圖，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection coverage fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check probe beam-coverage maps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢測覆蓋比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspection coverage fraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用平均電流平方代替均方電流會低估脈動熱輸入
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Squaring mean current understates heating from a fluctuating current.
quiz.explanation: 把覆蓋率當檢出率會誇大檢測能力。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equating coverage with detection probability exaggerates inspection capability. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接
summary: 鋼軌鋁熱焊接以「現場接頭熱量收縮形貌與無損檢測」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。鋁熱焊課程只分析接頭能量、凝固收縮與焊後驗證；化學配方、點火及現場操作均不由教學模型指定，重點是辨認外觀與內部品質的差異。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops field-joint heat shrinkage profile and nondestructive inspection through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. This aluminothermic-weld course analyses joint energy, solidification shrinkage and post-weld verification; it specifies no chemical recipe, ignition or field procedure, and distinguishes visible profile from internal quality. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=500 K；y=m*c*dT/1000=1500 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=1650 kJ。模型邊界：給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.864 kg. Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=5 kg, c=600 J/kgK, dT=500 K; y=m*c*dT/1000=1500 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=1650 kJ. Boundary: Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 接頭金屬質量與接頭顯熱量級
stages.titleEn: Joint metal mass & Joint sensible-heat scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「接頭金屬質量」與「接頭顯熱量級」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Joint metal mass" and "Joint sensible-heat scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 接頭金屬質量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Joint metal mass: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「接頭金屬質量」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Joint metal mass” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.864 kg。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料。使用接頭幾何與有效體積作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭金屬質量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 6.864 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded. Use joint geometry and effective volume as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Joint metal mass” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「接頭金屬質量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Joint metal mass”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 接頭金屬質量
knowledge.text: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。本模型把 rho 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 6.864 kg。
knowledge.textEn: Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. In this model, rho is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「接頭金屬質量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Joint metal mass" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量
密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill.
Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration.
quiz.explanation: 密度乘有效體積可核對材料帳，外部餘料需分開。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Density times effective volume checks the material account, keeping external surplus separate. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 接頭金屬質量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Joint metal mass: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「接頭金屬質量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Joint metal mass” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.864 kg. Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以接頭幾何與有效體積區分模型與觀察，先用接頭模型三維體積、密度資料及獨立秤重建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use joint geometry and effective volume to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。只把 rho 增加百分之十，y=6.864 kg。模型邊界：有效體積與密度對應同一溫度狀態；不含外部餘料；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3; y=rho*V=6.24 kg. Increasing only rho with a ten-percent increase gives y=6.864 kg. Boundary: Effective volume and density refer to the same temperature state; external surplus is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「接頭金屬質量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Joint metal mass", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用穩態熱流外推全部冷卻過程會失真
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：rho=7800 kg/m3, V=0.0008 m3；y=rho*V=6.24 kg。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect.

steps.instruction: 外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量。這個失效與「接頭金屬質量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭幾何與有效體積，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill. This failure and a measurement bias in Joint metal mass can produce similar symptoms. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.instruction: 顯熱只描述溫度變化，凝固潛熱必須另列。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1650 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算。使用質量與溫度歷程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「接頭顯熱量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Sensible heat describes temperature change; latent heat of solidification is separate. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate. Use mass and temperature history as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. steps.instruction: 本單元以質量與溫度歷程區分模型與觀察，先用合成金屬溫度歷程、有效質量及熱容量紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「接頭顯熱量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use mass and temperature history to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic metal-temperature history, effective mass and heat-capacity records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Joint sensible-heat scale. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「接頭顯熱量級」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出給定金屬質量、定比熱及均勻溫升；相變潛熱另算如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間造成偏離的合成觀察，以質量與溫度歷程說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Joint sensible-heat scale, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Given metal mass, constant heat capacity and uniform temperature rise; phase-change latent heat is separate. steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
