steps.title: 接頭顯熱量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Joint sensible-heat scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「接頭顯熱量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Joint sensible-heat scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間。這個失效與「接頭顯熱量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查質量與溫度歷程，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration. This failure and a measurement bias in Joint sensible-heat scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check mass and temperature history rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用質量與溫度歷程作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting latent heat misjudges cooling duration." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 凝固潛熱帳與體積收縮量
stages.titleEn: Solidification latent-heat account & Volume-shrinkage estimate
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「凝固潛熱帳」與「體積收縮量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Solidification latent-heat account" and "Volume-shrinkage estimate": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 凝固潛熱帳：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Solidification latent-heat account: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「凝固潛熱帳」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Solidification latent-heat account” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相變放熱可以在溫度變化很小時持續發生。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1485 kJ。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。全部指定質量完成同一相變；潛熱視為常數。使用冷卻曲線平台作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把平台當成感測器故障會漏掉相變效應，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「凝固潛熱帳」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Phase-change heat can be released while temperature changes little. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1485 kJ. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant. Use a plateau in the cooling trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mistaking a plateau for sensor failure misses phase-change behavior; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Solidification latent-heat account” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg；y=m*latent=1350 kJ。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg; y=m*latent=1350 kJ.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把平台當成感測器故障會漏掉相變效應」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Mistaking a plateau for sensor failure misses phase-change behavior." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「凝固潛熱帳」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Solidification latent-heat account”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 凝固潛熱帳

steps.title: 凝固潛熱帳：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Solidification latent-heat account: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「凝固潛熱帳」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Solidification latent-heat account” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg；y=m*latent=1350 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=1485 kJ。模型邊界：全部指定質量完成同一相變；潛熱視為常數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg; y=m*latent=1350 kJ. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=1485 kJ. Boundary: The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以冷卻曲線平台區分模型與觀察，先用合成冷卻曲線、相變比例與熱量收支建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use a plateau in the cooling trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=5 kg, latent=270 kJ/kg；y=m*latent=1350 kJ。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=1485 kJ。模型邊界：全部指定質量完成同一相變；潛熱視為常數；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: The specified mass completes the same phase change; latent heat is constant; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。

steps.instruction: 把平台當成感測器故障會漏掉相變效應。這個失效與「凝固潛熱帳」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查冷卻曲線平台，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Mistaking a plateau for sensor failure misses phase-change behavior. This failure and a measurement bias in Solidification latent-heat account can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check a plateau in the cooling trace rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.title: 體積收縮量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「體積收縮量」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。

steps.instruction: 總收縮量不能單獨決定縮孔位置，補縮路徑與冷卻次序也重要。本模型把 V 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.4 cm3。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。體積收縮率是明列的整體假設；結果不決定縮孔位置。使用內部孔隙分布作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「體積收縮量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Total shrinkage does not determine pore location; feeding paths and cooling order matter. In this model, V is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.4 cm3. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Volumetric shrinkage fraction is an explicit bulk assumption; the result does not locate shrinkage voids. Use distribution of internal voids as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Volume-shrinkage estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「體積收縮量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 體積收縮量：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Volume-shrinkage estimate: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「體積收縮量」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Volume-shrinkage estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以內部孔隙分布區分模型與觀察，先用模型凝固前後體積、內部缺陷影像及補縮路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「體積收縮量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use distribution of internal voids to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model before-after volumes, internal-defect images and feeding-path diagram, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Volume-shrinkage estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「體積收縮量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出體積收縮率是明列的整體假設；結果不決定縮孔位置如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以內部孔隙分布說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Volume-shrinkage estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Volumetric shrinkage fraction is an explicit bulk assumption; the result does not locate shrinkage voids. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. Explain which evidence in distribution of internal voids distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以內部孔隙分布區分模型與觀察，先用模型凝固前後體積、內部缺陷影像及補縮路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「體積收縮量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use distribution of internal voids to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model before-after volumes, internal-defect images and feeding-path diagram, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Volume-shrinkage estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「體積收縮量」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出體積收縮率是明列的整體假設；結果不決定縮孔位置如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷造成偏離的合成觀察，以內部孔隙分布說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Volume-shrinkage estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Volumetric shrinkage fraction is an explicit bulk assumption; the result does not locate shrinkage voids. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. Explain which evidence in distribution of internal voids distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「體積收縮量」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Volume-shrinkage estimate"?
options: 本單元以內部孔隙分布區分模型與觀察，先用模型凝固前後體積、內部缺陷影像及補縮路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量
optionsEn: Use distribution of internal voids to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以內部孔隙分布區分模型與觀察，先用模型凝固前後體積、內部缺陷影像及補縮路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use distribution of internal voids to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 體積收縮量：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Volume-shrinkage estimate: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「體積收縮量」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Volume-shrinkage estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷。這個失效與「體積收縮量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查內部孔隙分布，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. This failure and a measurement bias in Volume-shrinkage estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check distribution of internal voids rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用內部孔隙分布作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷。這個失效與「體積收縮量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查內部孔隙分布，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. This failure and a measurement bias in Volume-shrinkage estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check distribution of internal voids rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「體積收縮量」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Volume-shrinkage estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把兩種收縮重複相加會高估位移
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Double counting the two shrinkage stages overestimates movement.
quiz.explanation: 冷卻不均可能把收縮集中成缺陷。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Uneven cooling can concentrate shrinkage into a defect. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

stages.title: 線性熱收縮量與等效導熱通量
stages.titleEn: Linear thermal contraction & Equivalent conductive heat flux
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「線性熱收縮量」與「等效導熱通量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Linear thermal contraction" and "Equivalent conductive heat flux": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 線性熱收縮量：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Linear thermal contraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「線性熱收縮量」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Linear thermal contraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固態冷卻收縮與凝固體積收縮屬不同階段。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.1584 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。只算凝固完成後的自由固態收縮；不包含凝固體積收縮。使用降溫後幾何變化作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把兩種收縮重複相加會高估位移，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「線性熱收縮量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Solid-state thermal contraction and solidification shrinkage occur in different stages. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.1584 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Only free solid-state contraction after solidification is included; solidification volume shrinkage is excluded. Use geometry change after cooling as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Double counting the two shrinkage stages overestimates movement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Linear thermal contraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K；y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K; y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把兩種收縮重複相加會高估位移」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Double counting the two shrinkage stages overestimates movement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「線性熱收縮量」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Linear thermal contraction”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 線性熱收縮量
knowledge.text: 固態冷卻收縮與凝固體積收縮屬不同階段。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.1584 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Solid-state thermal contraction and solidification shrinkage occur in different stages. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把兩種收縮重複相加會高估位移 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Double counting the two shrinkage stages overestimates movement. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「線性熱收縮量」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Linear thermal contraction" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把兩種收縮重複相加會高估位移
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用穩態熱流外推全部冷卻過程會失真
固態冷卻收縮與凝固體積收縮屬不同階段。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Double counting the two shrinkage stages overestimates movement.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending a steady flux over the entire cooling history distorts energy.
Solid-state thermal contraction and solidification shrinkage occur in different stages.
quiz.explanation: 固態冷卻收縮與凝固體積收縮屬不同階段。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Solid-state thermal contraction and solidification shrinkage occur in different stages. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 線性熱收縮量：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Linear thermal contraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「線性熱收縮量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Linear thermal contraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K；y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=0.1584 mm。模型邊界：只算凝固完成後的自由固態收縮；不包含凝固體積收縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K; y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.1584 mm. Boundary: Only free solid-state contraction after solidification is included; solidification volume shrinkage is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以降溫後幾何變化區分模型與觀察，先用同一標距的冷卻溫度與端點尺寸變化建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use geometry change after cooling to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K；y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=0.1584 mm。模型邊界：只算凝固完成後的自由固態收縮；不包含凝固體積收縮；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K; y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.1584 mm. Boundary: Only free solid-state contraction after solidification is included; solidification volume shrinkage is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「線性熱收縮量」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Linear thermal contraction", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K；y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符
optionsEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.000012 1/K, L=40 mm, dT=300 K; y=alpha*L*dT=0.144 mm.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage.

steps.instruction: 把兩種收縮重複相加會高估位移。這個失效與「線性熱收縮量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查降溫後幾何變化，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Double counting the two shrinkage stages overestimates movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Linear thermal contraction can produce similar symptoms. steps.instruction: 一維熱流與溫度梯度成正比，有限接頭不是永久穩態。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 154000 W/m2。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。一維、定導熱係數及瞬時線性溫度梯度；不是完整暫態冷卻解。使用多位置溫度差作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用穩態熱流外推全部冷卻過程會失真，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「等效導熱通量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: One-dimensional heat flux scales with temperature gradient, but a finite joint is not permanently steady. One-dimensional flow with constant conductivity and an instantaneous linear gradient; not a full transient cooling solution. Use temperature differences at several positions as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Extending a steady flux over the entire cooling history distorts energy; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Equivalent conductive heat flux” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 等效導熱通量：失效診斷

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Equivalent conductive heat flux” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用穩態熱流外推全部冷卻過程會失真。這個失效與「等效導熱通量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多位置溫度差，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Extending a steady flux over the entire cooling history distorts energy. This failure and a measurement bias in Equivalent conductive heat flux can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check temperature differences at several positions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用穩態熱流外推全部冷卻過程會失真」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Extending a steady flux over the entire cooling history distorts energy." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 孔隙面積比例：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Void area fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 切片孔隙面積率不能直接當作三維缺陷體積率。本模型把 avoid 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.65 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。分子與分母取自同一切面；不能直接推算三維體積率。使用多切面或不同聲束觀察作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一切面可能避開主要縮孔，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「孔隙面積比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A section void-area fraction is not directly a three-dimensional void-volume fraction. In this model, avoid is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 1.65 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Numerator and denominator use one section; a three-dimensional volume fraction is not directly inferred. Use multiple sections or different beam views as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. One section can miss the main shrinkage void; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Void area fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 孔隙面積比例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Void area fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「孔隙面積比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Void area fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以多切面或不同聲束觀察區分模型與觀察，先用多方向切片影像、像素尺度及孔隙分割紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「孔隙面積比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use multiple sections or different beam views to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using section images in several orientations, pixel calibration and void-segmentation records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Void area fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「孔隙面積比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出分子與分母取自同一切面；不能直接推算三維體積率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由單一切面可能避開主要縮孔造成偏離的合成觀察，以多切面或不同聲束觀察說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Void area fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Numerator and denominator use one section; a three-dimensional volume fraction is not directly inferred. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: One section can miss the main shrinkage void. Explain which evidence in multiple sections or different beam views distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：單一切面可能避開主要縮孔。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: One section can miss the main shrinkage void. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 孔隙面積比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Void area fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「孔隙面積比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Void area fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一切面可能避開主要縮孔。這個失效與「孔隙面積比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查多切面或不同聲束觀察，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One section can miss the main shrinkage void. This failure and a measurement bias in Void area fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check multiple sections or different beam views rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用多切面或不同聲束觀察作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一切面可能避開主要縮孔，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One section can miss the main shrinkage void; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一切面可能避開主要縮孔」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One section can miss the main shrinkage void." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check multiple sections or different beam views rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「孔隙面積比例」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Void area fraction" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
單一切面可能避開主要縮孔。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
One section can miss the main shrinkage void.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress.
quiz.explanation: 單一切面可能避開主要縮孔。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: One section can miss the main shrinkage void. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 有效斷面應力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Effective-section stress: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「有效斷面應力」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Effective-section stress” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 淨截面應力只描述平均量，不包含缺陷尖端應力集中。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 44 MPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。只處理軸向淨截面平均應力；忽略缺陷尖端應力集中。使用缺陷尺寸與軸向載荷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「有效斷面應力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Net-section stress describes an average and excludes defect-tip concentration. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 44 MPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Only axial net-section average stress is included; defect-tip stress concentration is excluded. Use defect dimensions and axial load as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A small-area crack can still generate high local stress; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Effective-section stress” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2；y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2; y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「有效斷面應力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Effective-section stress”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 有效斷面應力
knowledge.text: 淨截面應力只描述平均量，不包含缺陷尖端應力集中。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 44 MPa。
knowledge.textEn: Net-section stress describes an average and excludes defect-tip concentration. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「有效斷面應力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Effective-section stress" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振
淨截面應力只描述平均量，不包含缺陷尖端應力集中。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation.
Net-section stress describes an average and excludes defect-tip concentration.
quiz.explanation: 淨截面應力只描述平均量，不包含缺陷尖端應力集中。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Net-section stress describes an average and excludes defect-tip concentration. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 有效斷面應力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Effective-section stress: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「有效斷面應力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Effective-section stress” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2；y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=44 MPa。模型邊界：只處理軸向淨截面平均應力；忽略缺陷尖端應力集中；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2; y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=44 MPa. Boundary: Only axial net-section average stress is included; defect-tip stress concentration is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以缺陷尺寸與軸向載荷區分模型與觀察，先用合成載荷、同截面缺陷幾何及周圍應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use defect dimensions and axial load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2；y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=44 MPa。模型邊界：只處理軸向淨截面平均應力；忽略缺陷尖端應力集中；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2; y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=44 MPa. Boundary: Only axial net-section average stress is included; defect-tip stress concentration is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「有效斷面應力」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Effective-section stress", which statement holds?
options: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2；y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa。

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=300 kN, A=7600 mm2, lost=100 mm2; y=F*1000/(A-lost)=40 MPa. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Effective-section stress” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以缺陷尺寸與軸向載荷區分模型與觀察，先用合成載荷、同截面缺陷幾何及周圍應變建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「有效斷面應力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use defect dimensions and axial load to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic load, defect geometry on the same section and surrounding strain, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Effective-section stress. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「有效斷面應力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出只處理軸向淨截面平均應力；忽略缺陷尖端應力集中如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力造成偏離的合成觀察，以缺陷尺寸與軸向載荷說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

steps.title: 有效斷面應力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Effective-section stress: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「有效斷面應力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Effective-section stress” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力。這個失效與「有效斷面應力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查缺陷尺寸與軸向載荷，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress. This failure and a measurement bias in Effective-section stress can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check defect dimensions and axial load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用缺陷尺寸與軸向載荷作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：小面積裂紋仍可能產生高局部應力」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A small-area crack can still generate high local stress." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check defect dimensions and axial load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation.
A small-area crack can still generate high local stress.

stages.title: 焊頂輪廓坡度與檢測掃描間距
stages.titleEn: Weld crown profile slope & Inspection scan spacing
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「焊頂輪廓坡度」與「檢測掃描間距」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Weld crown profile slope" and "Inspection scan spacing": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 焊頂輪廓坡度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Weld crown profile slope: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「焊頂輪廓坡度」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Weld crown profile slope” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輪廓斜率將表面高差和過渡長度連結。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 mrad。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。高差相對過渡長度很小；結果是幾何斜率而非輪軌衝擊力。使用接頭連續縱向掃描作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「焊頂輪廓坡度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Profile slope links surface height difference with transition length. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 mrad. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Height difference is small relative to transition length; the result is geometric slope rather than wheel impact force. Use continuous longitudinal scans across the joint as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Weld crown profile slope” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm；y=h/L*1000=2 mrad。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm; y=h/L*1000=2 mrad.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「焊頂輪廓坡度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Weld crown profile slope”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 焊頂輪廓坡度
knowledge.text: 輪廓斜率將表面高差和過渡長度連結。本模型把 h 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 mrad。
knowledge.textEn: Profile slope links surface height difference with transition length. In this model, h is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「焊頂輪廓坡度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Weld crown profile slope" is correct?
options: 輪廓斜率將表面高差和過渡長度連結。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振

optionsEn: Profile slope links surface height difference with transition length.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage.

steps.title: 焊頂輪廓坡度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Weld crown profile slope: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「焊頂輪廓坡度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Weld crown profile slope” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm；y=h/L*1000=2 mrad。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.2 mrad。模型邊界：高差相對過渡長度很小；結果是幾何斜率而非輪軌衝擊力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm; y=h/L*1000=2 mrad. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 mrad. Boundary: Height difference is small relative to transition length; the result is geometric slope rather than wheel impact force; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以接頭連續縱向掃描區分模型與觀察，先用連續輪廓掃描、標距及重複掃描的定位誤差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use continuous longitudinal scans across the joint to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm；y=h/L*1000=2 mrad。只把 h 增加百分之十，y=2.2 mrad。模型邊界：高差相對過渡長度很小；結果是幾何斜率而非輪軌衝擊力；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm; y=h/L*1000=2 mrad. Increasing only h with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 mrad. Boundary: Height difference is small relative to transition length; the result is geometric slope rather than wheel impact force; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「焊頂輪廓坡度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Weld crown profile slope", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略潛熱會誤判冷卻時間
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm；y=h/L*1000=2 mrad。

Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm; y=h/L*1000=2 mrad.

quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm；y=h/L*1000=2 mrad。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: h=0.2 mm, L=100 mm; y=h/L*1000=2 mrad. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 焊頂輪廓坡度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Weld crown profile slope: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「焊頂輪廓坡度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Weld crown profile slope” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以接頭連續縱向掃描區分模型與觀察，先用連續輪廓掃描、標距及重複掃描的定位誤差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「焊頂輪廓坡度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use continuous longitudinal scans across the joint to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using continuous profile scan, gauge length and repeat-scan registration error, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Weld crown profile slope. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「焊頂輪廓坡度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出高差相對過渡長度很小；結果是幾何斜率而非輪軌衝擊力如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振造成偏離的合成觀察，以接頭連續縱向掃描說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Weld crown profile slope, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Height difference is small relative to transition length; the result is geometric slope rather than wheel impact force. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation. Explain which evidence in continuous longitudinal scans across the joint distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 焊頂輪廓坡度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Weld crown profile slope: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「焊頂輪廓坡度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Weld crown profile slope” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振。這個失效與「焊頂輪廓坡度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接頭連續縱向掃描，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation. This failure and a measurement bias in Weld crown profile slope can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check continuous longitudinal scans across the joint rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用接頭連續縱向掃描作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同高差在更短距離內形成更尖銳激振」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: The same height difference over a shorter distance creates sharper excitation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

steps.title: 檢測掃描間距：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Inspection scan spacing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「檢測掃描間距」如何影響鋼軌鋁熱焊接的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Inspection scan spacing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Aluminothermic rail welding”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 掃描速度除量測頻率給出沿程點距，細點距仍不保證可檢出。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測。使用編碼器與取樣時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「檢測掃描間距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Scan speed divided by acquisition rate gives spatial spacing, though fine spacing alone does not guarantee detection. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.55 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded. Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Inspection scan spacing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz；y=v/f=0.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz; y=v/f=0.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「檢測掃描間距」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Inspection scan spacing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 檢測掃描間距
knowledge.text: 掃描速度除量測頻率給出沿程點距，細點距仍不保證可檢出。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.55 mm。

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

Scan speed divided by acquisition rate gives spatial spacing, though fine spacing alone does not guarantee detection.

quiz.explanation: 掃描速度除量測頻率給出沿程點距，細點距仍不保證可檢出。 其餘選項是常見誤解。

steps.title: 檢測掃描間距：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Inspection scan spacing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「檢測掃描間距」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inspection scan spacing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz；y=v/f=0.5 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.55 mm。模型邊界：速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz; y=v/f=0.5 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 mm. Boundary: Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以編碼器與取樣時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用編碼器位置、逐點時間戳與實際取得資料的點數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz；y=v/f=0.5 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=0.55 mm。模型邊界：速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=50 mm/s, f=100 Hz; y=v/f=0.5 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.55 mm. Boundary: Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.title: 檢測掃描間距：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Inspection scan spacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「檢測掃描間距」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inspection scan spacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以編碼器與取樣時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用編碼器位置、逐點時間戳與實際取得資料的點數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢測掃描間距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using encoder positions, individual timestamps and actual acquired point counts, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection scan spacing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「檢測掃描間距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符造成偏離的合成觀察，以編碼器與取樣時間戳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection scan spacing, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. Explain which evidence in encoder positions and sampling timestamps distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.
