knowledge.text: 本單元以編碼器與取樣時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用編碼器位置、逐點時間戳與實際取得資料的點數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢測掃描間距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using encoder positions, individual timestamps and actual acquired point counts, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection scan spacing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「檢測掃描間距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出速度與取樣率恆定且時間同步；不含聲束寬度及漏測如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符造成偏離的合成觀察，以編碼器與取樣時間戳說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection scan spacing, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Speed and sampling rate are constant and synchronized; beam width and missed acquisitions are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. Explain which evidence in encoder positions and sampling timestamps distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「檢測掃描間距」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Inspection scan spacing"?
options: 本單元以編碼器與取樣時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用編碼器位置、逐點時間戳與實際取得資料的點數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一切面可能避開主要縮孔
optionsEn: Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One section can miss the main shrinkage void.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以編碼器與取樣時間戳區分模型與觀察，先用編碼器位置、逐點時間戳與實際取得資料的點數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use encoder positions and sampling timestamps to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢測掃描間距：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspection scan spacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢測掃描間距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inspection scan spacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符。這個失效與「檢測掃描間距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查編碼器與取樣時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection scan spacing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check encoder positions and sampling timestamps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用編碼器與取樣時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符。這個失效與「檢測掃描間距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查編碼器與取樣時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection scan spacing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check encoder positions and sampling timestamps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢測掃描間距」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Inspection scan spacing" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：外部餘料混入有效體積會高估接頭補入量
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Including surplus in effective volume overstates useful joint fill.
quiz.explanation: 編碼器打滑會讓名義覆蓋與實際覆蓋不符。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Encoder slip separates nominal coverage from actual coverage. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 軌道道碴搗固整正
summary: 軌道道碴搗固整正以「道碴重排支承恢復與幾何保真」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。搗固把道碴重新配置到軌枕下方以恢復支承，起道後的幾何和重載後的幾何並非同一件事；必須把短期整正與長期沉陷追蹤連在一起。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops ballast rearrangement support recovery and geometry fidelity through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Tamping rearranges ballast beneath sleepers to restore support, but geometry immediately after lifting differs from geometry after traffic; short-term correction must therefore be connected with settlement monitoring. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s；y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h。只把 sleepers 增加一個整數單位，y=1350 sleepers/h。模型邊界：每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.5 m2, gap=0.004 m；y=A*gap*1000=2 litre。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=2.2 litre。模型邊界：空隙以面積上的平均值代表；不描述局部懸空或顆粒排列；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s; y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h. Increasing only sleepers with an increase of one whole unit gives y=1350 sleepers/h. Boundary: Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.5 m2, gap=0.004 m; y=A*gap*1000=2 litre. Increasing only A with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 litre. Boundary: Gap is represented by its area-average value; local voids and particle arrangement are not resolved; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 搗固循環產能與軌枕底空隙量
stages.titleEn: Tamping cycle productivity & Under-sleeper void volume
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「搗固循環產能」與「軌枕底空隙量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Tamping cycle productivity" and "Under-sleeper void volume": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 搗固循環產能：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Tamping cycle productivity: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「搗固循環產能」如何影響軌道道碴搗固整正的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Tamping cycle productivity” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast tamping and track alignment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 單循環處理數乘循環頻率只是理想產能。本模型把 sleepers 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 1350 sleepers/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能。使用實際循環與停機時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「搗固循環產能」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Units per cycle times cycle frequency gives ideal productivity only. In this model, sleepers is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 1350 sleepers/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only. Use actual cycles and downtime as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Tamping cycle productivity” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s；y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s; y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「搗固循環產能」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Tamping cycle productivity”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 搗固循環產能
knowledge.text: 單循環處理數乘循環頻率只是理想產能。本模型把 sleepers 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 1350 sleepers/h。
knowledge.textEn: Units per cycle times cycle frequency gives ideal productivity only. In this model, sleepers is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「搗固循環產能」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Tamping cycle productivity" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能
單循環處理數乘循環頻率只是理想產能。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均空隙會掩蓋局部懸空
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity.
Units per cycle times cycle frequency gives ideal productivity only.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An average gap hides local unsupported regions.
quiz.explanation: 單循環處理數乘循環頻率只是理想產能。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Units per cycle times cycle frequency gives ideal productivity only. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 搗固循環產能：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Tamping cycle productivity: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「搗固循環產能」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Tamping cycle productivity” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s；y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h。只把 sleepers 增加一個整數單位，y=1350 sleepers/h。模型邊界：每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: sleepers=2 count, cycle=8 s; y=sleepers*3600/cycle=900 sleepers/h. steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Tamping cycle productivity” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以實際循環與停機時間區分模型與觀察，先用合成循環起訖時間、每次軌枕數及停機原因帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「搗固循環產能」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use actual cycles and downtime to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic cycle start-end times, sleeper counts and downtime records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Tamping cycle productivity. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「搗固循環產能」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出每循環處理數固定且無停機；僅為理想連續產能如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能造成偏離的合成觀察，以實際循環與停機時間說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Tamping cycle productivity, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Fixed units per cycle and no downtime; ideal continuous throughput only. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity. Explain which evidence in actual cycles and downtime distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Tamping cycle productivity” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能。這個失效與「搗固循環產能」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查實際循環與停機時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity. This failure and a measurement bias in Tamping cycle productivity can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check actual cycles and downtime rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用實際循環與停機時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略定位與等待會高估施工產能」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting positioning and waiting overstates productivity." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 軌枕底空隙量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「軌枕底空隙量」如何影響軌道道碴搗固整正的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Under-sleeper void volume” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast tamping and track alignment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 面積乘平均空隙描述需重新支承的體積量級。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 litre。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。空隙以面積上的平均值代表；不描述局部懸空或顆粒排列。使用支承接觸與空隙剖面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；平均空隙會掩蓋局部懸空，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軌枕底空隙量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Area times average gap describes the volume scale requiring renewed support. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 litre. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Gap is represented by its area-average value; local voids and particle arrangement are not resolved. Use support contact and gap profile as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An average gap hides local unsupported regions; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Under-sleeper void volume” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.5 m2, gap=0.004 m；y=A*gap*1000=2 litre。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.5 m2, gap=0.004 m; y=A*gap*1000=2 litre.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：平均空隙會掩蓋局部懸空」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.instructionEn: An average gap hides local unsupported regions. This failure and a measurement bias in Under-sleeper void volume can produce similar symptoms. steps.instruction: 平均壓力不能代表個別顆粒接觸點壓力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 440 kPa。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。名義接觸面積已知且合力準靜態；不代表顆粒點接觸應力。使用力與接觸範圍作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；顆粒破碎會改變粒徑與長期支承，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「擠壓平均接觸壓」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean pressure does not represent individual grain-contact pressure. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 440 kPa. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Nominal area is known and resultant force quasistatic; particle point-contact stresses are not represented. Use force and contact extent as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Grain crushing changes grading and long-term support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean squeeze contact pressure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

Use force-displacement loops as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. steps.instruction: 本單元以力位移迴圈區分模型與觀察，先用模型同步力位移取樣與迴圈積分建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「模型擠壓作功」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use force-displacement loops to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synchronized model force-displacement samples and loop integration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Model squeeze work. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「模型擠壓作功」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出力是行程內的代表平均值；只算外部機械作功如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由無效摩擦耗能會使高作功不代表高品質造成偏離的合成觀察，以力位移迴圈說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Unproductive friction means high work does not prove quality. steps.failure: 注意干擾：無效摩擦耗能會使高作功不代表高品質。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unproductive friction means high work does not prove quality. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 模型擠壓作功：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Model squeeze work: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「模型擠壓作功」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Model squeeze work” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 無效摩擦耗能會使高作功不代表高品質。這個失效與「模型擠壓作功」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查力位移迴圈，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unproductive friction means high work does not prove quality. This failure and a measurement bias in Model squeeze work can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check force-displacement loops rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用力位移迴圈作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；無效摩擦耗能會使高作功不代表高品質，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unproductive friction means high work does not prove quality; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：無效摩擦耗能會使高作功不代表高品質」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unproductive friction means high work does not prove quality." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 頻率乘持續時間給出循環次數，不等同填充程度。本模型把 f 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 46.2 cycles。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。頻率固定且無中斷；循環數不代表填充品質。使用振動與填充位移作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重複振動可能只磨耗顆粒而未改善支承，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「振動週期次數」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Frequency times duration gives cycle count, not degree of filling. In this model, f is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 46.2 cycles. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Frequency is constant without interruption; cycle count does not establish filling quality. Use vibration and filling movement as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Repeated vibration may abrade grains without improving support; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Vibration cycle count” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instructionEn: A moving datum corrupts the inferred lift. This failure and a measurement bias in Lift allocation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check before-and-after levels on the same datum rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：基準移動會使起道量失真」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 細料累積會使整正後仍持續軟化。這個失效與「道碴橫向排水」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查水頭差與排出流量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Fines accumulation can sustain softening after geometric correction. This failure and a measurement bias in Ballast lateral drainage scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check head difference and discharged flow rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.title: 支承剛度回復：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Support stiffness recovery” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast tamping and track alignment”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 載重位移斜率描述支承剛度而非單純高度。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 27.5 kN/mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。力位移由共同零點計算割線剛度；不把它當非線性切線剛度。使用重複模型載重曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同一高程可能隱藏不同承載剛度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承剛度回復」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Load-displacement slope characterizes support stiffness rather than height alone. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 27.5 kN/mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Force and displacement from one origin give secant stiffness, not nonlinear tangent stiffness. Use repeated model loading curves as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. The same elevation can conceal different support stiffnesses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Support stiffness recovery” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 本單元以逐點殘差與位置區分模型與觀察，先用逐點里程、高程殘差及感測器零點紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「幾何殘差均方根」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use pointwise residuals and positions to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.title: 幾何殘差均方根：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Geometry residual RMS: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「幾何殘差均方根」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Geometry residual RMS” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷。這個失效與「幾何殘差均方根」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查逐點殘差與位置，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: One average quality score hides localized defects. This failure and a measurement bias in Geometry residual RMS can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check pointwise residuals and positions rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用逐點殘差與位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: One average quality score hides localized defects; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：單一平均品質指標會掩蓋尖峰缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: One average quality score hides localized defects." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

title: 道碴清篩與再利用
summary: 道碴清篩與再利用以「粒徑分離再利用物料帳與排水性能」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。清篩將受污染道碴分成可再用粗料與廢細料，回收比例不能取代粒形、強度及排水驗證；含水率和顆粒損傷會影響質量帳的解讀。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops gradation separation reuse mass accounts and drainage performance through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Cleaning separates fouled ballast into reusable coarse material and discarded fines, but recovery fraction cannot replace checks on particle shape, strength and drainage; moisture and particle damage affect the mass account. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。只把 feed 增加百分之十，y=13 t。模型邊界：各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：reusable=72 t, feed=100 t；y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent。只把 reusable 增加百分之十，y=79.2 percent。模型邊界：可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t. Increasing only feed with a ten-percent increase gives y=13 t. Boundary: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: reusable=72 t, feed=100 t; y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent. Increasing only reusable with a ten-percent increase gives y=79.2 percent. Boundary: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 清篩質量守恆與可再用材料比例
stages.titleEn: Cleaning mass conservation & Reusable material fraction

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Cleaning mass conservation" and "Reusable material fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 清篩質量守恆：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Cleaning mass conservation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「清篩質量守恆」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Cleaning mass conservation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 輸入減已知輸出應對應存量變化與量測差。本模型把 feed 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13 t。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化。使用各料流同步乾質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「清篩質量守恆」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Input minus known outputs corresponds to inventory change and measurement discrepancy. In this model, feed is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13 t. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change. Use synchronized dry mass in each material stream as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Cleaning mass conservation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Cleaning mass conservation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t；y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t。只把 feed 增加百分之十，y=13 t。模型邊界：各料流均為同時間窗乾質量；差額包含存量變化；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: feed=100 t, coarse=72 t, fines=25 t; y=feed-coarse-fines=3 t. Increasing only feed with a ten-percent increase gives y=13 t. Boundary: All streams use dry mass over the same time window; the residual includes inventory change; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以各料流同步乾質量區分模型與觀察，先用同步料流秤重、含水率修正及設備內存料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Cleaning mass conservation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以各料流同步乾質量區分模型與觀察，先用同步料流秤重、含水率修正及設備內存料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「清篩質量守恆」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「清篩質量守恆」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 未記錄存料會把正常暫存當成損耗。這個失效與「清篩質量守恆」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各料流同步乾質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded inventory makes temporary storage appear as loss. This failure and a measurement bias in Cleaning mass conservation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check synchronized dry mass in each material stream rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Reusable material fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：reusable=72 t, feed=100 t；y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent。只把 reusable 增加百分之十，y=79.2 percent。模型邊界：可再用質量已通過另列的材料檢查；比例不是檢驗合格概率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: reusable=72 t, feed=100 t; y=reusable/feed*100=72 percent. Increasing only reusable with a ten-percent increase gives y=79.2 percent. Boundary: Reusable mass has passed separate property checks; the ratio is not a probability of acceptance; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以粗料質量與獨立性能試驗區分模型與觀察，先用乾質量秤重、粒形與強度試驗的批次對照建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Reusable material fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以粗料質量與獨立性能試驗區分模型與觀察，先用乾質量秤重、粒形與強度試驗的批次對照建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「可再用材料比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use coarse mass and independent property tests to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A high recovery fraction may retain weak particles. Explain which evidence in coarse mass and independent property tests distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A high recovery fraction may retain weak particles. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Reusable material fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒。這個失效與「可再用材料比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查粗料質量與獨立性能試驗，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A high recovery fraction may retain weak particles. This failure and a measurement bias in Reusable material fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check coarse mass and independent property tests rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用粗料質量與獨立性能試驗作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高回收率也可能保留脆弱顆粒，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.title: 補充新道碴需求：機制與系統路徑

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fresh ballast requirement” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 需求扣除合格回料才得到新料需求。本模型把 demand 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 32.5 t。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。需求不少於合格回料且兩者同為乾質量；超額回料另列存量。使用可用回料與設計斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「補充新道碴需求」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Fresh demand is required material minus qualified recovered material. In this model, demand is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 32.5 t. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Demand is at least qualified recovery and both are dry mass; surplus recovery is separate inventory. Use usable recovered material and required section as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating all coarse material as qualified understates fresh demand; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fresh ballast requirement” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 把全部粗料視為合格會低估新料。這個失效與「補充新道碴需求」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查可用回料與設計斷面，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating all coarse material as qualified understates fresh demand. This failure and a measurement bias in Fresh ballast requirement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check usable recovered material and required section rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.instructionEn: For moisture content on a dry-mass basis, divide wet mass by one plus moisture ratio. In this model, wet is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 110 kg. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Moisture is water mass divided by dry-solid mass; sampled moisture is representative. Use wet mass and mass after drying as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Mixing wet-basis and dry-basis moisture corrupts mass balance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Moisture dry-mass conversion” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Bulk-volume conversion” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=40 t, bulk=1.6 t/m3；y=mass/bulk=25 m3。只把 mass 增加百分之十，y=27.5 m3。模型邊界：散裝密度適用同含水率及堆積狀態；不使用岩石本體密度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=40 t, bulk=1.6 t/m3; y=mass/bulk=25 m3. Increasing only mass with a ten-percent increase gives y=27.5 m3. Boundary: Bulk density applies to the same moisture and packing state; solid-rock density is not used; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以料斗體積與質量區分模型與觀察，先用已知容積容器、批次秤重及堆積狀態影像建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use hopper volume and mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 散裝體積換算：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「散裝體積換算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Bulk-volume conversion” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以料斗體積與質量區分模型與觀察，先用已知容積容器、批次秤重及堆積狀態影像建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「散裝體積換算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use hopper volume and mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using known-volume container, batch weighing and packing-state images, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Bulk-volume conversion. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「散裝體積換算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出散裝密度適用同含水率及堆積狀態；不使用岩石本體密度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積造成偏離的合成觀察，以料斗體積與質量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Bulk-volume conversion, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Bulk density applies to the same moisture and packing state; solid-rock density is not used. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume. Explain which evidence in hopper volume and mass distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 散裝體積換算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Bulk-volume conversion: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「散裝體積換算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Bulk-volume conversion” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積。這個失效與「散裝體積換算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查料斗體積與質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume. This failure and a measurement bias in Bulk-volume conversion can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check hopper volume and mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用料斗體積與質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用岩石密度會低估運輸與暫存體積」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Solid-rock density understates transport and storage volume." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check hopper volume and mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production.

stages.title: 清篩處理速率與細料新增損傷
stages.titleEn: Screening throughput & New fines from breakage
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「清篩處理速率」與「細料新增損傷」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Screening throughput" and "New fines from breakage": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 清篩處理速率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Screening throughput: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「清篩處理速率」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Screening throughput” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 物料處理率需明確時間窗並扣除等待。本模型把 mass 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 176 t/h。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。質量與時間窗一致；說明時間是否包含等待與維修。使用連續秤重與運轉時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短時峰值不代表整班處理量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「清篩處理速率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Processing rate needs a defined time window and treatment of waiting. In this model, mass is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 176 t/h. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included. Use continuous weighing and operating time as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A short peak rate does not represent shift production; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Screening throughput” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=80 t, time=0.5 h；y=mass/time=160 t/h。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=80 t, time=0.5 h; y=mass/time=160 t/h.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短時峰值不代表整班處理量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「清篩處理速率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Screening throughput”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Processing rate needs a defined time window and treatment of waiting. In this model, mass is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Screening throughput” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：mass=80 t, time=0.5 h；y=mass/time=160 t/h。只把 mass 增加百分之十，y=176 t/h。模型邊界：質量與時間窗一致；說明時間是否包含等待與維修；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: mass=80 t, time=0.5 h; y=mass/time=160 t/h. Increasing only mass with a ten-percent increase gives y=176 t/h. Boundary: Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以連續秤重與運轉時間區分模型與觀察，先用連續皮帶秤、起訖時間戳與設備狀態記錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Screening throughput” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以連續秤重與運轉時間區分模型與觀察，先用連續皮帶秤、起訖時間戳與設備狀態記錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「清篩處理速率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use continuous weighing and operating time to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using continuous belt-scale readings, start-end timestamps and equipment-state log, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Screening throughput. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「清篩處理速率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出質量與時間窗一致；說明時間是否包含等待與維修如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由短時峰值不代表整班處理量造成偏離的合成觀察，以連續秤重與運轉時間說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Screening throughput, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Mass and time window agree; state whether waiting and maintenance are included. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production. Explain which evidence in continuous weighing and operating time distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：短時峰值不代表整班處理量。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: A short peak rate does not represent shift production. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 清篩處理速率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Screening throughput: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「清篩處理速率」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Screening throughput” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 短時峰值不代表整班處理量。這個失效與「清篩處理速率」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查連續秤重與運轉時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: A short peak rate does not represent shift production. This failure and a measurement bias in Screening throughput can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check continuous weighing and operating time rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用連續秤重與運轉時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；短時峰值不代表整班處理量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A short peak rate does not represent shift production; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：短時峰值不代表整班處理量」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A short peak rate does not represent shift production." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 細料新增損傷：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: New fines from breakage: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「細料新增損傷」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “New fines from breakage” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 前後細料差可檢查清篩過程是否產生額外破碎。本模型把 before 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 3.5 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。前後樣本來自同批並使用同一篩界；沒有外來細料加入。使用同批料前後粒徑作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同取樣位置會被誤認為破碎增量，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「細料新增損傷」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Change in fines checks whether processing generated additional breakage. In this model, before is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 3.5 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Before-after samples share a batch and sieve boundary; no external fines are added. Use before-and-after grading of the same batch as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different sampling positions can imitate breakage growth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “New fines from breakage” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：before=5 kg, after=9 kg, total=100 kg；y=(after-before)/total*100=4 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: before=5 kg, after=9 kg, total=100 kg; y=(after-before)/total*100=4 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同取樣位置會被誤認為破碎增量」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Different sampling positions can imitate breakage growth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「細料新增損傷」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “New fines from breakage”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 流量反算滲透率須記錄水力梯度與試體斷面。本模型把 Q 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.011 m/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。飽和穩態達西滲流且無側漏；結果是試體等效滲透率。使用水頭與流量穩定區段作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「滲透流量比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Inferring permeability from flow requires hydraulic gradient and specimen area. In this model, Q is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.011 m/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability. Use stable intervals of head and flow as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Permeability flow comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Permeability flow comparison” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：Q=0.0001 m3/s, A=0.02 m2, i=0.5 1；y=Q/(A*i)=0.01 m/s。只把 Q 增加百分之十，y=0.011 m/s。模型邊界：飽和穩態達西滲流且無側漏；結果是試體等效滲透率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: Q=0.0001 m3/s, A=0.02 m2, i=0.5 1; y=Q/(A*i)=0.01 m/s. Increasing only Q with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.011 m/s. Boundary: Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以水頭與流量穩定區段區分模型與觀察，先用穩定水頭時間序列、試體斷面與定時排水量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use stable intervals of head and flow to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 滲透流量比較：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「滲透流量比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Permeability flow comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以水頭與流量穩定區段區分模型與觀察，先用穩定水頭時間序列、試體斷面與定時排水量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「滲透流量比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use stable intervals of head and flow to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using stable head history, specimen area and timed discharge volume, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Permeability flow comparison. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「滲透流量比較」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出飽和穩態達西滲流且無側漏；結果是試體等效滲透率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態造成偏離的合成觀察，以水頭與流量穩定區段說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Permeability flow comparison, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Saturated steady Darcy flow without side leakage; the result is specimen-equivalent permeability. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. Explain which evidence in stable intervals of head and flow distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 滲透流量比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Permeability flow comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「滲透流量比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Permeability flow comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態。這個失效與「滲透流量比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查水頭與流量穩定區段，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow. This failure and a measurement bias in Permeability flow comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check stable intervals of head and flow rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用水頭與流量穩定區段作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：空氣滯留會使初期流量不能代表穩態」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Trapped air makes initial flow unrepresentative of steady flow." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.
