steps.title: 未回收物料比例：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「未回收物料比例」如何影響道碴清篩與再利用的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Unrecovered material fraction” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ballast cleaning and reuse”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 未回收量可以包含秤重誤差、濺散與滯留，不能直接判定偷漏。本模型把 lost 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 percent。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因。使用秤重校正與存量盤點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「未回收物料比例」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecovered quantity can include weighing error, spillage and retained inventory; it does not identify a cause by itself. In this model, lost is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.3 percent. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause. Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Unrecovered material fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：lost=3 t, feed=100 t；y=lost/feed*100=3 percent。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: lost=3 t, feed=100 t; y=lost/feed*100=3 percent.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「未回收物料比例」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Unrecovered material fraction” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：lost=3 t, feed=100 t；y=lost/feed*100=3 percent。只把 lost 增加百分之十，y=3.3 percent。模型邊界：分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: lost=3 t, feed=100 t; y=lost/feed*100=3 percent. Increasing only lost with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.3 percent. Boundary: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以秤重校正與存量盤點區分模型與觀察，先用各秤重點校準、容器殘料與物料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「未回收物料比例」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Unrecovered material fraction” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以秤重校正與存量盤點區分模型與觀察，先用各秤重點校準、容器殘料與物料盤點建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「未回收物料比例」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use scale calibration and inventory reconciliation to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using calibration at each scale, retained container material and inventory count, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Unrecovered material fraction. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「未回收物料比例」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出分母與差額採同一批次乾質量；比例本身不判定差額原因如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題造成偏離的合成觀察，以秤重校正與存量盤點說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Unrecovered material fraction, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Denominator and residual share one batch and dry-mass basis; the ratio does not identify the cause. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. Explain which evidence in scale calibration and inventory reconciliation distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 未回收物料比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Unrecovered material fraction: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「未回收物料比例」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Unrecovered material fraction” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題。這個失效與「未回收物料比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查秤重校正與存量盤點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults. This failure and a measurement bias in Unrecovered material fraction can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check scale calibration and inventory reconciliation rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用秤重校正與存量盤點作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Labelling every discrepancy as waste hides measurement faults." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.text: 把所有差額當成廢料會掩蓋量測問題。這個失效與「未回收物料比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查秤重校正與存量盤點，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。

If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: 軌道扣件彈性設計
summary: 軌道扣件彈性設計以「扣件預壓彈性絕緣與疲勞的共同設計」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。扣件同時控制鋼軌位置、提供彈性支承與維持電氣條件，增加夾持力並不保證所有性能改善；墊片、彈條與錨定件的路徑需分開辨認。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops fastener preload resilience insulation and fatigue design through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Fastenings locate the rail, provide resilient support and maintain electrical conditions; increasing clamping force does not improve every property, so pads, clips and anchors need separate load-path interpretation. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm；y=F/d=40 kN/mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=44 kN/mm。模型邊界：從明確零點取得割線剛度；固定溫度及載入速率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k1=25 kN/mm, k2=35 kN/mm；y=k1+k2=60 kN/mm。只把 k1 增加百分之十，y=62.5 kN/mm。模型邊界：兩支承保持接觸且位移相同；各元件線彈性；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=60 kN, d=1.5 mm; y=F/d=40 kN/mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=44 kN/mm. Boundary: Secant stiffness is measured from a defined origin at fixed temperature and loading rate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k1=25 kN/mm, k2=35 kN/mm; y=k1+k2=60 kN/mm. Increasing only k1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=62.5 kN/mm. Boundary: Both supports stay in contact with identical displacement; each component is linearly elastic; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 墊片壓縮剛度與平行支承合成
stages.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness & Parallel support stiffness
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「墊片壓縮剛度」與「平行支承合成」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Pad compression stiffness" and "Parallel support stiffness": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 墊片壓縮剛度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Pad compression stiffness: mechanism and system paths

steps.title: 夾持力平均壓力：定量估算

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Clamping mean pressure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=20 kN, A=2000 mm2；y=F*1000/A=10 MPa。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=11 MPa。模型邊界：接觸面積與夾持合力已知；忽略局部邊緣峰值；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=20 kN, A=2000 mm2; y=F*1000/A=10 MPa. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=11 MPa. Boundary: Contact area and clamp resultant are known; local edge peaks are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以接觸印跡與力區分模型與觀察，先用模型夾持力、壓敏印跡及偏心位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Clamping mean pressure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以接觸印跡與力區分模型與觀察，先用模型夾持力、壓敏印跡及偏心位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「夾持力平均壓力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use contact imprint and force to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Clamping mean pressure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 偏斜安裝造成局部壓力集中。這個失效與「夾持力平均壓力」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查接觸印跡與力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Skew installation concentrates local pressure. This failure and a measurement bias in Clamping mean pressure can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check contact imprint and force rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 塑性變形使能量不再完全可回復。這個失效與「彈條位移能量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查卸載回復曲線，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Plastic deformation makes stored work partly irrecoverable. This failure and a measurement bias in Clip elastic energy can produce similar symptoms. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Lateral shear displacement” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=12 kN, k=8 kN/mm；y=F/k=1.5 mm。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=1.65 mm。模型邊界：使用橫向集中剛度且保持接觸；不以垂向剛度替代；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=12 kN, k=8 kN/mm; y=F/k=1.5 mm. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.65 mm. Boundary: Lateral lumped stiffness is used with maintained contact; vertical stiffness is not substituted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以橫向載入位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型橫向力、相對滑移與軌距方向位移建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Lateral shear displacement” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以橫向載入位移區分模型與觀察，先用模型橫向力、相對滑移與軌距方向位移建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「橫向剪切變形」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use displacement under lateral loading to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model lateral force, relative slip and gauge-direction displacement, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Lateral shear displacement. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Using vertical stiffness misestimates gauge movement. Explain which evidence in displacement under lateral loading distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：沿用垂向剛度會誤估軌距變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Using vertical stiffness misestimates gauge movement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「橫向剪切變形」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。

steps.instruction: 沿用垂向剛度會誤估軌距變化。這個失效與「橫向剪切變形」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查橫向載入位移，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Using vertical stiffness misestimates gauge movement. This failure and a measurement bias in Lateral shear displacement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check displacement under lateral loading rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.instruction: 線性累積損傷是教學近似而非普遍壽命定律。本模型把 n1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.21 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。各級壽命值已另給且採線性累積；忽略載入順序與交互作用。使用載重幅值分組與循環數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略載入順序與腐蝕會低估實際疲勞，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「循環損傷指標」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n1=100000 cycles, N1=1000000 cycles, n2=200000 cycles, N2=2000000 cycles；y=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.2 1。只把 n1 增加百分之十，y=0.21 1。模型邊界：各級壽命值已另給且採線性累積；忽略載入順序與交互作用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: n1=100000 cycles, N1=1000000 cycles, n2=200000 cycles, N2=2000000 cycles; y=n1/N1+n2/N2=0.2 1. Increasing only n1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.21 1. Boundary: Life values for each amplitude are supplied separately and damage accumulates linearly; sequence and interaction are omitted; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以載重幅值分組與循環數區分模型與觀察，先用合成載荷幅值直方圖、循環數與各級壽命曲線建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「循環損傷指標」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use load-amplitude groups and cycle counts to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Ignoring load sequence and corrosion understates actual fatigue. Explain which evidence in load-amplitude groups and cycle counts distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：忽略載入順序與腐蝕會低估實際疲勞。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Ignoring load sequence and corrosion understates actual fatigue. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 循環損傷指標：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「循環損傷指標」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Cycle damage index” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略載入順序與腐蝕會低估實際疲勞。這個失效與「循環損傷指標」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查載重幅值分組與循環數，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring load sequence and corrosion understates actual fatigue. This failure and a measurement bias in Cycle damage index can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check load-amplitude groups and cycle counts rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用載重幅值分組與循環數作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略載入順序與腐蝕會低估實際疲勞，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring load sequence and corrosion understates actual fatigue; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略載入順序與腐蝕會低估實際疲勞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring load sequence and corrosion understates actual fatigue." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

Cross-check load-amplitude groups and cycle counts rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: 浮動式道床減振
summary: 浮動式道床減振以「浮動道床隔振共振及附加質量效應」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。浮動式道床利用彈性支承把軌道質量與基礎分開，低頻共振與高頻隔振同時存在；隔振效果必須指定輸入位置、輸出位置與頻率範圍。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops floating-slab isolation resonance and added-mass effects through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Floating slabs separate track mass from the foundation through resilient supports, creating both low-frequency resonance and high-frequency isolation; performance needs specified input and output positions and frequency range. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=3.33846 Hz。模型邊界：線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, k=4000000 N/m；y=m*g/k*1000=24.525 mm。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=26.9775 mm。模型邊界：重力載荷平均且支承線性；不含動載與限位接觸；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.33846 Hz. Boundary: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, k=4000000 N/m; y=m*g/k*1000=24.525 mm. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=26.9775 mm. Boundary: Gravity load is steady and support linear; dynamic load and travel-stop contact are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 隔振固有頻率與靜載壓縮量
stages.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency & Static support compression
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「隔振固有頻率」與「靜載壓縮量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Isolation natural frequency" and "Static support compression": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「隔振固有頻率」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Isolation natural frequency” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.33846 Hz。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率。使用自由衰減頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承硬化會提高固有頻率，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「隔振固有頻率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.33846 Hz. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped. Use free-decay frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Support hardening raises natural frequency; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Isolation natural frequency” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「隔振固有頻率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Isolation natural frequency”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 隔振固有頻率
knowledge.text: 固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。本模型把 k 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.33846 Hz。
knowledge.textEn: Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. In this model, k is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「隔振固有頻率」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Isolation natural frequency" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承硬化會提高固有頻率
固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承到底會使線性隔振失效
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency.
Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation.
quiz.explanation: 固有頻率由剛度質量比的平方根決定。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Natural frequency follows the square root of stiffness-to-mass ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「隔振固有頻率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Isolation natural frequency” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=3.33846 Hz。模型邊界：線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz. Increasing only k with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.33846 Hz. Boundary: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型質量、靜剛度與經阻尼修正的自由衰減頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=sqrt(k/m)/(2*pi)=3.1831 Hz。只把 k 增加百分之十，y=3.33846 Hz。模型邊界：線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「隔振固有頻率」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Isolation natural frequency” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以自由衰減頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型質量、靜剛度與經阻尼修正的自由衰減頻率建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「隔振固有頻率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use free-decay frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model mass, static stiffness and damping-corrected free-decay frequency, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Isolation natural frequency. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「隔振固有頻率」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出線性單自由度且基礎固定；計算無阻尼固有頻率如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由支承硬化會提高固有頻率造成偏離的合成觀察，以自由衰減頻率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Isolation natural frequency, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Linear single-degree system with a fixed base; the calculated frequency is undamped. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Support hardening raises natural frequency. Explain which evidence in free-decay frequency distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：支承硬化會提高固有頻率。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Support hardening raises natural frequency. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 隔振固有頻率：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Isolation natural frequency: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 靜壓縮提供剛度量級檢查，但不能直接證明動態隔振。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 26.9775 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。重力載荷平均且支承線性；不含動載與限位接觸。使用靜態高度與總載重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承到底會使線性隔振失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「靜載壓縮量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Static compression checks stiffness scale but does not establish dynamic isolation. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 26.9775 mm. Gravity load is steady and support linear; dynamic load and travel-stop contact are excluded. steps.instruction: 支承到底會使線性隔振失效。這個失效與「靜載壓縮量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查靜態高度與總載重，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation. This failure and a measurement bias in Static support compression can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check static height and total load rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用靜態高度與總載重作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；支承到底會使線性隔振失效，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：支承到底會使線性隔振失效」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Bottoming out invalidates linear isolation." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 阻尼比估算與頻率比辨認
stages.titleEn: Damping ratio estimate & Frequency-ratio identification
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「阻尼比估算」與「頻率比辨認」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Damping ratio estimate" and "Frequency-ratio identification": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 阻尼比估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Damping ratio estimate: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「阻尼比估算」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Damping ratio estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 阻尼比將黏性阻尼相對於臨界阻尼正規化。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0825 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。黏性阻尼與線性剛度已知；不把庫侖摩擦視為固定黏性阻尼。使用衰減包絡與頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「阻尼比估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Damping ratio normalizes viscous damping by critical damping. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.0825 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Viscous damping and linear stiffness are known; Coulomb friction is not treated as constant viscous damping. Use decay envelope and frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Damping ratio estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=30000 Ns/m, k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=c/(2*sqrt(k*m))=0.075 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=30000 Ns/m, k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=c/(2*sqrt(k*m))=0.075 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「阻尼比估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Damping ratio estimate”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 阻尼比估算
knowledge.text: 阻尼比將黏性阻尼相對於臨界阻尼正規化。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0825 1。
knowledge.textEn: Damping ratio normalizes viscous damping by critical damping. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

optionsEn: Damping ratio normalizes viscous damping by critical damping.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient.

steps.title: 阻尼比估算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Damping ratio estimate: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「阻尼比估算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Damping ratio estimate” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=30000 Ns/m, k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=c/(2*sqrt(k*m))=0.075 1。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=0.0825 1。模型邊界：黏性阻尼與線性剛度已知；不把庫侖摩擦視為固定黏性阻尼；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=30000 Ns/m, k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg; y=c/(2*sqrt(k*m))=0.075 1. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.0825 1. Boundary: Viscous damping and linear stiffness are known; Coulomb friction is not treated as constant viscous damping; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以衰減包絡與頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型自由衰減包絡、多振幅試驗及頻率估計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use decay envelope and frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=30000 Ns/m, k=4000000 N/m, m=10000 kg；y=c/(2*sqrt(k*m))=0.075 1。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=0.0825 1。模型邊界：黏性阻尼與線性剛度已知；不把庫侖摩擦視為固定黏性阻尼；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Viscous damping and linear stiffness are known; Coulomb friction is not treated as constant viscous damping; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.title: 阻尼比估算：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「阻尼比估算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Damping ratio estimate” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以衰減包絡與頻率區分模型與觀察，先用模型自由衰減包絡、多振幅試驗及頻率估計建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「阻尼比估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use decay envelope and frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model free-decay envelopes, several vibration amplitudes and frequency estimates, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Damping ratio estimate. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「阻尼比估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出黏性阻尼與線性剛度已知；不把庫侖摩擦視為固定黏性阻尼如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示造成偏離的合成觀察，以衰減包絡與頻率說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Damping ratio estimate, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Viscous damping and linear stiffness are known; Coulomb friction is not treated as constant viscous damping. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient. Explain which evidence in decay envelope and frequency distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Damping ratio estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示。這個失效與「阻尼比估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查衰減包絡與頻率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient. This failure and a measurement bias in Damping ratio estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check decay envelope and frequency rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用衰減包絡與頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：摩擦阻尼不一定可由固定黏性係數表示」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Friction damping need not match a fixed viscous coefficient." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.objective: 說明「頻率比辨認」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Frequency-ratio identification” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 激振與固有頻率的比值比任一頻率單獨更有判讀力。本模型把 f 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 8.59375 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。激振為單一頻率且固有頻率採同一工況。使用輸入頻譜與模態頻率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只看峰值幅度會漏掉共振移動，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻率比辨認」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The forcing-to-natural frequency ratio is more informative than either frequency alone. In this model, f is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 8.59375 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Excitation has one frequency and natural frequency uses the same operating condition. Use input spectrum and modal frequency as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Amplitude alone can miss a shifted resonance; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Frequency-ratio identification” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：f=25 Hz, fn=3.2 Hz；y=f/fn=7.8125 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: f=25 Hz, fn=3.2 Hz; y=f/fn=7.8125 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只看峰值幅度會漏掉共振移動」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Amplitude alone can miss a shifted resonance." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「頻率比辨認」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 頻率比辨認：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Frequency-ratio identification: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「頻率比辨認」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Frequency-ratio identification” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：f=25 Hz, fn=3.2 Hz；y=f/fn=7.8125 1。只把 f 增加百分之十，y=8.59375 1。模型邊界：激振為單一頻率且固有頻率採同一工況；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: f=25 Hz, fn=3.2 Hz; y=f/fn=7.8125 1. Increasing only f with a ten-percent increase gives y=8.59375 1. Boundary: Excitation has one frequency and natural frequency uses the same operating condition; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以輸入頻譜與模態頻率區分模型與觀察，先用合成輸入力頻譜、模態試驗與相同載重紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use input spectrum and modal frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Frequency-ratio identification” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以輸入頻譜與模態頻率區分模型與觀察，先用合成輸入力頻譜、模態試驗與相同載重紀錄建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「頻率比辨認」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use input spectrum and modal frequency to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using synthetic input-force spectrum, modal test and matched loading records, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Frequency-ratio identification. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.failure: 注意干擾：只看峰值幅度會漏掉共振移動。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Amplitude alone can miss a shifted resonance. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 力傳遞率估算：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「力傳遞率估算」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Force transmissibility estimate” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 線性力傳遞率含共振分母與阻尼路徑。本模型把 r 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出減少為 0.12088 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。諧波力作用在質塊、基礎固定且線性穩態；不是任意基礎激振公式。使用輸入力與基礎反力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過大阻尼在高頻可增加傳遞，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「力傳遞率估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Linear force transmissibility contains a resonance denominator and damping path. In this model, r is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output decreases to 0.12088 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Harmonic force acts on the mass with a fixed base in linear steady state; not a formula for arbitrary base excitation. Use input force and foundation reaction as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Excess damping can increase high-frequency transmission; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Force transmissibility estimate” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Force transmissibility estimate” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 過大阻尼在高頻可增加傳遞。這個失效與「力傳遞率估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查輸入力與基礎反力，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Excess damping can increase high-frequency transmission. This failure and a measurement bias in Force transmissibility estimate can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check input force and foundation reaction rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用輸入力與基礎反力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；過大阻尼在高頻可增加傳遞，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Excess damping can increase high-frequency transmission; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：過大阻尼在高頻可增加傳遞」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Excess damping can increase high-frequency transmission." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check input force and foundation reaction rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「力傳遞率估算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Force transmissibility estimate" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 症狀相同就代表原因相同，不必用量測區分。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重心偏移使單支承過載
過大阻尼在高頻可增加傳遞。
optionsEn: Identical symptoms always mean identical causes, so no discriminating measurement is needed.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A shifted centre of mass overloads individual supports.
Excess damping can increase high-frequency transmission.

steps.title: 支承數量分力：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Load per isolator: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「支承數量分力」如何影響浮動式道床減振的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Load per isolator” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Floating-slab track vibration isolation”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻分力只適用對稱幾何與重心位置。本模型把 m 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13.4887 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。支承對稱、剛度相同且重心居中；只算靜載。使用各支承壓縮與反力作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；重心偏移使單支承過載，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「支承數量分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal support load requires symmetric geometry and centre of mass. In this model, m is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13.4887 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Supports are symmetric, equally stiff and centered beneath the mass; static load only. Use compression and reaction at each support as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A shifted centre of mass overloads individual supports; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Load per isolator” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, n=8 count；y=m*g/n/1000=12.2625 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, n=8 count; y=m*g/n/1000=12.2625 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：重心偏移使單支承過載」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A shifted centre of mass overloads individual supports." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「支承數量分力」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Load per isolator”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 支承數量分力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Load per isolator: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「支承數量分力」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Load per isolator” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, n=8 count；y=m*g/n/1000=12.2625 kN。只把 m 增加百分之十，y=13.4887 kN。模型邊界：支承對稱、剛度相同且重心居中；只算靜載；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: m=10000 kg, g=9.81 m/s2, n=8 count; y=m*g/n/1000=12.2625 kN. Increasing only m with a ten-percent increase gives y=13.4887 kN. Boundary: Supports are symmetric, equally stiff and centered beneath the mass; static load only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以各支承壓縮與反力區分模型與觀察，先用各支承模型力計、壓縮量及重心位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use compression and reaction at each support to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

Boundary: Supports are symmetric, equally stiff and centered beneath the mass; static load only; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

steps.titleEn: Load per isolator: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「支承數量分力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Load per isolator” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以各支承壓縮與反力區分模型與觀察，先用各支承模型力計、壓縮量及重心位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「支承數量分力」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use compression and reaction at each support to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using individual model support force gauges, compression and center-of-mass location, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Load per isolator. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「支承數量分力」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出支承對稱、剛度相同且重心居中；只算靜載如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由重心偏移使單支承過載造成偏離的合成觀察，以各支承壓縮與反力說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。

Explain which evidence in compression and reaction at each support distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：重心偏移使單支承過載。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

steps.title: 剛度不均分力：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 同位移支承中較硬者承受較大力。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 66 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。剛性板保持兩支承同位移且無轉動；兩者皆接觸。使用支承高度與剛度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只檢查總剛度會漏掉局部過載，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「剛度不均分力」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: The stiffer support carries more force when displacement is shared. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 66 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. A rigid plate maintains identical support displacement without rotation; both supports remain in contact.
