steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Gauge deviation calculation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 軌距偏差需明確量測高度與內側接觸定義。本模型把 measured 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 145.7 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。同一量測高度與內側基準；未將範例參考軌距當作通用規範。使用軌距尺與量測斷面作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同量測高度在磨耗鋼軌上得到不同讀值，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「軌距誤差計算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Gauge deviation needs a defined measurement height and inner-face contact convention. In this model, measured is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 145.7 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. One measurement height and inner-face datum; the example reference gauge is not a universal requirement. Use gauge bar and measurement section as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Different measurement heights give different readings on worn rail; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Gauge deviation calculation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

knowledge.text: 本單元以已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應區分模型與觀察，先用已知振幅波長的模型輪廓及弦端中點座標建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「弦測轉移增益」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。

steps.title: 弦測轉移增益：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Chord transfer gain: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「弦測轉移增益」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Chord transfer gain” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較。這個失效與「弦測轉移增益」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands. This failure and a measurement bias in Chord transfer gain can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check chord response to a known sinusoidal profile rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用已知正弦輪廓的弦測回應作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：未修正轉移函數會扭曲不同波段比較」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring the transfer function distorts comparison across bands." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 局部扭轉估算與離群點比例
stages.titleEn: Local track twist & Outlier fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「局部扭轉估算」與「離群點比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Local track twist" and "Outlier fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 局部扭轉估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Local track twist: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「局部扭轉估算」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Local track twist” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 超高差必須附帶量測基長才能定義扭轉。本模型把 dc 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 mm/m。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉。使用同一基長兩端超高作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「局部扭轉估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Cant difference requires a measurement base to define twist. In this model, dc is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.2 mm/m. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented. Use cant at both ends of one defined base as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Local track twist” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dc=6 mm, base=3 m；y=dc/base=2 mm/m。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dc=6 mm, base=3 m; y=dc/base=2 mm/m.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「局部扭轉估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Local track twist”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 局部扭轉估算
knowledge.text: 超高差必須附帶量測基長才能定義扭轉。本模型把 dc 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.2 mm/m。
knowledge.textEn: Cant difference requires a measurement base to define twist. In this model, dc is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析

steps.title: 局部扭轉估算：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「局部扭轉估算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dc=6 mm, base=3 m；y=dc/base=2 mm/m。只把 dc 增加百分之十，y=2.2 mm/m。模型邊界：兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dc=6 mm, base=3 m; y=dc/base=2 mm/m. Increasing only dc with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.2 mm/m. Boundary: Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以同一基長兩端超高區分模型與觀察，先用同基準雙端超高、基長及正負方向標記建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dc=6 mm, base=3 m；y=dc/base=2 mm/m。只把 dc 增加百分之十，y=2.2 mm/m。模型邊界：兩端超高相減後除同一明確基長；不代表其他基長的扭轉；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「局部扭轉估算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。

steps.instruction: 本單元以同一基長兩端超高區分模型與觀察，先用同基準雙端超高、基長及正負方向標記建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「局部扭轉估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Local track twist, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Endpoint cant difference is divided by one defined base; twist over other bases is not represented. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable. Explain which evidence in cant at both ends of one defined base distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。

Use raw traces and repeat-pass comparison as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Outlier fraction” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.title: 離群點比例：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Outlier fraction: failure diagnosis

steps.instruction: 自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷。這個失效與「離群點比例」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查原始波形與重複通過比對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect. This failure and a measurement bias in Outlier fraction can produce similar symptoms. steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：自動刪除尖峰可能刪掉真正局部缺陷」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Automatic spike removal can erase a real local defect." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 重複通過差值與檢測率統計

steps.title: 重複通過差值：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Repeat-pass difference: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「重複通過差值」如何影響軌道幾何動態檢測的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Repeat-pass difference” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Dynamic track-geometry inspection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 同里程比較前需先校正位置偏移。本模型把 x1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.92 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩次資料已配準至同里程與相同方向；量測條件可比較。使用交叉相關與固定地標作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「重複通過差值」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Repeat-pass comparison needs position registration first. In this model, x1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.92 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions. Use cross-correlation and fixed landmarks as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Repeat-pass difference” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：x1=2.2 mm, x2=1.5 mm；y=x1-x2=0.7 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: x1=2.2 mm, x2=1.5 mm; y=x1-x2=0.7 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.check: 系統圖標明「重複通過差值」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

knowledge.text: 同里程比較前需先校正位置偏移。本模型把 x1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.92 mm。

steps.title: 重複通過差值：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Repeat-pass difference: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「重複通過差值」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Repeat-pass difference” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：x1=2.2 mm, x2=1.5 mm；y=x1-x2=0.7 mm。只把 x1 增加百分之十，y=0.92 mm。模型邊界：兩次資料已配準至同里程與相同方向；量測條件可比較；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: x1=2.2 mm, x2=1.5 mm; y=x1-x2=0.7 mm. Increasing only x1 with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.92 mm. Boundary: Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以交叉相關與固定地標區分模型與觀察，先用固定地標定位、交叉相關位移及配準後殘差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use cross-correlation and fixed landmarks to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以交叉相關與固定地標區分模型與觀察，先用固定地標定位、交叉相關位移及配準後殘差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「重複通過差值」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Repeat-pass difference, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Passes are registered to the same chainage and direction under comparable conditions. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Misregistration makes an unchanged defect appear different. Explain which evidence in cross-correlation and fixed landmarks distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：位置錯位會讓同一缺陷看似變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

options: 本單元以盲測標註與事件配對區分模型與觀察，先用盲測真值表、逐事件判定及漏檢清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
不確定度太難估計，報告中只寫最佳值即可。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：不同基長的扭轉值不可直接替代
optionsEn: Use blinded truth labels and event matching to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
Uncertainty is too hard to estimate, so the report may state only the best value.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Twist values over different bases are not interchangeable.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以盲測標註與事件配對區分模型與觀察，先用盲測真值表、逐事件判定及漏檢清單建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use blinded truth labels and event matching to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 檢測率統計：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Detection recall: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢測率統計」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Detection recall” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。這個失效與「檢測率統計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測標註與事件配對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Counting only reported events hides misses. This failure and a measurement bias in Detection recall can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded truth labels and event matching rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用盲測標註與事件配對作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Counting only reported events hides misses; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Counting only reported events hides misses." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。這個失效與「檢測率統計」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查盲測標註與事件配對，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Counting only reported events hides misses. This failure and a measurement bias in Detection recall can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check blinded truth labels and event matching rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「檢測率統計」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Detection recall" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 先更換最貴的構件；只要症狀消失，就代表已找到根因。
只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略加減速會造成不均勻空間取樣
optionsEn: Replace the most expensive component first; if the symptom disappears, the root cause has been found.
Counting only reported events hides misses.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring acceleration produces uneven spatial sampling.
quiz.explanation: 只統計已報警事件會隱藏漏檢。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Counting only reported events hides misses. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

title: 鋼軌超音波探傷
summary: 鋼軌超音波探傷以「聲程折射耦合盲區與缺陷證據」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。超音波探傷以聲束與缺陷交互作用取得間接證據，耦合、角度和鋼軌幾何會改變回波；沒有回波不能獨立證明沒有裂紋。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops sound paths refraction coupling blind zones and defect evidence through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. Ultrasonic testing obtains indirect evidence from beam-defect interaction; coupling, angle and rail geometry alter echoes, so absence of an echo alone does not prove absence of a crack. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=77.7817 mm。模型邊界：角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm. Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=77.7817 mm. Boundary: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 垂直回波深度與斜入射聲程
stages.titleEn: Normal echo depth & Oblique sound path
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「垂直回波深度」與「斜入射聲程」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Normal echo depth" and "Oblique sound path": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「垂直回波深度」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Normal echo depth” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 64.9 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一。使用已知厚度試塊的回波時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「垂直回波深度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 64.9 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector. Use echo time from a block of known thickness as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Normal echo depth” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「垂直回波深度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Normal echo depth”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 垂直回波深度
knowledge.text: 脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 64.9 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. In this model, c is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「垂直回波深度」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Normal echo depth" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍
脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把聲程直接當深度會錯定位
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth.
Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector.
quiz.explanation: 脈衝回波飛行時間包含往返兩程。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Pulse-echo flight time includes outgoing and returning paths. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「垂直回波深度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Normal echo depth” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use echo time from a block of known thickness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=64.9 mm。模型邊界：聲速均勻、垂直往返聲程且零時已扣除；反射體單一；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Increasing only c with a ten-percent increase gives y=64.9 mm. Boundary: Uniform wave speed, normal round-trip path and corrected time zero; one reflector; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「垂直回波深度」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Normal echo depth", which statement holds?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把波長當檢出保證會高估能力
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊
原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating wavelength as a detection guarantee overstates capability.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively.
Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm.
quiz.explanation: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s；y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm。 重算時請保留單位。
quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: c=5900 m/s, t=0.00002 s; y=c*t/2*1000=59 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 垂直回波深度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「垂直回波深度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Normal echo depth” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以已知厚度試塊的回波時間區分模型與觀察，先用已知厚度教學試塊、零時校準及完整回波波形建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「垂直回波深度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use echo time from a block of known thickness to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 垂直回波深度：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Normal echo depth: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「垂直回波深度」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Normal echo depth” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍。這個失效與「垂直回波深度」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查已知厚度試塊的回波時間，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth. This failure and a measurement bias in Normal echo depth can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check echo time from a block of known thickness rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用已知厚度試塊的回波時間作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忘記除二會把缺陷深度加倍」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Omitting the factor of two doubles inferred depth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.title: 斜入射聲程：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Oblique sound path: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「斜入射聲程」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Oblique sound path” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 斜聲束聲程大於垂向深度。本模型把 depth 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 77.7817 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路。使用折射角與反射體位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把聲程直接當深度會錯定位，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「斜入射聲程」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: An oblique beam travels farther than the vertical depth. In this model, depth is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 77.7817 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated. Use refracted angle and reflector location as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Oblique sound path” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把聲程直接當深度會錯定位」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「斜入射聲程」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Oblique sound path”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth/cos(theta)=70.7107 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=77.7817 mm。模型邊界：角度在材料內相對法線定義；只計單程直線聲路；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=77.7817 mm. Boundary: Angle is measured inside the material from the normal; one straight one-way path is calculated; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 斜入射聲程：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Oblique sound path: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「斜入射聲程」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Oblique sound path” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 把聲程直接當深度會錯定位。這個失效與「斜入射聲程」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查折射角與反射體位置，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector. This failure and a measurement bias in Oblique sound path can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check refracted angle and reflector location rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用折射角與反射體位置作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把聲程直接當深度會錯定位，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：把聲程直接當深度會錯定位」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

stages.title: 水平定位偏距與頻率波長換算
stages.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset & Frequency-wavelength conversion
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「水平定位偏距」與「頻率波長換算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Horizontal reflector offset" and "Frequency-wavelength conversion": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Horizontal reflector offset: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「水平定位偏距」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Horizontal reflector offset” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 反射體水平位置由聲程方向與深度共同決定。本模型把 depth 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 55 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定。使用探頭座標及折射角作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「水平定位偏距」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Horizontal reflector position depends on beam direction and depth. In this model, depth is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 55 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign. Use probe coordinate and refracted angle as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Horizontal reflector offset” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「水平定位偏距」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Horizontal reflector offset”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：定量估算

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad；y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm。只把 depth 增加百分之十，y=55 mm。模型邊界：材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: depth=50 mm, theta=0.7853981633974483 rad; y=depth*sin(theta)/cos(theta)=50 mm. Increasing only depth with a ten-percent increase gives y=55 mm. Boundary: Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以探頭座標及折射角區分模型與觀察，先用探頭固定座標、朝向標記及已知反射體位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use probe coordinate and refracted angle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Horizontal reflector offset” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以探頭座標及折射角區分模型與觀察，先用探頭固定座標、朝向標記及已知反射體位置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「水平定位偏距」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use probe coordinate and refracted angle to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using fixed probe coordinates, orientation markers and known reflector position, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Horizontal reflector offset. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「水平定位偏距」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出材料內直線聲束與平面幾何；正負方向由探頭朝向另定如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側造成偏離的合成觀察，以探頭座標及折射角說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Horizontal reflector offset, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Straight internal beam with planar geometry; probe orientation separately defines the offset sign. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. Explain which evidence in probe coordinate and refracted angle distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 水平定位偏距：失效診斷

steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「水平定位偏距」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Horizontal reflector offset” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側。這個失效與「水平定位偏距」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查探頭座標及折射角，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side. This failure and a measurement bias in Horizontal reflector offset can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check probe coordinate and refracted angle rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用探頭座標及折射角作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：探頭方向標記錯誤會把缺陷投到另一側」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: An incorrect probe orientation projects a defect to the wrong side." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instruction: 波長影響散射與解析度但不是最小必檢裂紋尺寸。本模型把 c 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 1.4212 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。聲速與頻率屬同一波型；忽略色散與寬頻效應。使用頻譜中心與材料聲速作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；把波長當檢出保證會高估能力，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「頻率波長換算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Wavelength affects scattering and resolution but is not the minimum guaranteed detectable crack size. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Speed and frequency describe the same wave mode; dispersion and broadband effects are omitted. Treating wavelength as a detection guarantee overstates capability; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：c=3230 m/s, f=2500000 Hz；y=c/f*1000=1.292 mm。只把 c 增加百分之十，y=1.4212 mm。模型邊界：聲速與頻率屬同一波型；忽略色散與寬頻效應；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.title: 聲幅分貝比較：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Echo-amplitude decibel comparison: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「聲幅分貝比較」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Echo-amplitude decibel comparison” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 相同量測鏈下幅值比才可作有意義比較。本模型把 A 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 -13.1515 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩幅值使用相同接收鏈且參考非零；比較振幅而非能量。使用參考反射體與接收增益作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「聲幅分貝比較」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Amplitude ratios are comparable only within a matched measurement chain. In this model, A is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to -13.1515 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Amplitudes use the same receive chain with nonzero reference; amplitude rather than energy is compared. Use reference reflector and receiver gain as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Echo-amplitude decibel comparison” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.2 1, ref=1 1；y=20*log(A/ref)/log(10)=-13.9794 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: A=0.2 1, ref=1 1; y=20*log(A/ref)/log(10)=-13.9794 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「聲幅分貝比較」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：A=0.2 1, ref=1 1；y=20*log(A/ref)/log(10)=-13.9794 dB。只把 A 增加百分之十，y=-13.1515 dB。模型邊界：兩幅值使用相同接收鏈且參考非零；比較振幅而非能量；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。

steps.title: 聲幅分貝比較：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Echo-amplitude decibel comparison: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「聲幅分貝比較」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Echo-amplitude decibel comparison” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以參考反射體與接收增益區分模型與觀察，先用參考反射體、增益紀錄與未飽和原始回波建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「聲幅分貝比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use reference reflector and receiver gain to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using reference reflector, gain log and unsaturated raw echoes, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Echo-amplitude decibel comparison. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「聲幅分貝比較」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出兩幅值使用相同接收鏈且參考非零；比較振幅而非能量如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化造成偏離的合成觀察，以參考反射體與接收增益說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Echo-amplitude decibel comparison, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Amplitudes use the same receive chain with nonzero reference; amplitude rather than energy is compared. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth. Explain which evidence in reference reflector and receiver gain distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 聲幅分貝比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Echo-amplitude decibel comparison: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「聲幅分貝比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Echo-amplitude decibel comparison” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化。這個失效與「聲幅分貝比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查參考反射體與接收增益，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth. This failure and a measurement bias in Echo-amplitude decibel comparison can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reference reflector and receiver gain rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用參考反射體與接收增益作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：改變增益卻未記錄會形成假缺陷變化」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Unrecorded gain changes mimic defect growth." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

steps.title: 衰減補償量級：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Attenuation compensation scale: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「衰減補償量級」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Attenuation compensation scale” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均勻衰減近似中總衰減隨聲程增加。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 dB。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。衰減係數固定，聲程為完整傳播總長；不另計幾何擴散。使用不同距離參考反射體作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「衰減補償量級」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Under uniform attenuation the loss grows with path length. In this model, alpha is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.3 dB. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Attenuation coefficient is constant and path is the total traveled distance; geometric spreading is separate. Use reference reflectors at different distances as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Attenuation compensation scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.02 dB/mm, path=150 mm；y=alpha*path=3 dB。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.02 dB/mm, path=150 mm; y=alpha*path=3 dB.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「衰減補償量級」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Attenuation compensation scale”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 衰減補償量級
knowledge.text: 均勻衰減近似中總衰減隨聲程增加。本模型把 alpha 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.3 dB。

steps.title: 衰減補償量級：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Attenuation compensation scale: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「衰減補償量級」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Attenuation compensation scale” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：alpha=0.02 dB/mm, path=150 mm；y=alpha*path=3 dB。只把 alpha 增加百分之十，y=3.3 dB。模型邊界：衰減係數固定，聲程為完整傳播總長；不另計幾何擴散；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: alpha=0.02 dB/mm, path=150 mm; y=alpha*path=3 dB. Increasing only alpha with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.3 dB. Boundary: Attenuation coefficient is constant and path is the total traveled distance; geometric spreading is separate; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以不同距離參考反射體區分模型與觀察，先用多聲程參考反射體、同增益回波及傳播路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use reference reflectors at different distances to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

steps.instruction: 本單元以不同距離參考反射體區分模型與觀察，先用多聲程參考反射體、同增益回波及傳播路徑圖建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「衰減補償量級」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use reference reflectors at different distances to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. steps.title: 衰減補償量級：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Attenuation compensation scale: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「衰減補償量級」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Attenuation compensation scale” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊。這個失效與「衰減補償量級」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查不同距離參考反射體，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively. This failure and a measurement bias in Attenuation compensation scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reference reflectors at different distances rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用不同距離參考反射體作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：忽略材質差異會過度補償雜訊」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Ignoring material differences can amplify noise excessively." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check reference reflectors at different distances rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

As long as the structure is still standing, its safety margin must still be adequate.

stages.title: 掃描點距估算與死區相對比例
stages.titleEn: Ultrasonic scan spacing & Dead-zone fraction
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「掃描點距估算」與「死區相對比例」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Ultrasonic scan spacing" and "Dead-zone fraction": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 掃描點距估算：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic scan spacing: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「掃描點距估算」如何影響鋼軌超音波探傷的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Ultrasonic scan spacing” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Ultrasonic rail-flaw detection”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 脈衝重複頻率決定沿掃描方向的名義點距。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.75 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。掃描速度與有效脈衝取得率固定；不含漏觸發及聲束寬度。使用速度編碼器與脈衝時序作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；打滑會造成漏掃區段，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「掃描點距估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Pulse repetition frequency determines nominal along-scan spacing. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2.75 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Scan speed and effective pulse-acquisition rate are fixed; missed triggers and beam width are excluded. Use speed encoder and pulse timing as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Slip can leave an uninspected section; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Ultrasonic scan spacing” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz；y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz; y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：打滑會造成漏掃區段」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Slip can leave an uninspected section." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「掃描點距估算」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Ultrasonic scan spacing”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 掃描點距估算
knowledge.text: 脈衝重複頻率決定沿掃描方向的名義點距。本模型把 v 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2.75 mm。
knowledge.textEn: Pulse repetition frequency determines nominal along-scan spacing. In this model, v is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：打滑會造成漏掃區段 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Slip can leave an uninspected section. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「掃描點距估算」，下列哪一項敘述正確？

options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：打滑會造成漏掃區段

steps.title: 掃描點距估算：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic scan spacing: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「掃描點距估算」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Ultrasonic scan spacing” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz；y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=2.75 mm。模型邊界：掃描速度與有效脈衝取得率固定；不含漏觸發及聲束寬度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz; y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.75 mm. Boundary: Scan speed and effective pulse-acquisition rate are fixed; missed triggers and beam width are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以速度編碼器與脈衝時序區分模型與觀察，先用逐脈衝時間戳、編碼器位置及成功取得回波計數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use speed encoder and pulse timing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz；y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=2.75 mm。模型邊界：掃描速度與有效脈衝取得率固定；不含漏觸發及聲束寬度；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。
knowledge.textEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz; y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.75 mm. Boundary: Scan speed and effective pulse-acquisition rate are fixed; missed triggers and beam width are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

quiz.question: 依「掃描點距估算」的定量模型，下列哪一項敘述成立？
quiz.questionEn: According to the quantitative model for "Ultrasonic scan spacing", which statement holds?

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Treating sound path as depth mislocates the reflector.

quiz.explanationEn: Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=5 m/s, prf=2000 Hz; y=v/prf*1000=2.5 mm. Keep units when recalculating.

steps.title: 掃描點距估算：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic scan spacing: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「掃描點距估算」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Ultrasonic scan spacing” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以速度編碼器與脈衝時序區分模型與觀察，先用逐脈衝時間戳、編碼器位置及成功取得回波計數建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「掃描點距估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use speed encoder and pulse timing to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using per-pulse timestamps, encoder positions and successful echo-acquisition counts, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Ultrasonic scan spacing. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「掃描點距估算」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出掃描速度與有效脈衝取得率固定；不含漏觸發及聲束寬度如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由打滑會造成漏掃區段造成偏離的合成觀察，以速度編碼器與脈衝時序說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Ultrasonic scan spacing, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Scan speed and effective pulse-acquisition rate are fixed; missed triggers and beam width are excluded. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Slip can leave an uninspected section. Explain which evidence in speed encoder and pulse timing distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：打滑會造成漏掃區段。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Slip can leave an uninspected section. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 掃描點距估算：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Ultrasonic scan spacing: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「掃描點距估算」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Ultrasonic scan spacing” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 打滑會造成漏掃區段。這個失效與「掃描點距估算」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查速度編碼器與脈衝時序，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Slip can leave an uninspected section. This failure and a measurement bias in Ultrasonic scan spacing can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check speed encoder and pulse timing rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用速度編碼器與脈衝時序作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；打滑會造成漏掃區段，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Slip can leave an uninspected section; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：打滑會造成漏掃區段」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Slip can leave an uninspected section." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

Cross-check speed encoder and pulse timing rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「掃描點距估算」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？

Slip can leave an uninspected section.
