steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Dynamic modulus ratio” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以共振頻率及試件質量區分模型與觀察，先用同模態共振頻率、試件質量含水率及支承配置建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「動態彈模比較」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use resonant frequency and specimen mass to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using same-mode resonant frequencies, specimen mass and moisture, and support configuration, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Dynamic modulus ratio. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「動態彈模比較」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出試件質量、幾何及模態相同；頻率平方比只作剛度比例如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀造成偏離的合成觀察，以共振頻率及試件質量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Dynamic modulus ratio, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Specimen mass, geometry and mode are unchanged; frequency-squared ratio is only a stiffness ratio. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference. Explain which evidence in resonant frequency and specimen mass distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。

steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 動態彈模比較：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Dynamic modulus ratio: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「動態彈模比較」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Dynamic modulus ratio” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀。這個失效與「動態彈模比較」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查共振頻率及試件質量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference. This failure and a measurement bias in Dynamic modulus ratio can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check resonant frequency and specimen mass rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用共振頻率及試件質量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：含水質量改變會干擾剛度判讀」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Moisture mass change confounds stiffness inference." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

title: 高速道岔組裝
summary: 高速道岔組裝以「道岔線形組裝公差與輪軌導引」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。高速道岔不是單一轉向角，而是尖軌、導曲線與轍叉協同導引；各構件公差需回到共同中心線和輪對通過包絡。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops turnout alignment assembly tolerances and wheel guidance through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A high-speed turnout is not a single angle but coordinated guidance by switch rails, closure curves and crossing; component tolerances need one centreline and wheelset passage envelope. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：n=18 1；y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree。只把 n 增加百分之十，y=2.89127 degree。模型邊界：道岔號數定義為分岔角正切的倒數；其他號數慣例不適用；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：v=45 m/s, R=1800 m；y=v**2/R=1.125 m/s2。只把 v 增加百分之十，y=1.36125 m/s2。模型邊界：固定分歧速度及圓曲線半徑；不含超高與車體滾動；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: n=18 1; y=atan(1/n)*180/pi=3.17983 degree. Increasing only n with a ten-percent increase gives y=2.89127 degree. Boundary: Turnout number is defined as reciprocal tangent of divergence angle; other numbering conventions do not apply; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: v=45 m/s, R=1800 m; y=v**2/R=1.125 m/s2. Increasing only v with a ten-percent increase gives y=1.36125 m/s2. Boundary: Constant diverging speed and circular radius; cant and body roll are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 道岔分岔角估算與導曲線橫向加速

stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Turnout divergence angle" and "Closure-curve lateral acceleration": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 道岔分岔角估算：機制與系統路徑

steps.instruction: 直股速度不能直接當作側股速度。這個失效與「導曲線橫向加速」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查分歧速度與曲率，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed. This failure and a measurement bias in Closure-curve lateral acceleration can produce similar symptoms. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用分歧速度與曲率作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；直股速度不能直接當作側股速度，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。

steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Endpoint coordinate closure” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High-speed turnout assembly”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 道岔端點閉合應保留方向與共同座標。本模型把 dx 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.72022 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向。使用獨立控制點測量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「兩端座標閉合」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Turnout endpoint closure needs direction and common coordinates. In this model, dx is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.72022 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction. Use independent control-point survey as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Endpoint coordinate closure” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm；y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm; y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「兩端座標閉合」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。

steps.title: 兩端座標閉合：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Endpoint coordinate closure: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「兩端座標閉合」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Endpoint coordinate closure” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm；y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm。只把 dx 增加百分之十，y=3.72022 mm。模型邊界：端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: dx=2 mm, dy=3 mm; y=sqrt(dx**2+dy**2)=3.60555 mm. Increasing only dx with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.72022 mm. Boundary: Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以獨立控制點測量區分模型與觀察，先用獨立控制點、東北向殘差及閉合向量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use independent control-point survey to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 兩端座標閉合：試驗與驗證

steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「兩端座標閉合」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Endpoint coordinate closure” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以獨立控制點測量區分模型與觀察，先用獨立控制點、東北向殘差及閉合向量建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「兩端座標閉合」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use independent control-point survey to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using independent control points, east-north residuals and closure vector, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Endpoint coordinate closure. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「兩端座標閉合」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出端點在同一平面座標系；長度不保留修正方向如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略造成偏離的合成觀察，以獨立控制點測量說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Endpoint coordinate closure, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Endpoints share one planar coordinate system; magnitude does not retain correction direction. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. Explain which evidence in independent control-point survey distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 兩端座標閉合：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Endpoint coordinate closure: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「兩端座標閉合」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Endpoint coordinate closure” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略。這個失效與「兩端座標閉合」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查獨立控制點測量，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement. This failure and a measurement bias in Endpoint coordinate closure can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check independent control-point survey rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用獨立控制點測量作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：整組偏移可被內部相對量測忽略」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Internal relative measurements can miss whole-assembly displacement." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

steps.instructionEn: Using RMS for worst-case guarantees understates the bound. This failure and a measurement bias in Assembly tolerance stack can produce similar symptoms. stages.description: 本階段聚焦「緊固件夾持分配」與「輪緣導引時間」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Fastener clamp-force allocation" and "Flange-guidance time": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「緊固件夾持分配」如何影響高速道岔組裝的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Fastener clamp-force allocation” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “High-speed turnout assembly”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 kN。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分。使用各緊固點力或伸長作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「緊固件夾持分配」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 kN. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing. Use force or extension at each fastening point as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Fastener clamp-force allocation” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「緊固件夾持分配」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Fastener clamp-force allocation”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 緊固件夾持分配
knowledge.text: 均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。本模型把 F 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 kN。
knowledge.textEn: Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry. In this model, F is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「緊固件夾持分配」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Fastener clamp-force allocation" is correct?
options: 本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同
均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：取樣不足可能漏掉短時接觸
optionsEn: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload.
Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Insufficient sampling misses short contact events.
quiz.explanation: 均分假設需構件剛度及幾何對稱。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal sharing requires symmetric stiffness and geometry. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「緊固件夾持分配」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Fastener clamp-force allocation” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=22 kN。模型邊界：幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: F=80 kN, n=4 count; y=F/n=20 kN. Increasing only F with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 kN. Boundary: Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以各緊固點力或伸長區分模型與觀察，先用模型各點伸長、獨立夾持力及支承接觸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use force or extension at each fastening point to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：F=80 kN, n=4 count；y=F/n=20 kN。只把 F 增加百分之十，y=22 kN。模型邊界：幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。

Boundary: Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為教學假設或公開資料的簡化；套用到實際工程前，必須依規範荷載組合、材料試驗與現場量測重新計算並由技師簽證。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are teaching assumptions or simplified public data; before applying them to a real system, recalculate with code load combinations, material tests and site measurements, certified by a qualified engineer.

This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Through-route speed cannot simply become diverging-route speed.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「緊固件夾持分配」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Fastener clamp-force allocation” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以各緊固點力或伸長區分模型與觀察，先用模型各點伸長、獨立夾持力及支承接觸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「緊固件夾持分配」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use force or extension at each fastening point to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model pointwise extension, independent clamp force and support contact, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fastener clamp-force allocation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「緊固件夾持分配」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同造成偏離的合成觀察，以各緊固點力或伸長說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fastener clamp-force allocation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. Explain which evidence in force or extension at each fastening point distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 本單元以各緊固點力或伸長區分模型與觀察，先用模型各點伸長、獨立夾持力及支承接觸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「緊固件夾持分配」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。
knowledge.textEn: Use force or extension at each fastening point to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using model pointwise extension, independent clamp force and support contact, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Fastener clamp-force allocation. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 重算「緊固件夾持分配」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出幾何剛度對稱且接觸均勻；不以相同扭矩保證等分如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同造成偏離的合成觀察，以各緊固點力或伸長說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
knowledge.textEn: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Fastener clamp-force allocation, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Symmetric geometry and stiffness with uniform contact; equal torque does not prove equal sharing. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. Explain which evidence in force or extension at each fastening point distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

quiz.question: 要驗證「緊固件夾持分配」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Fastener clamp-force allocation"?
options: 本單元以各緊固點力或伸長區分模型與觀察，先用模型各點伸長、獨立夾持力及支承接觸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
量測時不必記錄溫度、速度、運行歷程與施工荷重，因為它們不會影響結果。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：長枕局部懸空會在載重後改變線形

Temperature, speed, operating history and construction loads need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: A locally unsupported bearer changes geometry under load.
quiz.explanation: 本單元以各緊固點力或伸長區分模型與觀察，先用模型各點伸長、獨立夾持力及支承接觸建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Use force or extension at each fastening point to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Verification needs a datum, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 緊固件夾持分配：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Fastener clamp-force allocation: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「緊固件夾持分配」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Fastener clamp-force allocation” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同。這個失效與「緊固件夾持分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各緊固點力或伸長，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. This failure and a measurement bias in Fastener clamp-force allocation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check force or extension at each fastening point rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用各緊固點力或伸長作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同。這個失效與「緊固件夾持分配」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查各緊固點力或伸長，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. This failure and a measurement bias in Fastener clamp-force allocation can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check force or extension at each fastening point rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

quiz.question: 在「緊固件夾持分配」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Fastener clamp-force allocation" shows distress, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 所有異常都來自施工人員失誤，設計與細部不需要檢討。
扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同。
本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：取樣不足可能漏掉短時接觸
optionsEn: Every anomaly is a workmanship error, so design and detailing never need review.
Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload.
This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Insufficient sampling misses short contact events.
quiz.explanation: 扭矩相同不保證預緊力相同。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Equal torque does not guarantee equal preload. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 輪緣導引時間：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Flange-guidance time: mechanism and system paths

steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Inspection checklist coverage” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：done=45 count, required=50 count；y=done/required*100=90 percent。只把 done 增加一個整數單位，y=92 percent。模型邊界：完成與必需項的定義固定；數量比例不替代關鍵項判定；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: done=45 count, required=50 count; y=done/required*100=90 percent. Increasing only done with an increase of one whole unit gives y=92 percent. Boundary: Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以每項驗證證據與未完成項區分模型與觀察，先用每項模型證據、未完成原因與關鍵項獨立判定建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use evidence for each check and open items to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 檢驗覆蓋清單：試驗與驗證

steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Inspection checklist coverage” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以每項驗證證據與未完成項區分模型與觀察，先用每項模型證據、未完成原因與關鍵項獨立判定建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「檢驗覆蓋清單」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use evidence for each check and open items to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Inspection checklist coverage. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.

steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Inspection checklist coverage, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Definitions of completed and required items are fixed; count fraction does not replace critical-item decisions. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. Explain which evidence in evidence for each check and open items distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.

steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.title: 檢驗覆蓋清單：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Inspection checklist coverage: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「檢驗覆蓋清單」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or deterioration causes of “Inspection checklist coverage” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。這個失效與「檢驗覆蓋清單」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查每項驗證證據與未完成項，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection checklist coverage can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check evidence for each check and open items rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用每項驗證證據與未完成項作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

knowledge.text: 用完成率取代關鍵項未通過會造成假結案。這個失效與「檢驗覆蓋清單」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查每項驗證證據與未完成項，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。
knowledge.textEn: Completion percentage can hide a failed critical item. This failure and a measurement bias in Inspection checklist coverage can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check evidence for each check and open items rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢測確認；只補強外觀、更換構件或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; cosmetic repair, swapping components or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

title: 道岔可動心軌控制
summary: 道岔可動心軌控制以「可動心軌位置鎖閉與回讀一致性」為主線，將十個物理或系統問題拆成機制、計算、驗證與診斷。可動心軌在不同路徑下提供連續輪面支承，位置、機械鎖閉與電氣表示是三種獨立證據；命令發出並不等於路徑已可使用。每個單元附帶可重算的假想數據與敏感度，學員需提交帶單位的工作表、可區分失效的證據及模型邊界。
summaryEn: This course develops movable frog position locking and feedback consistency through ten physical or systems questions, each studied through mechanism, calculation, verification and diagnosis. A movable frog provides continuous running support for different routes; position, mechanical locking and electrical indication are separate evidence, and issuing a command does not establish route availability. Every unit contains reproducible assumed inputs and a sensitivity calculation. Learners submit a worksheet with units, discriminating evidence for failures, and explicit model boundaries.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、軌道進入、牽引供電隔離或列車營運許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, track-access, traction-power isolation or train-operation permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

workedExample.title: 原創假想算例與邊界
workedExample.text: 以下為跨單元的原創假想工作表。先用第一單元定義邊界與單位，再以第二單元檢查另一個控制量，最後用第三單元提出前兩式未涵蓋的另一個檢查問題。原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。只把 travel 增加百分之十，y=22 mm/s。模型邊界：位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s；y=timeout-move-prove=3 s。只把 timeout 增加百分之十，y=3.8 s。模型邊界：移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。把兩個算例的單一輸入敏感度放在同一張決策表，說明哪個變化最值得先量測；不可把不同物理量的裸數字直接比較，也不可把任一結果當成實際設備的設計、施工或營運許可。
workedExample.textEn: This original worksheet connects the first three units using assumed inputs. Establish boundaries and units with the first unit, examine another controlling quantity with the second, and use the third to pose a separate check outside the first two equations. Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s. Increasing only travel with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 mm/s. Boundary: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Original assumed example, not field operating values: timeout=8 s, move=4 s, prove=1 s; y=timeout-move-prove=3 s. Increasing only timeout with a ten-percent increase gives y=3.8 s. Boundary: Movement and proving stages are sequential without overlap; timeout budget is a teaching assumption; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification.Put both single-input sensitivities in one decision table and explain which change most deserves measurement. Do not compare bare numbers with different physical dimensions, and do not treat any result as design approval, a construction procedure or operating permission.
workedExample.assumptions: 數值是本課自行設定的教學假設，不代表任何專案的設計值、量測值或規範允許值；改變系統邊界或荷載組合後必須重算。
workedExample.assumptionsEn: Inputs are teaching assumptions, not any project's design values, measurements or code allowances; recalculate after changing the system boundary or load combination.
workedExample.sourceScope: 原創數值練習；來源支援公開原理與工程背景，不宣稱來源提供這組數據。
workedExample.sourceScopeEn: Original numerical exercise; sources support public principles and project context, not these numbers.

stages.title: 心軌平均行程速度與鎖閉時間餘量
stages.titleEn: Mean frog travel speed & Locking time reserve
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「心軌平均行程速度」與「鎖閉時間餘量」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Mean frog travel speed" and "Locking time reserve": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 心軌平均行程速度：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Mean frog travel speed: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「心軌平均行程速度」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Mean frog travel speed” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 平均速度不描述起動和鎖閉區的局部速度。本模型把 travel 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 22 mm/s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻。使用全行程位置時間曲線作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「心軌平均行程速度」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Mean speed does not describe local speed during starting and locking. In this model, travel is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 22 mm/s. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed. Use full-stroke position-time trace as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Mean frog travel speed” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「心軌平均行程速度」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Mean frog travel speed”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Mean speed does not describe local speed during starting and locking. In this model, travel is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

steps.title: 心軌平均行程速度：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Mean frog travel speed: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「心軌平均行程速度」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Mean frog travel speed” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：travel=80 mm, time=4 s；y=travel/time=20 mm/s。只把 travel 增加百分之十，y=22 mm/s。模型邊界：位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: travel=80 mm, time=4 s; y=travel/time=20 mm/s. Increasing only travel with a ten-percent increase gives y=22 mm/s. Boundary: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以全行程位置時間曲線區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型連續位置、共同時鐘及末端停滯時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use full-stroke position-time trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.title: 心軌平均行程速度：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Mean frog travel speed: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「心軌平均行程速度」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停工點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Mean frog travel speed” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 本單元以全行程位置時間曲線區分模型與觀察，先用低壓模型連續位置、共同時鐘及末端停滯時間建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「心軌平均行程速度」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Use full-stroke position-time trace to distinguish the model from observation in this unit. Establish a baseline using continuous low-voltage model position, common clock and endpoint dwell time, then repeat at the same locations and conditions. Keep input and output records separate, recording calibration, resolution and timestamps. Change one input while holding others fixed and check the trend predicted by Mean frog travel speed. When residuals exceed a predefined teaching tolerance, examine units and the measurement chain before attributing the difference to omitted physics. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments and sensors, datums or reference specimens, procedure, comparison baseline, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：重算「心軌平均行程速度」的基準與所列單一輸入變動案例，畫出輸入至輸出的關係，並寫出位移與時間屬同一完整行程；不推定局部速度均勻如何限制結論。接著設計一組符合模型及一組由相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻造成偏離的合成觀察，以全行程位置時間曲線說明哪個證據能分辨兩者，保留單位及有效位數。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Recalculate the baseline and specified single-input perturbation for Mean frog travel speed, plot the input-output relationship, and explain the limiting assumption: Movement and time cover the same full stroke; uniform local speed is not assumed. Construct one synthetic observation consistent with the model and another affected by this failure: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding. Explain which evidence in full-stroke position-time trace distinguishes them, keeping units and justified significant figures throughout.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：相同平均速度可隱藏末端卡阻。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄溫度、速度與操作條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Equal mean speeds can hide end-position binding. A single reading, no traceable datum, or unrecorded temperature, speed and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停工點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格或不合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, datums, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

steps.instruction: 移動和證明時間共同消耗超時預算。本模型把 timeout 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 3.8 s。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。移動與證明階段依序且不重疊；超時預算是教學假設。使用命令位置鎖閉的時間戳作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「鎖閉時間餘量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Movement and proving time consume one timeout budget. In this model, timeout is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 3.8 s. Movement and proving stages are sequential without overlap; timeout budget is a teaching assumption. Use command, position and lock timestamps as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Monitoring motor stop alone misses an unlocked state; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Locking time reserve” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 只監測馬達停止會漏掉未鎖閉狀態。這個失效與「鎖閉時間餘量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查命令位置鎖閉的時間戳，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Monitoring motor stop alone misses an unlocked state. This failure and a measurement bias in Locking time reserve can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check command, position and lock timestamps rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Monitoring motor stop alone misses an unlocked state." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 感測器分辨率與推力量級估算
stages.titleEn: Position sensor resolution & Actuation-force scale
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「感測器分辨率」與「推力量級估算」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Position sensor resolution" and "Actuation-force scale": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 感測器分辨率：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Position sensor resolution: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「感測器分辨率」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Position sensor resolution” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 數位分辨率不是絕對位置精度。本模型把 stroke 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.0268555 mm/count。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。完整行程均勻分配至計數格；不含校準誤差及間隙。使用基準尺與編碼器對照作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；高位元數可能掩蓋機械間隙，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「感測器分辨率」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Digital resolution is not absolute position accuracy. In this model, stroke is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.0268555 mm/count. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Full stroke is uniformly divided into count bins; calibration error and backlash are excluded. Use reference gauge versus encoder reading as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Position sensor resolution” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stroke=100 mm, counts=4096 count；y=stroke/counts=0.0244141 mm/count。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stroke=100 mm, counts=4096 count; y=stroke/counts=0.0244141 mm/count.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：高位元數可能掩蓋機械間隙」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「感測器分辨率」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Position sensor resolution”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

steps.title: 感測器分辨率：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Position sensor resolution: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「感測器分辨率」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Position sensor resolution” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：stroke=100 mm, counts=4096 count；y=stroke/counts=0.0244141 mm/count。只把 stroke 增加百分之十，y=0.0268555 mm/count。模型邊界：完整行程均勻分配至計數格；不含校準誤差及間隙；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: stroke=100 mm, counts=4096 count; y=stroke/counts=0.0244141 mm/count. Increasing only stroke with a ten-percent increase gives y=0.0268555 mm/count. Boundary: Full stroke is uniformly divided into count bins; calibration error and backlash are excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以基準尺與編碼器對照區分模型與觀察，先用模型基準尺、編碼器碼值及正反行程回差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use reference gauge versus encoder reading to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以基準尺與編碼器對照區分模型與觀察，先用模型基準尺、編碼器碼值及正反行程回差建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「感測器分辨率」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instructionEn: High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash. This failure and a measurement bias in Position sensor resolution can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check reference gauge versus encoder reading rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: High bit depth can conceal mechanical backlash." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.instruction: 固定機械速度下可用推力受功率及效率限制。本模型把 P 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 2750 N。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。功率與效率固定、速度非零且穩態；不適用堵轉。使用低載模型推力及速度作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；以堵轉電流直接推定有效推力可能失準，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「推力量級估算」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Available force at fixed speed depends on power and efficiency. In this model, P is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 2750 N. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Power and efficiency are constant at nonzero steady speed; stall is excluded. Use low-load model force and speed as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Stall current alone can misrepresent useful force; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Actuation-force scale” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.

steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：P=100 W, eta=0.5 1, v=0.02 m/s；y=P*eta/v=2500 N。只把 P 增加百分之十，y=2750 N。模型邊界：功率與效率固定、速度非零且穩態；不適用堵轉；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: P=100 W, eta=0.5 1, v=0.02 m/s; y=P*eta/v=2500 N. Increasing only P with a ten-percent increase gives y=2750 N. Boundary: Power and efficiency are constant at nonzero steady speed; stall is excluded; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以低載模型推力及速度區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型同步電功率、機械速度與推力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。

steps.instruction: 本單元以低載模型推力及速度區分模型與觀察，先用低載模型同步電功率、機械速度與推力建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「推力量級估算」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.title: 行程不一致量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「行程不一致量」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Stroke discrepancy” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 命令與實測差描述運動鏈的未完成量。本模型把 commanded 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 13 mm。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。命令與實測使用同一零點和行程方向；差值不直接指認原因。使用獨立位移與控制器紀錄作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；連桿鬆脫使馬達到位但心軌未到位，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「行程不一致量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Command-minus-measured travel describes an incomplete movement chain. In this model, commanded is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 13 mm. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Command and measurement share zero and direction; the discrepancy does not identify its cause. Use independent displacement and controller log as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. A detached linkage lets the motor arrive without the frog; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. steps.title: 行程不一致量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「行程不一致量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “Stroke discrepancy” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：commanded=80 mm, measured=75 mm；y=commanded-measured=5 mm。只把 commanded 增加百分之十，y=13 mm。模型邊界：命令與實測使用同一零點和行程方向；差值不直接指認原因；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: commanded=80 mm, measured=75 mm; y=commanded-measured=5 mm. Increasing only commanded with a ten-percent increase gives y=13 mm. Boundary: Command and measurement share zero and direction; the discrepancy does not identify its cause; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以獨立位移與控制器紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用心軌模型獨立位移、連桿位移及控制器命令帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。

steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以獨立位移與控制器紀錄區分模型與觀察，先用心軌模型獨立位移、連桿位移及控制器命令帳建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「行程不一致量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instructionEn: A detached linkage lets the motor arrive without the frog. This failure and a measurement bias in Stroke discrepancy can produce similar symptoms. steps.instructionEn: Disagreement should preserve a diagnostic state rather than be averaged away. In this model, s1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 8.88 mm. steps.instruction: 同源感測器可能共同錯誤而仍一致。這個失效與「雙感測差異量」的量測偏差可能產生相似表象，因此必須同時檢查兩條獨立量測鏈，不能只靠一個合成指標判定原因。若資料無法區分兩種假說，結論應保留未確定狀態，並提出下一項可推翻假說的獨立測試。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢測，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響整體系統的安全、使用性、耐久或營運。
steps.instructionEn: Common-source sensors can agree while both are wrong. This failure and a measurement bias in Dual-sensor disagreement can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check two independent measurement chains rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.
steps.observation: 連結機制：使用兩條獨立量測鏈作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；同源感測器可能共同錯誤而仍一致，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: Common-source sensors can agree while both are wrong; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：同源感測器可能共同錯誤而仍一致」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Common-source sensors can agree while both are wrong." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

steps.title: 狀態覆蓋數量：機制與系統路徑

steps.objective: 說明「狀態覆蓋數量」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “State-space combination count” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 二元狀態組合數快速增加，需先定義不可接受組合。本模型把 bits 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加一個整數單位，輸出增加為 32 states。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。位元數為非負整數且每位二元；只算組合數，不表示皆可達或安全。使用狀態表與自動重播作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；只測正常切換會漏掉矛盾表示，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「狀態覆蓋數量」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Binary combinations grow rapidly and require explicitly forbidden states. In this model, bits is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. An increase of one whole unit means the output increases to 32 states. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Bit count is a nonnegative integer and each bit binary; combinations need not all be reachable or safe. Use state tables and automated replay as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Testing only normal transitions misses contradictory indication; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “State-space combination count” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：bits=4 count；y=2**bits=16 states。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: bits=4 count; y=2**bits=16 states.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：只測正常切換會漏掉矛盾表示」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。

steps.title: 狀態覆蓋數量：定量估算

steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「狀態覆蓋數量」的關鍵量，並判斷幾何、速度、荷載或材料參數改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantities of “State-space combination count” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when geometry, speed, load or material parameters move.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：bits=4 count；y=2**bits=16 states。只把 bits 增加一個整數單位，y=32 states。模型邊界：位元數為非負整數且每位二元；只算組合數，不表示皆可達或安全；上式只代表本單元明列項，不把它視為完整驗證。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次，再只改變一個輸入（連續量可增加 10%；計數須保持整數；分貝量使用加減值），預測並計算輸出的變化，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出規範或設計上通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: Original assumed example, not field operating values: bits=4 count; y=2**bits=16 states. Increasing only bits with an increase of one whole unit gives y=32 states. Boundary: Bit count is a nonnegative integer and each bit binary; combinations need not all be reachable or safe; this equation represents only the explicitly listed term and is not a complete verification. Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units, then change one input (for example +10% for a continuous quantity; retain integers for counts and use additive changes for decibels), predict and compute the output change, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how codes or designers usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 如何核對：本單元以狀態表與自動重播區分模型與觀察，先用完整教學狀態表、禁止組合及逐案例重播建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。
steps.observationEn: How to cross-check: Use state tables and automated replay to distinguish the model from observation in this unit.
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成真實設計值、混淆標稱值與設計值（未乘載重或強度係數），或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續設計判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as real design values, mixing nominal and factored values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later design decisions.
steps.check: 依模型顯示精度重現數值，列出單位與取整方式，並提交一個參數改變後的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce the model values to their displayed precision, state units and rounding, and submit a sensitivity calculation for one changed parameter with an engineering explanation.

steps.instruction: 本單元以狀態表與自動重播區分模型與觀察，先用完整教學狀態表、禁止組合及逐案例重播建立基準，再保留相同量測位置與工況重複比較。將輸入表與輸出表分開保存，記下校正、解析度及時間戳記；至少改變一個輸入並保持其餘條件，檢查結果方向是否符合「狀態覆蓋數量」的方程。殘差超出事先設定的教學容差時，先查單位與量測鏈，再查省略的物理項。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器與感測器、基準點或參考試體、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停工點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。

steps.instructionEn: An old arrival indication is not current lock evidence. This failure and a measurement bias in Stale-data movement scale can produce similar symptoms. Cross-check timestamp and current-position comparison rather than diagnosing from one aggregate score. If the available observations cannot distinguish the hypotheses, retain an unresolved conclusion and specify an independent test that could falsify one explanation. Repeating the same biased sensor is not independent confirmation. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects whole-system safety, serviceability, durability or operation.

steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢測能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。

stages.title: 獨立漏檢乘積與回讀掃描間距
stages.titleEn: Independent miss coincidence & Feedback scan interval
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「獨立漏檢乘積」與「回讀掃描間距」：先建立機制、系統路徑與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Independent miss coincidence" and "Feedback scan interval": establish the mechanism, system paths and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

steps.title: 獨立漏檢乘積：機制與系統路徑
steps.titleEn: Independent miss coincidence: mechanism and system paths
steps.objective: 說明「獨立漏檢乘積」如何影響道岔可動心軌控制的受力、變形、水流或訊號表現，並畫出相關輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Independent miss coincidence” governs forces, deformation, flow or signals in “Movable-point frog control”, and map the relevant inputs, transfer paths and boundaries.
steps.instruction: 只有獨立漏檢才可用乘積，不能套用共同原因故障。本模型把 p1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.00022 1。這個比較描述明列方程的局部敏感度，不能把相關變數也一起改變後仍稱為相同測試。兩漏檢事件獨立且概率屬同一需求；未計共同原因。使用人工注入故障與獨立性證據作量測證據，才能檢查方程是否對應此處的實際物理量；共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀，因此應把該原因與量測偏差分開。 師傅任務：以自由體圖、流路圖或訊號圖畫出相關物理量如何經過「獨立漏檢乘積」傳到系統邊界，標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由材料、施工或環境決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Only independent misses multiply; common-cause faults violate this assumption. In this model, p1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed. A ten-percent increase means the output increases to 0.00022 1. This comparison describes the sensitivity of the stated equation; changing correlated variables at the same time would be a different experiment. Miss events are independent and probabilities refer to one demand; common causes are excluded. Use injected faults and evidence of independence as measurement evidence that the equation represents the intended physical quantity. Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic; separate that causal mechanism from bias in the measurement chain. Mentor task: draw a free-body, flow or signal diagram showing how relevant physical quantities pass through “Independent miss coincidence” to the system boundary, mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by materials, construction or environment, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 量級提示：原創假想算例，輸入不是現場操作值：p1=0.01 1, p2=0.02 1；y=p1*p2=0.0002 1。
steps.observationEn: Order-of-magnitude cue: Original assumed example, not field operating values: p1=0.01 1, p2=0.02 1; y=p1*p2=0.0002 1.
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在系統圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your system diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 系統圖標明「獨立漏檢乘積」的輸入、傳遞路徑與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The system diagram shows inputs, transfer paths and boundaries for “Independent miss coincidence”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.title: 獨立漏檢乘積
knowledge.text: 只有獨立漏檢才可用乘積，不能套用共同原因故障。本模型把 p1 當成主動改變的輸入，其餘輸入固定；當它增加百分之十，輸出增加為 0.00022 1。
knowledge.textEn: Only independent misses multiply; common-cause faults violate this assumption. In this model, p1 is deliberately changed while every other input is held fixed.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：本單元絕不可能出現這種失效：共享電源故障會讓乘積估計過度樂觀 正確的工程判斷必須回到傳力機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: This unit cannot exhibit the following failure: Shared supply failure makes the product estimate optimistic. Sound engineering judgement goes back to the load path and magnitude.

quiz.question: 關於「獨立漏檢乘積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Independent miss coincidence" is correct?
